A delicious, balanced wine with a textural, persistent finish. Pairs well with vegetarian dishes.

The Clare Valley is renowned for producing outstanding wines. Sourced from premium parcels of grapes from across the region, this fresh and elegant Riesling shows steely lime fruit character, fresh acidity and long length of flavour. This wine may be enjoyed now, or will reward with careful cellaring over the medium term.
Bottled Chaos provides an insight into what winemakers taste in the winery when tasting ferments and wines still in their raw state, the results are perfect in their characterful chaos.

This seductive Pinot Grigio comes from the beautiful undulating agrarian countryside of Puglia. Situated at the heal of Italy and skirted by the Adriatic and Mediterranean seas this romantic classical landscape of olive groves, market gardens and vineyards is dominated by vivid red soils and punctuated by hill towns, traditional whitewashed trulli houses, seaside fortresses and Roman ruins. The long hot dry summers and cool night breezes are ideal conditions for producing generously flavoured wines. Pinot Grigio is naturally high in acidity while cool fermentation techniques can preserve fruitiness and freshness. Notte Rossa Pinot Grigio is a ripe expression and offers lovely nectarine, white apricot, pear aromas, intense sweet fruit flavours, creamy textures and plenty of refreshing crisp acidity. It’s a lovely foil to the leaner minerally styles of Northern Italy and perfect for the Australian palate! Enjoy with antipasto of all types, chicken schnitzel, grilled fish, risotto or hard cheeses.

Bright pale straw. Harmonious fine fruit with savoury complexities, displaying perfumes of nashi pear, Granny Smith apples and nectarine skin with hints of lemon butter, herb salt, crushed shells and a hit of Chinese five spice. A seamless palate with acidity that is so soft, yet shows stunning freshness. Creamy yet vibrant. This is a cool year, that shows restraint and super-fine balance.

Studio by Miraval Vermentino is the latest release from the “Brangelina” stable. While Hollywood brings the “razzle-dazzle” reputation, Miraval is one of the world’s most authentic celebrity wine brands. Actor Brad Pitt once dreamed of becoming an architect and his enthusiasm for precision and aesthetic beauty – are encapsulated by this tremendously impactful vermentino. By partnering with the Perrin Family, he found kindred souls who could use their considerable experience to farm and vinify expressive wines that stood for something. Although Miraval is based in the ancient village of Correns in Provence its - Studio de Miraval - derives from more widely sourced fruit. This neatly reflects the story of the estate’s recording studio which has hosted many famous rock bands including Australia’s AC/DC and Pink Floyd. Vermentino (also known as Rolle) is prolifically grown amongst the pine trees and olive groves along the French Riviera. The warm growing conditions and proximity to the Mediterranean Sea allow these grapes to accumulate plenty of flavour and aromatic freshness. The wine is cool vinified to promote clarity and varietal definition. Battonage (lees-stirring) is practiced achieving roundness and texture. The Studio de Miraval Vermentino is a reference style with intense pear, lime, white apricot, tonic water aromas, ripe generous flavours, attractive mid-palate creaminess, attractive bitter-sweet notes and fine minerally acidity. This is a delicious summer wine that can be enjoyed on all occasions especially with friends over a meal. Pair with salmon, pork fennel sausages, roasted vegetables, tomato salads or soft and hard cheeses.

Le Lulu Sauvignon Blanc is a popular “Vin de France” featuring Liberty, Quality and Creativity! Meticulous sourcing and modern winemaking technologies result in a delicious fruit driven wine showing pure fruit aromatics and liveliness. The fruit is sourced from vineyards between the Pyrenees and the Atlantic coast including Gascony. The growing season benefits from a maritime influence and warm summers. Vinified in stainless steel the fruit-driven Lulu Le Francais Sauvignon Blanc style is all about fun, fruitiness and freshness. Tropical fruit, grapefruit aromas and flavours, plentiful sweet fruit notes and a persistent tang are typical. This is a very versatile and gluggable wine! Pair with antipasto, raw or grilled fish, Niçoise salad, or quiche. Or enjoy with friends.

Cotes du Roses Chardonnay is a classic ripe fruit-driven style that reflects the warm Mediterranean climate and the varied “terroirs” of the Languedoc region. The soils range from limestone and schist to river gravels and the vineyards are all managed with sustainable principles. The fruit is picked at optimum ripeness and cool-vinified in stainless steel. The unique bottle with its base shaped as a rose, offers another experience all together. When tipped into an ice bucket it looks like a sculpture of a rose, wrapped in glass. Cotes du Roses Chardonnay exemplifies Gerard Bertrand’s eye for design and craftsmanship and typifies the warm relaxed Mediterranean lifestyle. The wine is light gold in colour with intense grapefruit, apricot, tropical fruit aromas and flavours, supple textures, lovely mid-palate richness and plenty of mineral length. Chill it down as an aperitif and enjoy the romance - or share with friends over a meal. Pair with seafood, white meats or salads.

Le Sauvignon Blanc by Paul Mas is the quintessential South of France experience where warm dry growing seasons lead to perfectly ripe grapes and gorgeously seductive wines. Vigneron Jean Claude Mas has worked assiduously to build a vineyard empire using organic and sustainable practices. A disciple of precision winemaking practices he employs the latest in technology to preserve natural fruit characters and linear freshness. The sauvignon blanc grapes are picked at optimum ripeness and cool-vinified at Domaine Paul Mas, near Pezenas in the Languedoc. Typically, this vibrant and juicy wine is pale coloured with intense grapefruit, lime, herb garden, camomile aromas, lovely fresh grapefruit, tropical fruit, lemon curd flavours, fine lacy textures and superb cutting acidity. The silk screened “flower” bottle neatly captures and sells the floral aromatics and prettiness of the wine. This is very much a warmer climate style with plenty of expression, freshness and flavour. Enjoy as a sundowner or pair with summer salads, roast chicken or pork, or seafood dishes.

The Zonin family’s Castello del Poggio Delle Venezia Pinot Grigio draws fruit from sustainably grown vineyards in North-East Italy. It is typified by pure fresh green apple, pear, lemon glacé aromas and flavours, attractive minerally textures and crisp clean acidity. The Castello de Poggio brand is steeped in history going back to 1699 and the ancient fortress on the original property at Asti goes back to the 12th Century. After its acquisition in 1985 the Zonin family expanded the vineyards and extended the range to include wines from the Tre Venezie zone. This expansive landscape comprising the Veneto, Friuli-Venezia-Giuila and Trentino-Aldo-Adige wine regions broadly corresponds to the old Venetian Republic. High tech winemaking, “respect and care” for the environment and precision viticulture practices result in a signature light dry crunchy style with beautiful clarity and flavour intensity. It can be enjoyed as an aperitif or paired with salads, vegetarian dishes, white meats and seafood of all types.

Jean-Clause Mas has come up with a novel white wine with an eye catching spring-summer theme. With its elegant branding from top to toe, this original Pinot Grigio is a breath of fresh air showing plenty of enticing flavours. This wine offers an elegant nose of apricot with spring flower aromas. On the palate, it is a round, velvety and crisp wine, with great freshness and balance. It is the perfect partner for seafood, fish and sushi. You can also enjoy it on its own and an appetizer.

The Sacchetto family’s Mille Bolle Pinot Grigio is a light crisp white wine with attractive pear skin, white apricot, tonic water aromas, mouth filling pear, stone fruit flavours supple creamy textures and persistent refreshing acidity. Controlled cool fermentation in stainless steel fermenters results in superb definition and freshness. The pinot grigio (pinot gris) fruit is sourced from vineyards around the enormous Delle Venezie region of North-East Italy. The Sachetto family has been making wine since the 1920s and flourished in Italy’s postwar boom by producing fresh animated wines with plenty of flavour and definition. Next generation Paolo and Beatrice engage traditional vineyard techniques, modern technology and new outlooks to maintain their reputation as a leading producer. Their father Filiberto Sachetto says "Living in so much tradition is a challenge, but living it and showing it to the world is the foundation of our passion and work." The refreshing Mille Bolle Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie works well as an aperitif wine or enjoy with caprese salad, chicken or veal parmigiana, pan seared white fish or a hard Italian cheese like Reggiano or Parmesan.

Kendall Jackson Vintner’s Reserve Chardonnay is an enduring symbol of the chardonnay revolution and has a history going back nearly fifty years with the establishment of cool-climate vineyards on California’s Central Coast. The style has been refined over the years but the essence remains the same. The wine is typically richly flavoured and supple with fresh white peach/ nectarine grilled nut aromas, lovely mid-palate creaminess, underlying vanilla/ toasted hazelnut notes and long fresh integrated acidity. This Californian style is ample yet minerally with attractive fruit sweetness. Barrel ferment characters and French oak maturation give the wine an extra layer of complexity and fine lacy textures. This is a great retro-modern style that will appeal to drinkers who like volume, flavour, oak, freshness and balance! Pair with grilled fish or prawns, roast chicken, mushroom risotto or vegetable terrine.

The Grand Reserve Chardonnay is made from 100% estate sourced fruit from Santa Barbara, one of California's coolest grape growing regions. Perfectly integrated tropical fruits compliment floral notes, a hint of spice and vanilla as well as nice minerality from the calciferous soils in the Santa Maria and Los Alamos Valleys.

This wine is crisp and clean and will better suit fresh salads and grilled seafood while it's young.

On the palate, the flavours are generous with notes of crème brûlée, ripe pear and baking spices and a lush, creamy finish. Pair with creamy pasta or a roast chicken.

Our Earthgarden Organic Sauvignon Blanc has lifted aromas of citrus fruits, lime and grapefruit that leap from the glass. The flavours on the palate showcase fresh herbs, lemongrass and passionfruit. The intense fresh fruit concentration is balanced with zesty acidity and is perfectly thirst-quenching.

Rich, generous and approachable, the McGuigan Black Label range is your contemporary guide to Australia’s most popular wine varieties. Whether it be a refreshing Sauvignon Blanc, a full-bodied Chardonnay or Australia’s #1 selling bottled red wine, McGuigan Black Label Red, every bottle of McGuigan Black Label is packed full of varietal flavour, proving that you need not be a connoisseur to enjoy the wine of your choice for any occasion.

McGuigan was the first Winery to be crowned International Winemaker of the Year four times at the prestigious International Wine & Spirits Competition in London. Having now achieved the feat in 2009, 2011, 2012 and 2016, McGuigan Wines is recognised as a leading winery on the world stage.

It is a fresh and elegant wine with notes of citrus, pear, white fruit, tied together with complex minerality and a long finish. A versatile wine that can be drunk with anything from Sushi to Pasta.

Floral and youthfully aromatic, the nose shows nashi pear, royal gala apple and hints of baking spice.

Fractionally off-dry to taste, the palate is textured and expressive, showing abundant fruits and spice. Long and lush with a lively acid line, the finish is moreish and mouthwatering.

This 2021 Clare Valley Riesling from Petaluma is both a youthful and young drinking wine but also has potential to be laid down for 5-10 years for exeptional drinking. The 2021 vintage saw unusual conditions however these led to a very even and long ripening period for the grapes. the grapes were handpicked and chilled overnight before a light whole bunch press occured. the grapes underwent cool fermentation in stainless steel and bottled in spring of 2021.

Made to be drunk while young and fresh, Vinho Verde is best served chilled with accompanying seafood dishes and white meat.

The palate is vibrant and lively with subtle nettle, guava and lemon flavour, well balanced acidity with a crisp, dry finish.
Intensely flavoured and very lifted Riesling character with citrus aromatics of grapefruit, lemon & lime. Enjoy as an aperitif or with seafood.

The St Andrews range from Taylors fly the flag for the iconic South Australian winery. The ultra premium wines are the true expression of the winemaking talents and terroir in which the fruit in grown. The Riesling has taken a little time to develop, but is now showing brilliant lime, citrus and tropical fruit balanced with cutting acidity.

The palate shows off a really fine, powdery-chalky feel that is in harmony with lemon pith and green apple. The fruit sweetness and powdery tannins drive the long finish.
An elegant fragrant wine displaying floral spice and lime flavours. The fresh lingering acidity makes it a perfect match with seafood and Asian cuisine.

Under the winemaking direction of Michael Brajkovich, MW, the village label is the first tier in the Kumeu River portfolio. From vineyards around the Kumeu area, it is a wild yeast ferment Chardonnay with 100% whole bunch pressing and malo. One third is barrel fermented and the whole package seeks to highlight the white peach and flintiness that makes the area famous.

This variety made famous by the Loire Valley is starting to gain a footing in Australia.  Coriole Chenin Blanc is fresh and elegant on the palate, comprising pineapple and gooseberry fruits with an attractive smoky finish.

The 2019 Sauvignon Blanc was picked at optimum ripeness during the coolest period of the night to help retain the vibrant primary fruit flavours. It was transported directly to the winery post-harvest, crushed and pressed to tank and allowed to cold settle. 48 hours later the juice was cleanly racked and inoculated with yeast selected to best express Sauvignon Blanc's varietal character. The ferment temperature was kept at around 13-14 °C to retain the fresh primary fruit aromas while also developing a complex fermentation bouquet, and increased palate weight and texture. Our winemakers have sourced parcels of wine from throughout Australia to deliver this Hidden Drop. A juicy and crisp Pinot Grigio with delectable notes of honeysuckle, pears & white peaches with an enjoyable finish.

Decrypting a wine takes skill and patience, lucky for you we've figured that out.
This Chardonnay displays aromas of fresh tropical fruit and creamy oak characters, which linger onto the palate leaving a long, pleasant finish.

Want a Sneak Preview? Then open the bottle and pour yourself a glass, you won’t be disappointed. This lively Chardonnay offers aromas of white peaches, tropical fruit flavours and hints of oak that develop onto the palate leaving a fresh finish.
Va Va Voom Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is crisp and light with fresh tropical fruit flavours that develop onto the palate leaving a clean finish. Perfect to enjoy on warm days with friends.

product_name: Blue Sky Margaret River Sauvignon Blanc Semillon 2019
product_description: Make a difference! We believe in The Search and creating a lasting legacy that can be enjoyed by future generations. We produce sustainably grown wine from iconic vineyards, which means farmers minimise inputs in the vineyard and winery and only use organic treatments. We partner with sustainability organisations contributing at least 10% of our profits. Please visit our website to see how we are helping improve our environment and making a difference.

Brookland Valley is committed to producing exceptional wines by selecting fruit from premium vineyards within Western Australia. A softly-textured and full flavoured Chardonnay. Displaying nectarine, pink grapefruit and melon with subtle nut nuances. Beautifully balanced, the wine has soft acidity and a wonderful persistence of flavour.
A lovely blend - citrus blossom aromas and tropical fruits, with a crisp and zingy finish.

Released with bottle age this is a wine which will still continue to evolve over many years the toasty lemony flavours becoming richer and more intense. A classic benchmark Hunter Semillon, it has earned its place in the Langtons Classification of Australian Wine.

Harvest at optimum maturities from low-yielding, hand pruned and hand picked vines. The Morts Block Riesling exhibits intense flavours and aromas of lemons and limes, complemented by cleansing natural acidity. Grapefruit, peach, nectarine, estate grown Riesling of classic character.

Pet Mout Chardonnay is a Petillant Naturel from France made from 100% Chardonnay grapes. Following the "Methode Ancestrale" the wine is bottled before the primary fermentation is finished, delivering a lower pressure, lightly sparkling wine in the petillant style. The wine is then finished without the addition of secondary yeasts or sugar.
It is a lovely wine with fine bubbles, aromas of citrus fruits as well as floral and mineral notes.
Perfect as an aperitif or paired with poultry dishes, sea scallops or fish.
Devil's Corner Chardonnay shows some up-front ripe stone fruit, citrus characters and hint of subtle spiciness. It shows excellent flavour intensity with great persistence and a refreshing finish.

If you want to try the benchmark in this style then look no further than Pierro. A clean and concentrated palate of lemon sherbet and gooseberry with a hint of oak influence. LTC stands for 'little touch of Chardonnay' which adds the right amount of palate weight and complexity.
The vines for this classic, cool climate Riesling date back to the early 70's. Combined with high altitude and the granite soils, this is a wine of rare purity and depth of flavour.

From the ever impressive Yering Station, this Chardonnay offers toasty barrel ferment characters, good supporting oak and ripe peach aromas leading to a textured and well rounded palate. One of the better value examples out there.

Sourced from regions throughout Australia, Midnight Collective Pinot Grigio is light and fresh with lifted tropical fruit and pear aromas that follow onto the palate leaving a crisp refreshing finish.

Late harvest styles of dessert wine are more versatile because they remain lighter than their Botrytis brothers. The Bethany shows some delicious sweetness with a lovely tingle of Riesling fruit acid.

Established in 1985, Cloudy Bay was one of the first five wine makers to venture into Marlborough. Sauvignon Blanc is the iconic wine behind the Cloudy Bay tale. It defined New Zealand's wine and established the Marlborough wine region globally. It is the unmistakable aromas, ripe fruit flavours and fine structure that makes Cloudy Bay synonymous with premium Sauvignon Blanc globally. It is a fresh, aromatic & vibrant wine.
The flavour is intense, concentrated & focused with mouthwatering acidity that gives textural intrigue to the palate. It is a hallmark expression of Marlborough

Take the palate on the journey around the world, with the Azurial collection of wines, Explore Italy with this crisp and refreshing Pinot Grigio. Aromas of pear and organge blossom wth a fresh and vibrant palate.

Sourced from viticultural regions of Australia, The Painter Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is crisp and fresh with hints of passionfruit and tropical fruit flavours leaving a juicy finish.. Enjoy now paired with grilled fish.

Early morning harvest in cool conditions to maximize freshness and aromatics. Stainless steel ferment and maturation to encourage this also. The ferment is arrested by chilling the ferment when the balance of sugar and acid reaches its peak.

Another cracker from the guys at Remarkable State Wines. Fruit was selected from both cool and warm climates to provide both a full fruit palate as well as zesty freshness. There's a fine bead, refreshing citrus characters and a crisp fruit driven finish. Its a smaller batch brut cuvee that's really a great all rounder, enjoy on its own or compliment with a mixed platter.

Piquette is a naturally lower in alcohol fruit wine; sustainably crafted by upcycling pressed grape skins. Our Piquette from Sauvignon Blanc is light, crisp and refreshing, with vibrant gooseberry complemented by tropical and zesty citrus flavours. Ideal for those lighter occasions - lunchtime, weekday dinners.

1987-planted Chardonnay vines, hand-picked and whole-bunch pressed straight to French barriques (15% new), matured for 9 months, the majority without stirring. A citrus driven nose with white nectarine & oatmeal. Super tangy palate with a great balance of acidity & flavour; Almond, white peach, & lemon curd.

100% estate grown, single vineyard fruit grown on predominantly silty grey, gravelly loam over sandstone with some clay loam patches. 100% certified biodynamic grapes are picked by hand and then the fruit is sorted by hand on a vibrating table. Tasmania’s ultra cool climate is perfect for making Riesling wines with finesse and distinction. Winemaking at Stefano Lubiana takes full advantage of the perfectly balanced pristine fruit from the naturally cultivated vineyard. Minimal handling and whole
Adelaide Hills vineyards were selected to accentuate the citrus and melon notes in the wine to match the natural acid and tropical flavours. A well credentialled wine that bursts with flavour.

Pale green in colour, with a nose of snow pea and blossom a palate of lemongrass, rock melon, fennel seed, white currant and lime. This is truly ethereal and lifted but with a taut structural savouriness showing vibrant energy and exquisite purity. Pairs perfectly with Rock cod, scallops, prosciutto or soft goats cheese.

Sourced from low yielding old vines from the rocky, bony soils around the Renwick township in Marlborough blended with biodynamically grown hillside fruit from the acclaimed Churton Vineyard. Delicious palate brimming with nectarine, fresh lime, and hints of ripe nectarine and gooseberry finishing with a lovely long feel of the stony soils and refreshing acidity.

The Zephyr MK III Sauvignon Blanc is designed to disrupt the norm and stretch conventional thinking within the nuance of Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. This wine is all about salted lime, unami, and mineral nuances.  An 'on the mark' match with blue cod, scallops, and prosciutto with soft goat's cheese.

Described as 'serious gear' for Chardonnay enthusiasts, Smith & Sheth hand select the best grapes from two exceptional Hawke's Bay vineyards to craft a wine full of character and almost Chablis-like that's as much style as substance.
Fresh and fruit driven, complex and light on its feet with vibrant acidity balanced by a creamy, lingering texture.
T’Gallant Light & Fresh Pinot Grigio is crisp and light in calories. A delicious lighter alternative for enjoyable moments with family & friends.

Farm Hand are Australia’s favourite Organic wines. Farmed by the Grigoriou family - fourth generation vignerons, from pristine 30 year old Organic vineyards located in the heart of South Australia. Farm Hand are proud partners of Carbon8, ensuring a great future for soil regeneration and sustainable agriculture

Located in the picturesque North Island of New Zealand, Te Mata produces a Chardonnay that has ripe stonefruit and citrus characters along with a rich and textural mouthfeel. Fermented in seasoned oak barrels to produce a creamy, rich and elegant wine.

Tread Softly is a contemporary range of wines that are naturally medium in weight and lower in alcohol. Tread Softly is dedicated to reducing its carbon footprint and chooses sustainable vineyard management and winemaking techniques to ensure its production has a minimal impact on the environment. For every case of Tread Softly sold, the brand proudly commits to planting an Australian native tree – to date, that is over 1.5 million trees.

Tread Softly is dedicated to reducing its carbon footprint and chooses sustainable vineyard management and winemaking techniques to ensure its production has a minimal impact on the environment. For every case of Tread Softly sold, the brand proudly commits to planting an Australian native tree – to date, that is over 1.5 million trees.

Produced from Gordo Blanco (otherwise known as Muscat of Alexandria) and Gewurtzraminer grapes grown on the Oatley family vineyards at Mudgee NSW, this is a typical lightly sparkling (or ‘spritzig’) wine that should be served young and fresh, well-chilled, as an aperitif or partner to fresh fruit desserts. Refreshingly spritzy, naturally effervescent, with lifted exotic aromas of rose, spicy pear and intense grape flavours, low alcohol and a hint of sweetness. Simply delicious, well chilled, with fruit salad – at any time of the day.
With the succulent aroma of fresh passionfruit and guava, our Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc is refined and delectable all the way to the full crisp citrus finish. Embrace the light.

Round Theory wines have been consciously crafted with a simple goal in mind - to make great wines that have a positive impact on the planet. Our vegan wines are sustainably grown and sourced, and our lightweight packaging reduces its environmental impact and we are climate positive and offset at least double the amount of carbon we use to ensure we not only taste good, but do good.

This Sauvignon Blanc is overflowing with tropical notes of guava and passionfruit, delivering crisp fresh flavours.

Round Theory wines have been consciously crafted with a simple goal in mind - to make great wines that have a positive impact on the planet. Our vegan wines are sustainably grown and sourced, and our lightweight packaging reduces its environmental impact and we are climate positive and offset at least double the amount of carbon we use to ensure we not only taste good, but do good. Notes of apple and pear shine through this Pinot Gris giving this wine a clean and lively palate.

Our Fiano is a modern Australian interpretation of this delicious Italian grape variety. Aromas of honeydew and white peach with hints of citrus blossom and kaffir lime. On the palate we taste an array of complex fruits from white peach and semi dried white nectarine, to white saffron pear and citrus with classic creamy texture that is Fiano. The wine finishes refreshingly dry and crisp. A great partner with salads, seafood, light poultry and a refreshing drink on its own.

The classic Margaret River blend. Pale green in colour, with aromas of succulent Sauvignon Blanc and grassy Semillon. The palate is flint-dry with an initial impact of sweet racy fruit and a fine and lengthy finish.

Some of the best Chardonnay in the country a sourced from the cool climate Adelaide Hills region. This crowd pleasing wine made by Ben Riggs shows classic stone fruit notes like peach and melon and these carry on through to the palate. It is bright and fresh with plenty of vitality.

The Serafino Sorrento Chardonnay is a crisp style of white wine, full of flavour and bustling with liveliness just like the Sorrento Township. This is the 1st release of the Serafino Sorrento Chardonnay, a wine that takes a modern twist with exciting new labelling and refreshing winemaking. Sorrento is one Italy’s most famous towns and one of Serafino (Steve) Maglieri’s favourite beaches. Perched on top of cliffs that separate the town from the busy marinas below, visitors to Sorrento enjoy the beach lifestyle, and a myriad of bustling bars around the colourful café-lined square. Food match: Fish and chips by the beach, Vegan Friendly.

Colour: Pale straw, lemon hues and green tinge.
Aromas: Orchard fruit, pears and apple blossom.
Palate: Full flavoured yet light bodied. A fine, dry, mineral palate with notes of white peach and citrus.

The palate is medium bodied with stone fruit and fresh citrus flavours and a light touch of French oak. Use of MLF on one parcel adds richness and roundness to the palate to ensure a more fruitful wine. The wine finishes smoothly with balanced acidity and lingering ripe fruit flavour.

Founded in 2001 Mr. Riggs wine co. is headed by iconic South Australian winemaker Ben Riggs, here we introduce Mr. Riggs first Sauvignon Blanc, Woodside.

The Adelaide Hills produces some of the best Sauvignon Blanc in Australia, the Woodside Sauvignon Blanc is no exception, crisp, bright and aromatic with tropical notes of passionfruit, melon and nashi pear.

To make this wine we stole grapes from our Hard Chard snatching them off the vine early to lock in their fresh crispness.A light bodied sparkling, clean and zesty style, with a crisp finish. A criminally easy wine to enjoy in many ways. Break out a bottle and celebrate with your gang!

Well, we made a cool wine, from one of the hottest and driest vintages, from one of Australia’s hottest wine regions. Pretty snazzy eh? Combine this with being dry grown, it gives us confidence our little region has a few more miles under the bonnet for the bumpy road of climate change ahead. 100% Chenin Blanc grown on Rocket’s Vineyard in Upper Swan. Soils are Houghton loam and the clones are Noack massale selection. The vines are planted at a density of 1540 vines per hectare. The grapes were picked on 16th and 22nd January 2020. Bottled on 11th November 2020 Alcohol 13%; RS 0.8g/L; pH 3.32; total Acidity 5.78g/L. The grapes were harvested by hand and whole bunch-pressed prior to natural fermentation. A portion was fermented and matured in seasoned French oak barriques for seven months prior to blending and bottling. The wine smells of lemon pith and nashi pear with a lick of carbide. The palate is lively with a briny spine, great clarity and stacks of flavour. – Rob and Gen Mann

A lovely off white, copper hue to the wine. Not quite rose, but a really appealing blush. The nose has mandarin peel, fennel and a touch of funk and wet earth. Palate is racy, with cumquat and dried flower notes. Finishes with a vanilla note, and a savoury, phenolic bite. There’s skinsy and bunchy notes throughout, but they are in harmony with the pristine fruit and energy of a white wine from this cool, humid year.

Native & Ancient explores the interaction between microbiology and human intervention, of man and nature, through a series of natural wines. The grapes for this wine are organically farmed Sauvignon Blanc sourced from Block 4 on the Isabel Estate Vineyard. The wine style, Pet Nat or Petillant Naturel translates to naturally sparkling and is achieved by bottling the wine while it is still fermenting. The wine is made in as natural a way as possible, harking back to ancient winemaking techniques, it is unfined and unfiltered with no added sulphites. A great way to kick off your weekend BBQ, refreshing, lightly sparkling, lots of ripe tropical fruit. A real fruit salad of flavours followed by a textural slightly biscuity finish. Delicious.

Inspired by style icons, starlets and celebrities, Dean & Monroe Icon Series features a show-stopping Moscato. A classic that represents the timeless glamour of Hollywood's elite and never goes out of style, this fresh and fun white is floral and perfumed with sweet, lush fruit and bright acidity.

Take a stroll through Franke's Garden...
Our Once & Well winemaker, Freya Hohnen, is often nicknamed 'Frankie' - and this collection explores the relationship between nature and witness grown by her hand.
With aromas of passionfruit, feijoa and lemon zest that flow into a palate of zingy lime sorbet and fresh nectarine. This is a fresh and lively wine, best enjoyed for those lazy afternoons in the sun's glow.

Luscious aromas of grapefruit and lemon zest with hints of orange blossom and green apple. Fresh and juicy with layers of citrus, white peach and ginger spice that cascades with rolling sea salt waves towards a textural, savoury and super fresh finish.

This fresh wine delivers plenty of lively fruit character and zippy acidity. It's a fan favorite for seafood, veggies, and small bites — a food-friendly crowd pleaser. This high-scoring wine delivers above its price point, a gem to share with family and friends.

product_name: Muscadet Sevre et Maine Sur Lie
product_description: The classic light dry white from near the mouth of the Loire river on the Atlantic coast of France.  The grapes are gently pressed and the young wine is allowed to sit on lees for 6 months to bring out that wonderful briney note fans of Muscadet so love.  It is bright, light yellow in color with green reflections. A fine and complex nose, expressive and aromatic. It develops notes of citrus, flowers and white-fleshed fruits. The attack is straightforward. The palate is elegant, mineral and aromatic. Citrus notes bring liveliness and freshness. The classic accompaniament is oysters, but just about any molluscs or crustaceans will do.

Crafted by the Calabria Family, Calabria BELENA, pays homage to the second generation; Bill & Lena, with a determined spirit, grace, and tenacity they worked harder through the tough times & prepare for the future generation - a true partnership.

Sweet aromas of honeyed apricot & citrus lemon that echo the palate to make this a refreshing Moscato.

The 2022 Springton Riesling is a blend of fruit picked from blocks 7,8 and 10. It is pale straw with banana and other tropical fruits on the nose. The palate is broad and subtly textural displaying stone fruits of nectarine and apricot with a long finish of lingering lime. An Eden Valley Riesling to drink now or lay down for years to come.

Precision, strength and freshness are words that form the signature of Brocard's winemaking philosophy. The domain is among the most important of Chablis. Brocard wines represent the higher end of expression at each level.
Their Chablis is 100% chardonnay, unoaked and fermented using natural yeast. Lemon, white peach and yellow fruit flavours, crisp and vibrant, pure and fresh make this a great match with grilled seafood.

This wine is made by the very skilled hands of Phil Lehmann. It shows as a pale gold with a green hue revealing cut peach and white pepper on the nose. There’s a lot going on once it hits the palate including citrus, grapefruit, nectarine and apricot. An elegant textural wine with a clean finish.

Lola Belle is the beautiful stranger who takes your breathaway. She's the essence of a sweet wine on a warm summer's eve, captured in a bottle. Full of exotic notes of guava and passionfruit, lightly spiced with musk and rose petal. Fragrant and fresh, with a zesty light fizz to finish.

Take a step back and unwind as time passes us turning seconds into minutes, minutes into hours; like sand trickle through an hourglass.
Deliciously light but filled with flavour at only 5% alcohol this wine exhibits aromas of crisp apple and pear, which lingers on the palate leaving a clean fresh finish.
The Hour Glass is perfect for long summer afternoons and the discovery of a fresh, light wine.

Ideally situated at the foot of the famous Roche de Solutré, in the hamlet of Pouilly, the Trouillet estate is currently run by William (4th generation).  The chardonnay fruit was hand-picked, gently pressed, then fermented in Burgundian oak to preserve freshness and finesse.  
The wine displays a fresh, open nose, the palate shows a good attack of vibrant flavour, with generosity and complexity important aspects of the signature.  Sourced from 50 year old vines, this wine exhibits all of the finesse expected of the grand white wines of Burgundy.

Ahoy-hoy! Alexander Graham Bell, the inventor of the humble telephone, demonstrated himself how the telephone worked to Queen Victoria in 1878.Queen Vic was just another Ordinary Monarch keeping on trend by learning a coming of age technology. Rediscover Moscato, fast becoming the 'it' drink for the new sassy Gen Z. This wine is the perfect introduction to this classic Italian light and delicate wine, it is fine and spritzy and pure joy on the palate.

Take a step back and unwind as time passes us turning seconds into minutes, minutes into hours; like sand trickle through an hourglass.
Deliciously light but filled with flavour at only 5% alcohol this wine exhibits aromas of florals and tropical fruit, which lingers on the palate leaving a crisp refreshing finish. The Hour Glass is perfect for long summer afternoons and the discovery of a fresh, light wine.

Latin for ‘lighten’, Allevio truly heroes the many simplicities of a great tasting wine. Vegan, gluten free, naturally lighter in alcohol and sustainably produced it has tropical fruit aromas and a soft minerality. It is perfect for complementing fresh salads rich with vegetables like artichokes, zucchini or green peas.

Savignin is the iconic white grape of the Côtes du Jura. The Domaine Rijckaert vineyards of Savagnin are located in Buvilly, a blessed terroir for great white wines. The blend was made with the aim of highlighting  the amazing complexity of this unique variety!  At once expressive, rich and refreshing. This rustic grape variety is both powerfull and fine, and when carefuly vinified, it expresses an unrivalled complexity.  2018 was a brilliant vintage, perfectly ripe, exceptionally balanced and with abundant energy.

From one of Languedoc's most energetic producers, Moulin de Gassac,  comes a crisp and vivacious picpoul de pinet.  A real crowd pleaser with floral aromatics, green melon and citrus flavours, finishing clean, brisk and zesty. One to get your taste buds going, and perfect with shellfish.

Intriguingly fragrant, with exotic aromas of crystallised Ginger, crushed Cardamom Pod, Quine and Allspice. The palate is bright and dry on entry, opening to pleasingly textural mid palate of Quince, freshly cut red apple and spiced pears before slowly fading to a clean, refreshing finish.

Velarino means "curtain" in Italian. Every theatre has one, and often it's a work of art. Opening the curtain can be likened to uncorking a bottle of  good wine. This is when the show begins! 
The Velarino Vermentino from Sicily will have you applauding as it entertains you with its fruity aromas and flavours of white peach, apricot and apple, not to mention the finale of crisp, delicious refreshment.
Take a bow, Velarino!

Barone Montalto is a crisp and delicious Sicilian pinot grigio, grown at 500 metres on the north-east facing slopes of the Belice Valley. This exotic example of Pinot Grigio has a straw to pale gold colour. On the nose, fresh and clean fruity notes of pear, green apple and white peaches. The palate is true to the nose with a fresh acidity, coriander and lime notes followed by a crisp finish. Drink with shellfish or risotto.

Produced in a truly Mediterranean climate on the south west corner of the beautiful island of Sardinia. From the esteemed house of Cantina Mesa comes a Vermentino of quality, vibrancy and intensity, singing of fruit blossom and a salad bowl of orchard fruit. A mediterranean herbal note, a touch of minerality and a refreshing hint of salinity add great complexity and refreshment. Finishing crisply, this would play an excellent supporting role to your next seafood meal.

Since 1858, Stonyfell has been synonymous with creating acclaimed Australian wines. Our celebrated winemakers continue the Stonyfell tradition and legacy with the 2020 Unwooded Chardonnay. Tropical fresh fruit aromas envelope the nose and lead to zesty, lively flavours on the palate. This unwooded Chardonnay shows beautiful length with fine acidity and a subtle creaminess.

Reserve Bin A Chardonnay has evolved into a wine that is now a distinctive, single-region style in its own right, with a contemporary and expressive Adelaide Hills chardonnay persona. Soaring and intense white peach fruits and defined natural acidity are well complimented by an interwoven nuttiness and heightened leesy texture. An expansive palate that grows, propelled by persistent flavours and textural integrity.
Peak drinking: Now - 2030

A crisp, stylish pinot grigio from the Della Venezie DOC in Veneto.  The wine shows straw yellow with copper reflections. Aromas of fresh apple and exotic fruit lead to pleasant and lively flavours, with clear fruity hints.  Excellent when served with fish-based hors d’oeuvres, shellfish, fried fish, soups, boiled meat and chicken.

Novum use small parcels of fruit from specially selected sites on established Marlborough vineyards to craft the best wines and expressions of terroir possible. Novum’s primary focus is on Syrah, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

Brookland Valley Margaret River Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is a great style to serve well chilled on a warm day. Lively aromas of lime, snow-pea and lemongrass are appealing and the palate brims with tropical fruit and citrus flavours.

Scotchmans Hills Chardonnay shows all the classical cool-climate melony varietal characters which are are perfectly integrated with light oak and restrained malo-lactic influence. Drinking beautifully now try it with rich seafood dishes.

This beautiful full-bodied round & rich with toasty flavours to savour & enjoy. This Chardonnay is silky & smooth, with rich notes of butter & toasty vanilla, and perfectly balanced with flavours of baked apple pie. Pair with creamy pasta carbonara or herb-roast chicken and vegetables.

Stylish bottle, stylish wine. The great Spanish house of Freixenet have extended their winemaking prowess into Italy. Their 150 years of experience are obvious in this elegant white wine made with the finest grapes from the picturesque Garda region in northern Italy.  This fine Pinot Grigio is packed full of fruity and floral flavours. You will also note subtle hints of citrus, making it a well-balanced wine, perfect to drink on it's own on a hot summer’s day.  Just as easily, you can pair this with a fresh salad or a platter of seafood.

Launched in 1998 with the 1995 vintage, Yattarna is the result of one of the most comprehensive, focused and highly publicised wine development projects ever conducted in Australia. The aspiration and independence of mind across generations of Penfolds winemakers inspired the ambition to create a white wine that would set the standard for ultra-fine Australian chardonnay. Selectively sourcing only the very best chardonnay fruit from cool-climate regions, coupled with clever winemaking, the style continues to evolve. Yattarna reflects Penfolds patience and continued commitment to its original goal, its very name being drawn from local indigenous language, meaning ‘little by little, gradually’. Each vintage provides the opportunity to further raise the quality bar.

Enjoy this premium quality Organic Sauvignon Blanc from Hawkes Bay, with a lemon tinted hue and fresh, vibrant aromas. Enjoy the burst of tropical fruit flavours, and a hint of lemon and lime zest on a crisp, mineral finish.

The Marlborough Sounds are a network of sea drowned valleys at the top of New Zealand’s South Island. This Organic Sauvignon Blanc is a pure expression of the pristine marine environment which inspires its name. Fresh floral and citrus aromas lead to swirls of tropical fruit flavours, balanced by crisp minerality and zesty acidity. Nature has crafted its finest work.

Like the Paradox of life, an infinite mystery, this wine is like no other. This Semillon Sauvignon Blanc is lighter in alcohol at only 8% and full of flavour. A crisp wine exhibiting fresh tropical fruits that develop onto the palate leaving a vibrant and zesty finish.

Like the Paradox of life, an infinite mystery, this wine is like no other. This Chardonnay is lighter in alcohol at only 8% and full of flavour. Displaying fresh peach and melon aromas, which are balanced with a hint of oak.

This Cote des Roses Sauvignon Blanc cuvée celebrates the Mediterranean Art of Living. The soil, very varied, consists essentially of hard limestone from the garrigues, schist soils but also gravels brought by the rivers and streams of Languedoc. The warm, windy climate (“semi-arid Mediterranean climate with mild winter variation”) favors the ripening of the grapes and their healthy condition, while retaining freshness thanks to the altitude and the effect of the sea, which mitigates high summer temperatures.
This cuvée boasts a lovely yellow colour with golden tints. It is fresh and intense on the nose, revealing aromas of citrus and exotic fruits, flowers, and a few notes of candy, pear, and pineapple. The fresh, flavorsome palate is lively, precise and pure thanks to the clear mineral backdrop and a certain opulence.
A perfectly balanced wine with elegance and concentration. Tropical fruits define the palate with complementary flavours of crème brulé, lemon pie, crisp pear and lemon blossom.

A sister wine to the riotously popular Lulu rosé. The wine is inspired by the ideals of relaxation, of holidays and fun. It's packed with floral and fruity aromas from the rapidly trending vermentino grape. Bright lemon in the glass, the palate is dry and refreshing and displays floral notes, fresh peach, citrus and green apple. The wine is rounded, with an ample acidity on the lingering finish. Chill a bottle, pour a glass, then relax.

product_name: Pietrariccia Surani Fiano Del Salento IGT
product_description: The vineyards that produce this delightful Fiano are located in Manduria, a region of Salento in Apulia, Southern Italy. An evocative wine showing straw yellow colours with gold hues, a warm, and an inviting nose with elegant hints of elder flowers and citrus fruit. It's medium-bodied with a well balanced acidity giving freshness on the palate. Perfectly suits fresh pasta dishes such as “spaghetti allo scoglio” or “linguine alle vongole” or with seafood and shellfish. .

Monte dei Cocci Fiano Minutolo is the result of traditional winemaking with a modern approach. The fruit is from the heart of Itria Valley in Puglia, grown at 450 metres.
The Fiano Minutolo grape is highly aromatic and the wine produced displays flavours and aromas of flowers and sweet herbs with fresh yellow fruit.
Highly enjoyable as an aperitive, and perfect with light dishes.

The wine displays a light yellow colour. The nose is fresh with notes of lemon, quince and creamy barrel fermentation characters. The palate is full-flavoured with spicy lemon and subtle oak characters. Fresh lively acidity balances the fullness of flavour and creates a long and lingering finish.

Vincent’s Breeze wines take their name from a picturesque stretch of water found between the Fleurieu and Yorke peninsula in South Australia known as the Gulf St Vincent. These wines were created by blending a number of separate vineyard parcels with the aim of balancing the strengths of each.
Honeydew and brown lime flavours intertwine with a smooth and creamy mid palate. Fine natural acidity give great length and balances the textural oak characters.

100% pinot gris grapes come from different areas located in the south of France: vineyards which are under Mediterranean influence and whose clay and limestone soils bring aromatic richness to the wine, and cooler vineyards in the Aude Valley whose grapes lend finesse and freshness.
A floral and fruity nose (lychee, vineyard peach, lemon and grapefruit) that meld with a touch of white pepper and ginger. Round and refreshing on the palate.

product_name: Orenji Project McLaren Vale White Blend
product_description:
A vibrant addition to the 'new wave' wine landscape that is right on point and a must try!
Super fresh and bursting with energy and zip, expect aromas of ginger, rose petals, orange zest and mandarin. The palate is equally bright and enjoyable with multiple layers of flavour along the same spectrum and supported by beautiful texture. Refreshing and difficult to resist.

Family owned Villa Maria Estate has been rated as New Zealand's Most Trusted Wine Brand in Reader's Digest poll 2016. This Sauvignon Blanc is sourced from premium sites in the Wairau and Awatere Valleys and it displays the zesty intense fruit qualities that makes Sauvignon Blanc so appealing.

The Yalumba Y Series Pinot Grigio is vegan friendly. The aromatics of the wine open with nashi pear, baked apple and orange blossom and finish with wild honey and feijoa. The palate is a succulent mix of the baked apple and feijoa with a fresh cream and poached pear mid palate, and a tight cinnamon and oatmeal finish. Lingering orange panna cotta completes the wine.
Jacob's Creek does it again with a Chardonnay with attractive melon and fresh fruit flavours complemented by subtle toasty oak that are all hallmarks of this fresh crisp variety.
This label offers classic Marlborough character at a terrific price. Aromas of passionfruit and gooseberry are followed by refreshing citrus and stone fruit flavours with a fresh, crisp finish.
This Australian dry white wine has fresh, tropical fruit aromas with hints of lemon and citrus. Delicate flavours of tropical and stone fruits leave a fresh clean finish on the palate.

With a history dating back to 1878, the Pike family has a past rich in brewing and winemaking. Current custodians, Neil & Andrew form a formidable partnership creating wines that express terroir magnificently. One of their icon wines, the 'Traditionale' Riesling manages to capture the essence of Clare Valley year after year.
This Pinot Grigio, sourced from premium Australian wine regions ,shows pears and citrus characters, balanced with good length and textual softness with a fresh, crisp finish.

Shaw & Smith is a benchmark Sauvignon Blanc. This release shows ripe tropical characters with restrained grassy notes and crisp dry acidity. Delightfully fresh lively and flavoursome. Always a classic and always quick to disappear off the shelves.
A delicate wine with dry, crisp fruit, supported by delicate acid. Perfect for parties, catering and cooking. Once opened it will last for months.

The Parson range is our invitation to discover the balance and purity we strive for in every bottle of Chapel Hill. Driven by an understanding that great wine is made in the vineyard, each wine is carefully crafted to highlight the delicious varietal characteristics of these extraordinary grape varieties. This is a drier Pinot Grigio with flavours of green pear and mandarin peel.

Introducing Whisper Rock, inspired by New Zealand's breathtaking and rocky landscapes. Embrace the magic of Whisper Rock, and let its whispered enchantment guide you on a wine experience like no other. This Sauvignon Blanc reveals tropical and grassy aromas with fresh fruit and citrus flavours. On the palate a crisp and zesty acidity.

Vavasour Sauvignon Blanc is a meticulously made wine with grapes selected for intensity and concentration. The bouquet shows passionfruit and white peach aromas and the palate has ripe fruit flavours with mineral notes. Always one of our favourites.
The Cat Amongst the Pigeons Chardonnay has a white peach, nectarine and melon fruit taste with a subtle oak, crisp acid line.

Since 1885, FAMILLE Bougrier masters the Art of Fine wines with the same passion and aim: offering the best expression of the French terroirs, and keeping the highest respect for land and people.  Renowned for the high quality of their wines, here they have produced an impressive chardonnay with characteristic yellow colour, with a nuance of  gold. Its subtle nose will remind of you some fresh butter, nuts and roasted almonds. Its palate is fully bodied and fruity with a pleasant roundness.

Lean and beautifully balanced, this Chablis from Simonnet-Febvre has flavours of lemon, peach, river stones. Steely acidity cleans the palate nicely and is just so food-friendly, it is a must have for your best fish dishes. Quite easily one of the best value Chardonnays in the Dan Murphy's range!
With lively lifted aromas of tropical fruits and fruit tingle, this is a tight and crisp wine with fresh fruit sweetness and a touch of spritz, with a clean refreshing lingering finish.
Pale yellow with a green hue, this is a wine iof great length with aromas of grapefruit, peach, citrus, wet stone and flint with white fruit, citrus curd, and fine French oak flavours.

Riesling is the signature variety of the Clare Valley, and the 2022 vintage is considered one of the best for many, many years. Riesling of this calibre promises unparalleled refreshment when first released, then develops over time to reveal a rare complexity both in aromatics and exhilarating palate. This 2022 Riesling is undeniably an elite showcase of why the region is intrinsically associated with the most noble of white varieties.

This Chardonnay features aromatic expressions of stone fruit and apple, with a hint of herb and mineral characters. Medium bodied, flavours of honeysuckle and white nectarine support a creamy mouthfeel and lingering finish.

Chardonnay is all about balance, whether it be big robust flavours or tightly wound minerality - everything should exist together in balance.

While this Chardonnay is not for the faint hearted - it’s a full flavoured, buttery chardonnay, packed full of bold fully ripened stone and tropical fruit flavours, balanced by beautiful oak and delicate acidity.

Everything here is in balance, showcasing the full range of what Chardonnay can offer when it’s made well and with care.

Golden yellow straw colour, with yellow hue, the wine displays honeysuckle, stone fruit, apple blossom and spice on the nose with a palate loaded with plush clingstone peach, baked apple, and fig up front.

These primary characters merge with deeper notes of creamy cashew, oatmeal, pie crust and rich honey all entwined on a line of lemon acidity, culminating with a dry finish of tangerine pithy appeal.

Flavoursome and fine finish with crisp lines of cleansing acid. Excalibur Sauvignon Blanc is an exciting, fresh, food-friendly white wine. Although a great food wine, especially seafood, at Zonte’s Footstep, we drink most of the Excalibur well-chilled, on a sunny afternoon with friends and family... usually followed by a second glass!
A fresh and zesty Sauvignon Blanc, bursting with juicy ripe flavours of gooseberry, guava and lime. The mouthwatering finish leaves you wanting more.
This shows in the final wine with great depth of flavour throughout the palate with well balanced acidity leaving you wanting more.
A well balanced medium bodied Chardonnay showing bright stone fruit, rockmelon and butterscotch on the nose. Succulent fruit forward flavours and creamy texture lead on to a silky finish.

Concentrated and fine with a creamy texture. The vibrant
acidity provides excellent structure and balance to the creamy juicy
mid palate.
Honeydew and brown lime flavours intertwine with a smooth and creamy mid palate. Fine natural acidity give great length and balances the textural oak characters.
The palate has a soft, yet delicate structure with typical varietal flavours of nashi pear and lychee. The wine has a delightful creaminess but finishes dry with beautifully balanced acidity
This wine was fermented then matured in older French oak barrels for 10 months. It is a light and crisp style with flavours of apple, pear and a hint of rose petal.

This wine is a rich concentrated Pinot gris with lovely balance. Floral and youthfully aromatic, the nose shows nashi pear, royal gala apple and hints of baking spice. Fractionally off-dry to taste, the palate is textured and expressive, showing abundant fruits and spice. Long and lush with a lively acid line, the finish is moreish and mouthwatering.
Clean and bright aromas; fleeting touches of passionfruit lead into a palate with very good thrust, flavour and length before faltering slightly on the finish.

Produced by an iconic critically acclaimed winery, this modern styled Chardonnay is complex and elegant, richly weigted with layers of fruit, yet restrained by tight vanilla oak and a crisp finish.

This is a stuning, delicious Chardonnay that will last for a long time, but is drinking well now and is a perfect match for shellfish pasta.

Eden Valley rieslings tend to be a little more delicate and floral compared to the more zingy style founc in Clare Valley.

This Riesling is no exception - bursting with mandarin, lemon, lime lychee, white flower floral and fennel flavours making this Riesling an absolutely perfect accompaniment to shellfish and spicy Asian dishes.

Wow - this is quite simply a stunning Chardonnay and without a doubt the best we tasted during the year for the Under Wraps program - it has everything you’d want in a Chardonnay, a lovely acid line, flavours of citrus, stone fruit meshed hazelnut and nougat. THis is a magnificent example of Margaret River Chardonnay.

From the Pewsey Vale sub-region of Eden Valley,  this Single Vineyard Riesling if a clear and complex expression of the varietal.
Expect citrus peel and lime flavours, with lively acidity and soft minerality - an elegant and pure wine.

We left our cosy home to spread our wings and explore theworld. We were never afraid of running bare foot or swimming in the deep end why should we be afraid of Flying Wild? These wines inspire fabulous ideas and fabulous ideas inspired these wines. These easy drinking medium-bodied wines should always be enjoyed in good company. Bright pale straw with green flecks. Fresh flavours of lemon zest and passionfruit on the palate. This wine has a crisp and crunchy acidity and is ready to enjoy now.

The grape growing region of Frankland River known for producing premium quality fruit unique for Western Australian conditions and when combined with the red jarrah gravel loam soils it leads to wines of great intensity. Wait till you try this Chardonnay!

Plucked form the renowned Watervale sub-region of Clare Valley this is a marvellous example of top quality Riesling from the excellent 2022 vintage.

Gorgeous flavours of grapefruit, juicy lime combine with slatey minerality and intense, focused acidity make this single vineyard cracker perfect for drinking now or cellaring and enjoing for decades.

Crafted in the Mornington Peninsula, this highly regarded 2019 Chardonnay expresses notes of stone & summer fruits - think cantaloupe, fresh fig & nectarine. Delightfully textured - a beautifully balanced, cool climate Chardonnay.
A crisp, medium dry, tropical fruit-driven white from our vineyard in East Gresford, Hunter Valley. This wine is a crowd pleaser and your go-to food wine.
Such a crowd pleaser with its light sparkle, zesty aromatic and tropical fruit flavours. Crisp with soft bubbles, it's a firm favourite.
Reflecting the vineyard's terroir this classic Hunter Valley Chardonnay is fruit driven with subtle oak. Did someone say lunch?

This wine is crafted with meticulous care, selecting 20-year-old
vines of Chardonnay from the West Pigeon Vineyard. On the palate, it offers a refreshing and clean entry with balanced acidity.It exhibits aromas of sweet melon, grapefruit, and hints of creamy and toasty notes.

Chardonnay is an adaptable grape variety that can show very
diverse styles. As the only white grape variety allowed to make top quality Burgundy white wines, it is one of the very best media that can truly reflect its terroir. And N28 Chardonnay is another testament of Xige Estate challenging the ultimate expression of the Region’s terroir.
This Chardonnay has been fermented and aged in oak barrels for 12 months. It combines both floral and ripe tropical fruits aromas, with a smooth creamy texture, a beautiful refreshing acidity that makes it very pleasant and easy to drink, ending up with a very long finish.

Crafted by winemaker and viticulturalist James-Paul Marin utilising minimal input and sustainable viticulture. An approachable Sauvignon Blanc, light and refreshing demonstrating tropical fruit salad flavours rather than grassy notes. The distinct citrus fruits; lemon and lime, add a refreshing finish to this lovely, bright, fruit packed expression of the Adelaide Hills and is vegan friendly.

Aromatics of lemongrass and herbal notes, fermented on skins for textural complexity, with a bright, fresh and balanced palate of juicy tropical fruits.
Sourced from a premium Hunter Valley vineyard with 75% of fruit fermented on skins.
This wine is textural, fruit forward which has the perfect amount of balance on the palate; a more complex style of Semillon!

Floral and citrus blossom aromas with a full-bodied and vibrant palate. Layers of stone fruit, citrus and juicy tropical fruits with a delicate hint of soft pear.
Delightfully fragrant and elegant on the nose with a juicy & fruity palate.

Aromas of candied citrus and tropical fruits with crisp apples on the palate. A balance of acidity and sweetness with a refreshing finish.
A delicate sweetness on the front palate with a rounded and crisp finish. Premium Hunter Semillon with a stylish twist.

Creamy layers of stone fruit with silky undertones. An elegant and modern style with a seamless and textured finish.
Sourced from Oakey Creek Road vineyard, this is the perfect modern Chardonnay that will age nicely for another 10 years.

product_name: Springs South West Semillion Sauvignon Blanc 2023
product_description:
The 2023 ‘Henty Springs’ SSB was picked at the optimum maturation for both the Semillon and the Sauvignon Blanc, and was co-fermented to produce a very clean, fresh and fruit driven wine that shows good varietal characteristics of both varieties. The wine has a nose of aromatic tropical stone fruit, guava and pineapple, with a clean citrus acidity, cut grass and green pea on the palate and is a balanced wine with a tangy finish.
13.5% Alc/Vol. 750ml Approx.
8 Standard Drinks.

Next Destination is a one of a kind premium non-alcoholic wine range bringing the cellar door experience of iconic Australian wine destinations to your home. The Next Destination 2018 McLaren Vale Chardonnay started as a premium alcoholicChardonnay, selected for its exceptional vintage and varietal. The alcohol has then been expertly removed resulting in an unmatched true to taste flavour.Produced from premium McLaren Vale this exceptional chardonnay is delicate with a dry profile,buttery mouthfeel and oak tannins. This wine is also vegan friendly, low in sugar and low in calories.

The alcohol has then been expertly removed resulting in an unmatched true to taste flavour. This non-alcoholic sparklingwine boastsa dry profile, aromas of lemon curd andcitrus and a crisp palate with flavours of toastedbrioche, fresh blossom and green apple. It is also vegan, low in sugar and low in calories.

Crafted by a boutique family-owned winery in South Australia, 1920 Winesare inspired by the year made famous by the introduction of Prohibition. Made from premium grapes harvested in the cool of the night for the most robust flavour profile, this non-alcoholic sauvignon blanc has a dry profile and exhibits all of the classic characteristics you would expect from this traditional white wine, which has notes of tropical fruit salad and an elegant palate of mango and passionfruit. This has a well balanced, full-bodied mouthfeel. Vegan friendly and contains just 2.7g of sugar per 100mls.

Inspired by the year made famous by the introduction of Prohibition (the constitutional ban of alcoholic beverages from 1920 to 1933). This Australian-made non-alcoholic Pinot Grigio has been crafted with traditional winemaking techniques and a unique de-alcoholisation process ensuring the finished wine retains the classic flavours and mouthfeel of this traditional Italian style wine. With a dry, robust flavour profile and notes of nashi pear, apple, and lemon, the 1920 Pinot Grigio is perfectly balanced with a long, satisfying finish. It is also low in calorie, contains just 2.7g sugar per 100mls and is vegan friendly.

A layered & thought-provoking blend inspired by the Rhône Valley. The underlying rich medley of fresh & roasted stone fruit is laced with toast and spice, with a crisp zesty hit of ginger on the lingering finish. A sophisticated wine ready to drink now with the ability to age well.

product_name: Vine To Wine Nagambie Lakes Arinto 2021
product_description: Straw yellow in colour. Subtle aromas of lime and stone fruit, with complex secondary winemaking artifact notes of breoche. The palate is well balanced and is surprisingly full bodied with a round viscous mid-palate. There is a fine and complex texturered phenolic structure. The rich palate finishes with a green apple freshness. A complex and interesting wine.

Lovely Salmon pink in colour, with layered aromas of blueberry, strawberry, and cream. Vibrant and appealing fresh soft red berry fruits. The red berry notes develop intensity on the palate, with the wine being a lovely medium bodied rose. The structure is soft with a lovely fruit sweetness on an extended clean and crisp finish.

product_name: Gabriella Possum Ancestral Method Nagambie Riesling 2021
product_description: This wine has been fermented in this bottle and is therefore turbid in nature as it includes the yeast lees. The wine should be gently mixed prior to serving cold to homogenise these lees through the bottle. Complex aromas of tropical fruits, and the savoury brioche notes of yeast autolysis. The wine is very light in body, a fine mousse, and complex champagne like savoury flavours on the finish. This preservative free wine should be enjoyed youthful and fresh.

product_name: Vine To Wine Mornington Peninsula Sauvignon Blanc 2020
product_description: Pale straw in colour with a slight golden tinge. An enticing nose of yellow nectarine, guava, jasmine and pineapple rind are on show with subtle background aromatic oak influence. With time in the glass, the wine opens up to reveal fleshy flavours of yellow nectarine, guava and rambutan wrapped around a bright acid backbone. Concentrated and complex, the persistent finish leaves lingering notes of fresh orchard fruit and balanced savoury oak.

product_name: Vine To Wine Yarra Valley Chardonnay 2020
product_description: Pale straw in colour with green hues. Complex and enticing aromas of preserved citrus, white fleshed stone fruit, spice, fresh picked nuts and oak all leap from the glass. The palate has a depth and volume of fruit that builds in intensity as it travels across the mid-palate. The fine acid and textural elements of the barrel fermentation interweave with the fruit to balance and complete the wine.

The wine is pale straw in colour with a green tinge looking youthful and fresh, this wine shows classic Yarra Valley regional and varietal aromas of white peach, with subtle elegant French oak interweaved with subtle complex yeast notes. The palate is a sophisticated medium body Chardonnay being a true reflection of the cooler 2020 vintage. There is a fresh but delicate clean acid line, integrated with savour secondary winemaking attributes of oak and yeast autolysis. The wine has a clean extended finish.
Vibrant yellow hues with subtle rose and lime aromas. Crisp citrus and lime juice palate with a firm acid finish.
Clean vibrant straw yellow with rich fruit salad and nectarine aromas. Crisp sweet melon and green apple flavours.

This wine displays the depth and balance for which this variety has developed a cult wine personality following. On the nose it displays aromas of guava, citrus and subtle marjoram spice. Wrapping around a core of chalky minerality are flavours of nectarine, citrus, melon and hazelnuts. Bringing it all together is a bitter almond character that complements the savoury and textured finish. Drink now or be rewarded with cellaring for up to 10 years.

Using Yamada Nishiki from Kyushu, with a sweet and gentle taste, asharp drink that brings it all together.
The sweet, dark, and strong flavor is goes very well with food, it overturns the concept that tanrei dry is delicious.
Polished Yamada Nishiki to 55% and slowly created the ginjozukuri. Enjoy the soft sweetness and refreshing aroma of the sake.

This parcel was carefully selected by winemaker Nick Badrice. True to its name, Nick describes this wine as 'the ultimate Barossa Grenache'. It offers berries, spice and wild raspberry notes with velvety tannins on the lingering finish.

Chris Ringland is one of the most admired and talented winemakers on the planet, but these days, he calls the Barossa Valley home, knowing it like the back of his hand. He has sourced top-notch Shiraz from the vineyards in the northwest of the Valley for this richly flavoured, finely balanced wine. Look for blackberries, plum pudding and dark chocolate. More flavour in this half-bottle than in most twice the size.

Bright and clean, cherry-red coloured with middle robe. Creamy notes of black fruit are combined with spicy aromas and slight toasting. All this wrapped by high-quality ripe tannins that display their elegant structure.

Rich and flavoursome the Cutlass shows thick cuts of red berry and juicy dark plum with some whole bunch derived perfume and spice. The palate is long and persistent with complex fruit flavours overlaid with fresh toasty French Oak.
The palate is awash with red fruits, notably cherry, raspberry, & red currant followed by blueberry with crunchy acidity and smooth, fine tannins on the finish. Drink now to 2028.

Taken from the pristine terra rossa over limestone soils in Wrattonbully, this Cabernet Malbec blend shows the trademark bright fruit and deep flavours associated with the region. The cool air flow and long sunshine hours in this area provides extended ripening and hence complexity. It's bright and fresh aromas are matched by a rich interior which shows wonderful fruit expression. Unlike the average son, ‘Favourite Son’ will repay over the years showing great potential for cellaring.
winery: Keeda Zilm - James Lienert - Andrew Hardy

product_description: Irresistibly delicate, this Pinot Noir is lighter in alcohol and full of flavour. Displaying notes of fresh red berry fruits that develop onto the palate leaving a clean finish.

Located on the southeastern shore of Lake Wakatipu, the Remarkables mountain range lives up to its name by rising sharply to create an impressive backdrop for the surrounding waters. This finely textured wine lives up to its namesake. A perfumed, dry-style Rose with enticing red berry aromas. On the palate, sweet and savoury are juxtaposed with fruit weight carrying length and flavour. Juicy acidity brightens the smooth, creamy finish.

Balthazar was the last of the Babylonian kings whose empire ended after he drank from a mythical sacred chalice. A fascination with ancient history and an appreciation of the deep sense of irony that befalls those who choose their drinks - and drinking vessels - unwisely, prompted the name. Concentrated and generous blackberry, dark cherry, plum & dark chocolate flavours balanced by velvety tannins and savoury oak complexity delivering texture and structure on the long, persisting palate.

One word - legend. Jack Mann served Houghton for a remarkable 51 consecutive vintages. His determination to create wines of intensity, elegance and regional character have inspired a generation of Australian winemakers to achieve great things. Simply one of this country's greatest Cabernets, this wine is not just single vineyard fruit, the selection process is so rigorous that often it is just a few rows from the Justin Vineyard. Such is the reverence for that great man - Jack Mann.

Margaret River icons, Leeuwin Estate, have produced a wine of true class here. A great finish to the vintage shows up here with aromas of cassis, redcurrant and chocolate. Sweet ripe fruit on the palate is well matched with toasty French oak and fine tannin.
This is an Estate wine made in a drink-now style, yet it is elegant and true to variety. A luscious shiraz that over-delivers and can be relied on to reward.

Yering Station Yarra Pinot Noir is a classic Pinot Noir with red/black cherry complimented with brooding earthy undertones and subtle savoury spice on the nose. The palate hints of violets and lavender. Rich black cherry spice surrounded by vanillin oak. Lovely middle palate concentration supported by fine velvet like tannins.

Grange is arguably Australia’s most celebrated wine and is officially listed as a Heritage Icon of South Australia. Grange boasts an unbroken line of vintages from the experimental 1951 and clearly demonstrates the synergy between Shiraz and the soils and climates of South Australia.

Penfolds Grange utilises fully-ripe, intensely-flavoured and textured Shiraz grapes. The result is a unique Australian style that is now recognised as one of the most consistent of the world’s great wines.

The Grange style is the original and most powerful expression of Penfolds multi-vineyard, multi-district, blending philosophy. At once Grange – formic, assertive, powerful with overt barrel-ferment markers. Bright, and noticeably fragrant/perfumed at this time of tasting. Racy red fruits clasp onto red liquorice, aniseed aromatics. Red meats with pepper and spice, rumtopf. Patiently, panforte/mascarpone/malt/dried fig aromatics appear in a second wave. Captivating, tempting, alluring – yet another subtle variation on the theme/expression of this thing called Grange. Voluptuous and generous, yet poised and harmonious. Assured, and not attempting to overstate its weight/extract/presence. Immediately apparent flavours of chocolate, mocha, cola and juicy plum entwine and converge toward the panforte impression aromatically sensed earlier.

Tight and defined, with excellent grip – savoury/tannic. These tannins are both integrated and balanced, colluding with 100% new oak that is all but completely absorbed.

Crimson red in colour. An alluring bouquet of wild fennel, boysenberry and rose petals, surrounded in subtle notes of smoky oak. A generous palate with loads of boysenberry, chocolate and plum cake. The wine has a silky texture and finishes with velvet-like tannins, making it a delight to drink.

product_name: Silence is Golden Barossa Valley Shiraz
product_description: Small parcels of Old Vine fruit were hand-crafted from the western Barossa Valley to create our trademark voluptuous, opulent yet refined Silence is Golden. The low yielding vintage produced perfect fruit with a great level of fruit intensity. Highly concentrated pure wine featuring alluring flavours of blackberry, plum, olive and chocolate. There are tannins as smooth as velvet with the slightest touch of acidity and wonderfully integrated oak ensuring great intensity, length and cellaring potential.
Casillero Del Diablo Shiraz is round and mouthfilling with ample soft and sweet tannins, finishing with lively acidity to balance the intense range of flavours.
Casillero Del Diablo Cabernet Sauvignon is medium bodied with silky tannins and long ripe fruit and berry aftertaste, with impressive balance of fruit and polished tannins.

Don’t miss this rare chance to secure a magnificent wine from a top producer that’s in seriously short supply. Made by an acclaimed winemaker at the top of their game, this is a slice of wine history you don’t want to miss. Add it to your collection while you can.

A big burst of black/ blue spiced fruits on the nose, with complex flavors of black cherry and sarsaparilla spice on the palate wrapped around a firm tannin backbone that is the hallmark of the Shiraz grown at this family owned vineyard.

Compelling and convincing, with florals, currants and blackberries, not too sweet; it has a savoury edge, with the oak seamlessly integrated. Perfectly ripe tannins with poise and presence ensure that this is lovely now, but will be more so in years to come.

The 2017 Vintage in the Vale was preceded by generous winter and spring rains with a dry & warm Summer and Autumn. This allowed even ripening & the development of vibrant varietal characters. This Single Vineyard Shiraz shows layered dark fruits, with savoury & herbal notes. The palate is soft & rich with mouth filling plum & spice, finishing with silky tannins. This wine was made by Michael Fragos of Chapel Hill.

A typically elegant regional style from Petaluma. Claret-like in structure, with enhancements of shiraz spice and regional mintiness, the wine is medium to full-bodied with layers of complexity. Black currants, dark cherries, choc/mocha, light grained tannins, earth, spice and a savoury dried herb powder edge are all flavours that resolve perfectly into a graceful and persistent experience. A meaty dimension has been added during its 6 years in our cellar, making it ideal with roast red meat. The wine is a delight to drink now and will hold well for at least 3 years.
Rich and vibrant Clare Valley Shiraz bursting with red currants, plum, and blackberries. Undercurrent of dark chocolate, aniseed and mint.

This classic Shiraz with a deep red hue and aromas of dark berries, cinnamon and spice notes envelopes the palate with rich plum and red currant fruits. Subtle spicy oak notes round out the flavour, for a smooth long finish and silky tannins.

Trains played a key role in early South Australian history. McLaren Vale was a central stop for passengers on their journey between Melbourne and Adelaide before highways rendered the railways unnecessary. Now, these 'ghost rail lines' are all that's left of the bustling intercity connection; a testament to times past when trains ruled. The rolling stock that sits idle are all that's left; a Train to Nowhere. This Shiraz is a tribute to those trains that carried passengers faithfully between cities. It displays sweet blackberry and Christmas cake aromas, with a full palate of dark fruit and dashes of cinnamon and spice.

William Bulling was the first to stumble upon gold in the McIvor-Heathcote area. His accidental find afforded him a legendary name and started the rush of 1852 that lasted ten years, creating many a rich man. An area known for fulfilling the dreams of its fortune seekers, the Heathcote region with its rich Cambrian soils once abundant with gold are now home to some of the country's most loved wines. Much like this classic Shiraz, with layers of red fruits, opulent liquorice and black cherry fruit with a powerful vanilla cedar oak finish.

Mr. Killerman lived in a humble tin shed in the hills behind Kilikanoon. He foraged through the Clare Valley for his meals, finding wild rabbit and many other gourmet treats. Kevin Mitchell’s father Mort respected this man from the bush, as they both knew the secrets of the rich landscape. Killerman’s Run reflects the rich landscape and being at one with the environment by sourcing and blending wines from right across the Clare Valley into a seamless, natural and uncompromising wine.

This deep brick red Cabernet Sauvignon with aromas of plums, cherries and hints of mint transcends to layers of savoury red fruits balanced with an earthy finish. A wine with elegance and power, best matched with home made lasagne.

This deep violet Merlot with aromas of strawberries, raspberries and a twist of floral herbs empowers this wine with a soft and generous mid palate. A genuinely versatile wine suited for meals of fish or sausages on the barbeque.
