The blending of the two allows me to make a consistent style that is a balance of fruitiness and acidity. Overall, crafting a wine with all the hallmarks of the variety and a fun, easy drinking wine.

Welcome to our latest release in theMéthode range. V2022Méthode Oakre Chardonnay.
A trial to explore the influence of different types and ages of oak barrels on the resultant wine. The grapes were harvested and quickly pressed into 3 types of oak for fermentation; One new 300L French Hogshead 300L, one old 500L Puncheon and one 225L barrique previously used for Cabernet Sauvignon. The resultant wine is complex, combining biscuit and melon fruit with a hint of ‘Ochre’ colour and tannin complexity.
A savoury style of Chardonnay combines biscuit and melon fruits, with a subtle oak influence. The palate is complex with the new oak adding toastiness, the old oak extending the mid-palate and the red wine barrel adding a hint of ‘ochre’ colour and tannin complexity.
An overall balanced and elegant wine that is textural and intriguing.

A tribute to Patrick Tocaciu, our founder, a master and lover of Riesling.  A Multi award winning wine and unique style, one that is rarely seen on shelves.  Grown in our northern most Coonawarra vineyard.  Block 5 Aged is only made in vintages that suit its style, it is bottled soon after harvest and cellared for a minimum of 5 years prior to release.  This wine showcases Rieslings natural journey from a fresh, fruity wine in its youth to a complex, textural and toasty Riesling in its age.  Cellar for as many years as you can resist, it will only get better.
Tasting Note:
This Riesling shows intense aromas of citrus, lanolin & a distinctive toasty character. The palate is delicately layered showing lime blossom & a wonderful mouth feel that extends to a crisp finish.
Winemaker’s Note:
Fresh & fruity in it’s youth, now displaying the unique characteristics & distinguished flavours that a well made Riesling can. This Riesling has been cellared for 7 years before release and will live for another 20 plus.
Vintage Note:
We had good winter rainfall followed by a warmer than average Spring. This brought forward flowering by two weeks and lead to moderate bunch numbers with small berries. A cool Summer then allowed the vines to catch up and a slow, even ripening period followed. Overall a strong vintage with excellent cellaring potential.

One of the most versatile varieties you’ll encounter, our Grigio is zesty with some honeyed tones, crisp and minerally and a touch of pear. The palate has savoury, marzipan flavours with some subtle white flower and talc aromas.  Enjoy it nice and chilled within 2-3 years.

Vermentino is a relative newcomer on the Australian landscape but is set become a favourite due to its natural texture and versatility. Vermentino is actually Spanish in origin but is believed to have travelled first to Corsica and then to Italy where it is the dominant white wine grape of Sardinia. It is a late-ripening grape variety which loves a hot dry climate, a natural choice for the Hunter Valley.
The grapes were sourced from the historic Roxburgh vineyard in the Upper Hunter Valley. Grafted onto 20 year Chardonnay rootstock the decision to trial Vermentino is certainly paying off. True to its reputation as a late ripening variety we harvested the Vermentino grapes in late February, after all of the Hunter reds were picked.
Our Vermentino shows wonderful aromas of jasmine, white nectarine and a touch of warm spice. The palate is textural and full bodied with flavours of pear and a crisp minerality. The ultimate food wine.

The fruit was harvested in the early morning and the juice removed from the skins as soon as possible. The juice was clarified, racked and inoculated with a neutral yeast and fermented in stainless steel at around 14 degrees. We left the finished wine on lees for approximately 10 weeks to give it a little more texture then racked and bottled the wine in early June.
We love this variety for its delicious crisp crunchy palate and its delicate pear and pink lady apple flavours. The wine shows complex minerality with a lovely aromatic crispness that make it appealing as a young wine and indicates an ability to age for further complexity.

Tasting Notes:
The 2022 Spring Vale Sauvignon Blanc has intense aromas and flavours of passionfruit and guava with subtle citrus, floral and cut grass characters. Vibrant, generous with a creamy texture and bright citrusy finish.
Great with Tassie scallops cooked in garlic butter with a side of fresh, steamed asparagus.

product_name: Great Southern Third Reef Sauvignon Blanc 2019
product_description: Elegant bouquet of gooseberries and guava with a hint of herbaceous notes. A true cool climate Sauvignon Blanc, this wine features well-integrated natural acidity and fresh varietal flavours of pea pod and herbal characteristics with intriguing complexity. The wine’s stunning acidity lifts the freshness of flavours and supports a long, flinty crisp finish.

Vibrant aromas of orange blossom and lemon zest and floral tones. Vibrant flavours of citrus and rose petal on the palate leading to a crisp lemon finish. The mouth feel is balanced between natural acidity and the fruit weight.
This wine displays subtle fragrances of nectarines and white peach with a touch of lemon blossom. A beautiful elegant structure combines upfront stone fruit with a creamy rich palate.
Vintage 2022 produced Rieslings with ripe intensity.Full of limes and jasmine, flavours of green apple with a long mineral finish.
On the nose this Fumé has passionfruit and gooseberries with crisp citrus. The palate is filled with tropical fruit, herbaceous citrus acidity with a smoky tannic finish.
Vibrant lifted nose of citrus blossom and grassiness with a touch of floral notes. Fresh and zesty palate. Citrus and grassy characters are abundant combined with a lovely richness from the Semillon.
Vibrant lifted nose of citrus blossom and grassiness with a touch of floral notes. Fresh and zesty palate. Citrus and grassy characters are abundant combined with a lovely richness from the Semillon.

This "Quarram Rocks" range is named after a beautiful protected bay in the Southern Ocean. The wines are crafted into “ready to drink now” styles that show great fruit depth and mouth feel. The label depicts the various granitic rocks that crop out over the region.
Lifted nose of citrus blossom and gooseberry. Fresh passionfruit and tropical fruit notes on the palate with a crisp cool climate herbaceous finish.
Lifted stonefruits - white nectarine, cumquant & subtle toasty oak notes on the nose. A creamy textured Chardonnay with flavours of fresh honeydew melons, limes and lemons.

This intensely complex wine is rich in stone fruit, citrus and melon. The creamy texture is perfectly integrated with the sweet oak and natural acidity which leaves a lasting impression on the palate.

Riesling from our low yielding Clare Valley vineyard was picked in the cool of the night and then softly pressed to preserve fruit freshness and natural acidity.
NOSE: Displays lifted aromas of citrus fruits and a hint of lychee
PALATE: Combination of lemon and lime flavours
SERVE: Chilled
PAIR: Seafood and Asian cuisines.
VINEYARD: Clare Valley
WINEMAKING: The wine was softly pressed to preserve the bright fruit freshness and traditional varietal flavours.
CELLARING: Enjoy now.

This spritzy Moscato has been produced using fruit sourced from premium South Australian vineyards. Our winemakers have used modern techniques, including minimal handling with gentle pressing to preserve the primary fruit flavours.
Nose: Displays lifted floral and orange blossom aroma
Palate: Lively palate of rose water, fruit sweetness. Good acidity and a touch of spritz.
Serve: Chilled. Or with a splash of gin and citrus for a refreshing 'Ginscato' cocktail.
Pair: Spicy curries and sweet desserts. Also excellent as an Aperitif on a hot day.
Winemaking: The use of modern techniques, including minimal handling with gentle pressing to preserve the primary fruit flavours.
Cellaring: Enjoy now.
Alcohol: 7.0%

Pinot Grigio was specially selected from our low yielding Langhorne Creek vineyards. The wine was softly pressed to preserve the bright fruit freshness and natural flavours.
Nose: Displays lifted aromas of citrus fruit and pear
Palate: Palate is clean with crisp acidity and an attractive array of
floral and fruit flavours
Serve: Chilled
Pair: Seafood and charcuterie boards.
Vintage: 2022
Vineyard: Langhorne Creek
Winemaking: The wine was softly pressed to preserve the bright fruit freshness and natural flavours.
Cellaring: Enjoy now.

A crisp, fresh dry wine displaying attractive fruit salad aromas with citrus and tropical flavours.
Enjoy it chilled while young.

product_name: Wild's Gully Alpine Valleys Sauvignon Blanc 2021
product_description:
Our Sauvignon blanc grapes are harvested from the Alpine Valley in the cool of the night to preserve the delicate fruit aromas and flavours. Bursting with rich fruit notes of passionfruit, gooseberry and citrus balanced with crisp acidity.
The fruit was gently crushed and pressed and after settling and racking the juice was fermented using a number of yeast strains to promote flavour and structure. This wine is a light bodied dry white and we recommend that it should be served between 7 and 11 degrees.

Our Pinot Gris grapes are grown in the Whitlands region of North East Victoria with high elevation that suits Pinot Gris variety. 

Our production follows the traditional French styling which results in a fresh, crisp palate with honey and pear characters.

The grapes are whole bunch pressed gently to avoid picking up colour and any bitterness. The juice is fermented to dryness in a stainless steel tank and then bottled soon after it finishes settling.

Harvested early this Viognier captures the ginger spice,apricot blossom and citrus characters.  Matured in French oak Puncheons, this wine has developed a subtle complexity. A soft and aromatic wine can be consumed now or will reward you in years to come.

product_name: St Johns Wild Fermented Sauvignon Blanc 2019
product_description: Abundantly ripe bouquet of stone fruits, white peach and nectarines mingled with fine buttery oak undertones. Creamy powerful, complex, mouth filling with a persistant dry finish.

Take the Australian Riesling rule book and do the opposite hand pick, wild fermented, high solids, extended skin contact, no fining, minimal filtration, all produces an intense and textural Riesling. Drink in its youth or allow it to develop over the next few decades.
This Margaret River Marsanne is hand picked and pressed, only the cuvee portion is wild fermented in stainless steel producing a delicate, rare and complex wine with exceptional aging potential.
Delicate stone fruit and soft acid balance beautifully leaving a lingering finish.

Aromas of freshly cut hay and slight hints of guava lead into more subtle notes of pear. On the palate, the wine is balanced with perfect natural acidity that reveals the refreshing yet subtle flavors of litchi and green apple. This wine reflects the ripe, succulent Pinot Grigio flavors that the grapes show on the vine. Enjoy as an aperitif or pair with almost any seafood or light pasta dish.
Our Pinot Grigio comes from the rolling Piacine hills of San Benito AVA, where the well drained limestone soils pair well with a moderated climate and precision viticulture. The valleys in this region help channel cool air from the cold Pacific Ocean only 20 or 30 miles away from the vineyard, thus reducing day and night time temperatures. Well suited to Pinot Grigio, the region is often cooler than many parts of the Napa Valley, yet receives the same amount of sunlight, preserving the bright acidity and developing the expressive aromatics of the grape.
After the dramatic end to the 2017 vintage the 2018 vintage was a return to normal, although a normal we've not seen in years. Mild conditions throughout flowering meant fruit set was extended and successful, ultimately leading to high yields slowing down ripening. The hot temperatures in July and August relented from September onward. There were no late season heat spikes or serious harvest rain events which meant the hang time of the grapes could be extended. The result was naturally balanced wines, lower in alcohol that retained good amounts of natural acidity. This was one of the longest harvests we've seen since 2011, starting on the 31st of August and ending on the 5th of November and can be summed up as a "Classic" vintage. Definitely one to follow closely.

This Sauvignon Blanc hails from our cool-climate southern Coonawarra vineyard. The wine is spritely with spring blossom, lime zest and juicy white nectarine.
This wine has lifted and passionfruit, guava and fresh citrus balanced by bright aromas of spring jasmine and fresh-cut lime, along with a delicate and focused palate of white nectarine and grapefruit. These flavours meld together beautifully with a very finely textured mouthfeel and crisp lime finish.
A delicate and beautifully textured wine made to match a variety of foods, showing the complexity of perfumed aromas and flavours.

After a very dry Spring and Summer the Verdelho grapes were picked at the end of January with excellent natural acidity. The wine was produced exclusively from the free run juice of the press.
A long clean finish results from organic grapes. Melons and citrus flavours are pronounced on the palate. To be enjoyed with spicy Asian dishes.

These Chardonnay grapes were grown using sustainable organic practices. The 2017 vintage had a cool year start with a very hot finish allowing the grapes to ripen with lots of flavour and natural acidity. The harvest produced quite small berries which resulted in very intense flavours. About 30% of the wine was matured in oak barrels for up to 4 months and then blended with the balance of the batch.

Tasting notes: This wine is pale gold in colour with youthful green tinges. The aroma is fresh and intense with lime citrus and background of ripe peach fruit characters. The palate is clean and lively with a soft but crisp citrus acid finish
Cellaring: This wine is ready to drink now, best drunk young while its perfume is most heady and the palate fresh.
Food Accompaniment: Great with Asian cuisine, Mediterranean pasta, salad.

Vineyard: The Pinot Gris grapes were grown ion the sandy loam flats of Belford. The grapes were ripe and full flavoured at harvest.
Winemakers notes: The handpicked fruit was gently whole bunch pressed and only the finest juice was barrel fermented in older French barrels, and stored on lees for 6 months prior to bottling.
Tasting notes: This wine is bright light yellow/green in colour with a clean fresh fragrance of pear and red apple. The palate is soft and rounded with a gentle texture and flavour due to the barrel fermentation and lees contact. The nutty overtones lead to a long lasting finish.

Vermentino is widely planted throughout the Mediterranean, often along the shore lines of both coasts and islands, where it produces bright clean lively wines with classic sea spray and wild herb characters. The variety has good acidity and can be made in several styles. The lighter aromatic style achieved with light pressing and cool fermentations generally without skin contact or oak maturation highlights the varieties fresh fruit and acidity.
The grapes for our 2022 Vermentino are frome the Central Ranges grown at altitude on the slopes of Mount Canobolas at Orange. The wine was stored on lees in tank for 3 months prior to bottling. The resulting wine is pale straw in colour with slight green tinges. It has aromas of orange blossom, ripe nashi and a flinty background. The palate is rich with ripe citrus flavour and the wine finishes with a touch of salinity and a slight pithy grapefruit bitterness. The perfect wine with grilled sardines.

This is a fan-favourite! Delicately perfumed with red toffee apple, pink fairy floss and plump, ripe red strawberries. The palate displays an array of floral and fruit complexities. An alluring and well constructed refreshing wine. Light and elegant to enjoy on all occasions!

product_name: Novello Adelaide Hills Semillon Sauvignon Blanc 2021
product_description: Hailing from the Adelaide Hills, this even blend of the two varieties came together in rousing tandem, allowing winemaker Greg Clack to strike a deliciously flavoursome wine featuring pronounced citrus and tropical fruit nuances. Fresh, clean and absolutely inviting and, at this price, it's impossible to question its value. - John Fordham Sunday Telegraph Chain of Ponds Novello range of wines are made with a youthful, exciting and vibrant idea in mind and all three can be tasted in this crisp and refreshing white blend. Compromising of a blend of Semillon and Sauvignon Blanc, the wine is a delicate blend of the lifted aromatics of the Sauv Blanc and wonderful texture and subtlety of the Semillon to lend itself to seafood matches wonderfully.

Do what you love...Drink what you love
In this exquisite representation of a GreatSouthern Riesling from the towering Porongurups region, vibrant aromas of zesty lime and lemon dance alongside ripe peach and apricot, entwined with the captivating sweetness of jasmine.
The palate is complex with flavours of ripe apricot, peach and pear, underscored by lively bursts of tangy lemon-lime, all supported by a backdrop of crunchy, crisp acidity and delicate mineral nuances.
A harmonious interplay of fruit, acidity and stony minerality unfolds, culminating in a lingering finish. With its graceful structure, this Riesling will mature beautifully over time

Flavours flow onto the palate which is mouth filling with creamy oak characters and crunchy salty acidity and very long finish.
Colour will deepen into golden hues as wine ages.

This wine is named after our daughter Christine; a natural redhead once a Ranga, always a Ranga. These low cropping Riesling grapes were grown in the Clare Valley wine region of South Australia, which has an ideal climate for Riesling. It has strong herbacious flavours of cirtus and  is suitable for white meats and fish.

These low cropping Chardonnay grapes were grown in the Barossa Valley wine region of South Australia, which has an ideal climate for Chardonnay. This unwooded wine has subtle tropical fruit flavours, that provide a soft mouth fill, with a vibrant finish. Ideal to enjoy with white meats and seafood.

This range of wines, named after fashionable fabrics, feature the iconic paisley design for which the company is named. The pattern became synonymous with the Scottish town of Paisley situated close to Glasgow and was the birthplace of Kirsten's great-great grandfather, who emigrated to Adelaide in 1839.

A hue of pale straw and tints of green. The nose is lifted with
lemon zest, limes and orange blossoms. The palate is bright and juicy with

Derek’s 90’s love-affair with dance parties and techno music hasinspired this range of red wines. The passion morphed with hisschool nickname Deadly Derek to became DJ Deadly. He used tomake CD for friends with his best DJ mixes and signed them Mixed by DJ Deadly. The Amplifier Chardonnay is just anotherone of his creations.
With a light straw hue the nose opens with lifted melon, peach,grilled nuts and a clove/cinnamon like character on the nose.The palate is mid weighted but with good flavour intensity. Itshows succulent white peach and tinned pear juice with hints ofmint and mushy peas. With a lovely pithy texture on the palatedue to leaving the wine on lees in French oak. With the Frenchoak imparting subtle clove and biscuity notes, With crispbalanced acidity and good drive to the finish it is a lovelyapproachable wine that would go well with roast chicken andcreamy pasta dishes.
Drink young while it is vibrant and fresh but will age in the
medium term.
A nice floral nose with tropical flavours. Crisp, clean, and pleasant on the palate. Pairs well with most gourmet deserts or cheese platters.

A nice straw colour and a bouquet of lifted ripe stone fruit characters of white peach and nectarine with toasty oak hints adding complexity. Stone fruit and lively citrus characters gives this wine a lovely palate complemented by vanillin oak and a tight acid structure providing backbone and length.

Aromas of tropical fruit and grapefruit. The palate is endowed with exotic flavours of melon, pineapple sage and tropical notes with a nice grassy undertone. Pairs well with salads and seafood dishes or just on its own.

product_name: Organic & Preservative Free Classic Semi Dry White 2021
product_description:
This 2021 Classic Semi Dry White comes from the popular Vermentino grape and is pale straw in colour with lifted flowery aromas.
The vibrant flavours of grapefruit and lime juice indulge the palate.
The wine finishes with crisp semi-dry acidity and lasting length.
Pairs well with fresh crisp salad, tapas and grilled seafood.

Dewey Station Wines is all about good humour, good times and serious wines. Spring Tide is our cheeky wink to Riesling’s best friend - the ocean. So whether you’re kicking back beachside or enjoying an ocean feast, our Spring Tide Riesling is sure to make the good times great!
This multi-layered showstopper draws you in with a fusion of lemon and sherbet delights, before giving way to vibrant yet delicate aromas of honeysuckle, orange blossom and rose petals. The steely acid line provides precision and evolves the fruit, showcasing apple and pear, in addition to the clearly defined lemon and citrus on the palate. With Dewey Station Wines and Spring tide, the world really is your oyster!
Toot! Toot!

An engaging blend of Viognier, Pinot Gris, Gewurztraminer and Sauvignon Blanc
This wine brings the family of confusion together, to give a wine of great flavour, texture, minerality, and freshness. 
Perfect for Summer afternoons.

Appearance: Vibrant green gold.
Aroma: Punchy guava with white flesh nectarine, and a hint of passionfruit pulp lift from the glass. There is an underlying lime zest note that helps to support these exotic characters. Citrus and subtle creamy elements help to complex the wine. This is a multi-layered, and engaging nose.
Palate: Ripe nectarines, guava, some flinty highlights, with a lime zest finish. The palate has wonderful textures, while retaining a juiciness of fruit and lightness. There is great intensity of fruit, and fantastic length of flavour. The wine finished with a chalky mineral acidity, but subtle fruit flavours linger with this cleansing finale. The length of palate is the real key here - this is a Sauvignon Blanc that can be ruminated upon, but also just enjoyed.

Oak Maturation: 9 months in new and one year old French oak barriques. Monthly batonnage on lees. 
Vintage: The 2016 vintage cold and wet in the early part of the season. The temperature then spiked in early October continuing to a mixture of warm days wet days and cool dry nights in the latter part of the season. Most rainfall was in the pre Spring growing period with drip irrigation required towards the end of the growing period around April.  
Winemakers Comments: Only free run juice used in this wine, inoculated with Burgundian yeast strains. Barrel & malolactic fermentation at 20 degrees celcius. Lees stirring over a nine month storage period.
Tasting Note: The colour is a vibrant straw with tinges of pale green. The nose shows peach and melon characters with subtle spicy vanilla wood characters. Undertones of cashew, butterscotch and vegemite “umami” from extended lees contact and careful oak selection. The pallet is showing rich peach and pear fruit with spicy undertones. Extended lees contact in French Oak barriques adds dimension and length to the wine providing great texture, intense flavour through the length of the pallet. The wines finished dry with crisp acidity and a gratifying creamy finish. The extra bottle age has enhanced the pallet texture and mouth feel.
Food: Raw and lightly cooked shellfish like crab and prawns, steamed or grilled fish, fish pâtés, fish, chicken or vegetable terrines and pasta or risotto with spring vegetables. Also goes well with creamy vegetable soups.

Colour: Vibrant light straw with tinges of pale green.
Nose: Aromatic citrus blossom and floral perfume notes.
Palate: Natural balance and harmony punctuated by a subtle floral perfume between acidity and sweetness. Intense lime and mineral flavours add great length to the wine and the lower alcohol of 8.5% entices a second glass.

Pale straw in colour with youthful green tints, the bouquet explodes with grassy and elegant distinctive Sauvignon Blanc and passionfruit characteristics mixed with the riper fruit salad characters stimulated by the warmer growing conditions. The intense herbaceous fruit dominates on the palate. The flavour fills the mouth and has a long lingering finish with clean crisp acidity, typical of an elegant cold climate white wine. Crisp and sophisticated this full bodied wine would be an ideal aperitif or serve with its perfect food partner steamed asparagus or with fine cuisine such as freshly chucked oysters.

The wine is pale gold in colour with youthful, green hues. The bouquet is elegant and intense with smoky citrus lime and floral varietal characters.The palate shows youthful intense varietal floral Riesling fruit characters filling the length of the palate balanced with a long crisp clean acid finish. There is also a hint of smokiness and lime characteristics, a full middle palate and a touch of alcohol sweetness on the finish. While extremely enjoyable now, the history of this wine shows it will gain further complexity and depth of flavour over the next 4 - 10 years.  The wine is crisp and sophisticated and may be served alone or with fine cuisine such as white meat fish yabbies or seafood.

The colour is a vibrant light to mid straw with tinges of pale green. The nose shows peach and melon characters with subtle spicy vanilla wood characters. Undertones of cashew, butterscotch and vegemite “umami” from extended lees contact and careful oak selection. The pallet is showing rich peach and pear fruit with spicy undertones. Extended lees contact in French Oak barriques adds dimension and length to the wine providing great texture, intense flavour through the length of the pallet. The wines finished dry with crisp acidity and a gratifying creamy finish.

Fume Blanc is a term use for wood aged/treated Sauvignon Blanc, made famous by the Sancerre wine region of France. Pale straw in colour with youthful green tints, the bouquet explodes with grassy and elegant distinctive Sauvignon Blanc and asparagus/passionfruit/lime characteristics with rich vanilla wood overtones. The intense herbaceous fruit dominates on the palate with soft tannin and vanilla wood characters. The flavour fills the mouth and has a long lingering finishing with clean crisp acidity typical of an elegant cold climate white wine. Crisp and sophisticated this full bodied wine would be an ideal aperitif or serve with its perfect food partner steamed asparagus or with fine cuisine such as freshly chucked oysters.

product_name: The Chieftain's Bard Macedon Ranges Sauvignon Blanc 2022
product_description:
There is a hint of orange blossom on the bouquet, it is subtle and plays understudy to an almost savoury herbaceous tone. There is generosity to this wine that people accustomed to NZ styles will find almost unbelievable. There is a laziness to the manner in which this wine flows through, across and around the palate. A breadth and length that persists longer than expected. There is a fruit pudding-like flavour, in that it is both sweet and savoury at once. Hints of asparagus with lemon, but there is a distinct shyness to this wine that speaks volumes of it’s longevity and reward for short term aging.
At 14.8%, this is a wine equally at home as a well-chilled aperitif or as an accompaniment to lighter entrees and canapes, salmon and quiche it’s best company
Drink now and over the next 3-4 years.

A deep straw colour with a depth of promise that builds the anticipation. The wine is young and as such rightly shy and reticent. A bouquet of banana skin and melon in line with a generous ripening season. Wisps of citrus and biscuit, indications of length and structure.
The palate is rich and generous. There is a wild puppy-like character to this wine with it’s youthful exuberance and cheekiness, aspects that will soften with age and time left alone to contemplate it’s future. It will create wonderful body over it’s long tight spine.
In time there will be added creaminess and depth, with apple pie and lemon meringue complexity growing ever more prominent.
Drink it now if you must, or wait and open your first bottle in 2-3 years where your greatest regret will have been not buying more.
Enjoy it now as a weighty aperitif or drink with robust white meats and even curries in the years to come. Best enjoyed with close dear friends. Drink now to 8 years but certainly longer!
An intensely flavoured crisp dry white. This fresh & tropical Sauvignon blanc shows distinctive tropical and herbacious notes.
Fresh and fruity, late havested sweet white wine displays luscious ripe fruit flavours with a refreshinly crisp finish.
Distinctive varietal characters of citrus, lime, some melon and tropical fruit. Full, rich Chardonnay!

The 2020 Viognier is a lively, vibrant and fresh wine with aromas of peach, citrus and gooseberry. It is well balanced with a fresh and fruity mouthfeel, and flavours of dried apricots, gooseberry, spiced fruits, lime and guava on the palate. It has a long, clean finish and is a good alternative to unoaked chardonnay.
Fun tropical fruit flavours (like pineapple and passionfruit) with a refreshing burst of lemon lime acidity.

product_name: Priscilla Queen Of The Pinot Gris
product_description: A crisp Pinot Gris displaying lemon and hints of melon on the nose with citrus lemon flavours and solid acid structure.
Lemon aromas with subtle hints of green apple come through, providing a wonderful full fruit flavoured mouthfeel.
This Verdelho exhibits lovely tropical fruits flavours such as pineapple and has a bright acidity. Made from grapes grown in Manjimup WA this is an aromatic-fruity wine.

A dry, crisp Riesling made from grapes sourced from a vineyard in Kalgan WA. This Riesling was completely unfiltered and unfinned therefore exhibiting more savoury characteristics. With age there are more citrus flavours, minerality, aromas of honey-suckle and the beginning of petroleum.

The Yard: the place where we break ground in single vineyard wines.Complex and full flavoured Sauvignon Blanc with lightly oaked charaters providing delicacy and richness. Lovely flavours of green pea, citrus and kiwi fruit building through the finish, great length.

The Ad Hoc Wallfower Riesling from the super star of the Australian wine scene - Larry Cherubino. The Wallflower exudes lovely mouth watering citrus flavours that are balanced by incredible fruit with a long finish. Because good wine doesn't have to scream its virtues. Sometimes shyness, delicacy and restraint are the signposts that lead to inner beauty.
Young Poets Sauvignon Blanc has zesty tropical fruits with just a hint of herbal notes. This wine has an attractive mouthfeel and terrific length of flavour.
Young Poets Pinot Grigio has bright fruit characters of green apple and ripe pear. Softly textured and balanced with a crisp acidity to the finish.
Young Poets Moscato displays fresh fruit salad aromas, luscious summer fruit– wild strawberries and rose petal, with a hint of spritz and a crisp refreshing finish.
Young Poets Chardonnay has lovely pineapple and fresh fig flavours, creamy, spicy oak with a touch of vanilla and a long, textured finish.
Wild Oats Western Australia Sauvignon Blanc displays succulent juicy tropical & citrus fruits in a refreshing, vibrant wine. Perfect for a beach picnic or seafood BBQ with friends.

Wild Oats Pinot Grigio is deliciously easy to drink : crisp and light, with an appealing spic y aroma, with fresh lemon and pear notes and a pleasing mouthfeel. From Oatley family vineyards, this is brilliant with Asian salads and deep -fried seafood.

Typical characters include florals, orange blossom, jasmine and fruity with ripe mango, perfumed characters of musk, lavender and lychees. Powerful perfume that follows through into the mouth. Intense and long finish.
Classically varietal with punchy grapfrut, dried herb and passionfruit flavours. Fresh salivating acid structure on the palate.
Fresh yellow Nectarine fruits and sublt e french oak on the nose. A big mouthful of flavour. Supple & creamy with lush fruits & a gentle buttery finish on the palate.
A deliciously complex Sauvignon Blanc. It’s crunchy and structured with white stone fruits and a touch of juniper and cucumber. It sees a very small amount of French oak to add an extra creamy layer.

Very fine nose of white peach and lime with hints of nectarine and mandarin. Chiselled, austere and haughty, with supreme power and self confidence. Ripe apricots, rock salt and lemon zest acidity, leading to a super finish. Will age superbly.

This delicious Chardonnay is 100% wild ferment and spent seven months in French barriques. Lees were stirred regularly. With flavours of orange blossum, freshly shaved fennel and toasted hazelnut with a briny, saline finish
A golden hue with a lime and nutty aroma. A soft mouth filling presence with lingering caramel creaminess.

Every meal was a celebration of the seasons, and the table overflowed with her orchard's bounty. This elegant Chardonnay has light straw hues with a pale green tint. It has fresh aromas of white and yellow peaches, with lightly spiced, honey, lime, citrus and limestone notes and delicate toasted vanilla oak. The vineyard was blessed with ideal growing and ripening conditions in 2018. Weather was close to average and very typical of Margaret River's mediterranean climate, cool wet winter and mild dry summer. Harvest decisions were plenty and left to optimise quality.
This wine has been given much hands-on TLC from pruning to leaf plucking to hand harvesting. Hand harvesting gives us ultimate selection of grapes and thus quality. We harvest in bunches so the fruit skin is not punctured (compared to machine harvesting which harvests each grape off the stem) and left intact and there is no juice contact with skin, preventing unwanted phenolic (contributes to bitterness) being picked up. Fruit can then be chilled down post harvest and pressed cold which is ideal. Gentle pressing of the whole bunch using stalks to assist drainage and reduce extraction of phenolics makes for a fine Chardonnay. Of course the balance to this is the much higher costs for labour and time. Hand picking has been an annual ritual!

product_name: Moldova Asconi Dry Wine Sauvignon Blanc 2015
product_description:
Be sure to try Sol Negru Sauvignon Blanc from the magical wine region of Codru, Moldova. The colour of this wine is special - pale straw with a greenish tinge.
The stunningly strong bouquet and powerful aromas of black and red currant flavour will remind you of fresh berries and the smell after rain, complemented by spicy notes of dried herbs and exotic fruit. You will be pleasantly impressed by the incredibly fresh and bright flavour with an intriguing spice coming from seeds of apricot and pepper.
Next, the taste is developed into a citrus freshness, especially expressive is the freshness of grapefruit. A brief taste of lime and lychee will manifest itself along the edges of your tongue. It then gives way to the refreshing taste of cherry.
This wine will win you over with its fresh, warm breath and leave a lasting, soft, cherry finish.

product_name: Moldova Asconi Sol Negru Pinot Grigio 2014 750mL
product_description:
This wine has a bright straw colour, perfectly balanced and refreshing with a distinctive fruity bouquet.
The taste is full of pear and apples with warm notes of saffron, herbs and flowering acacia leaves, gently complemented by cherry. Freshness is demonstrated in the form of a light pleasant tingling on the tip of your tongue. The finish is very long with hints of ripe cheeses.
This wine has a noble, quiet and balanced character. This wine is perfectly complemented by seafood as it has light acidity, fruit tones and a pleasant aroma.
A successful gastronomic pair will also be obtained with a dish such as a duck with apples.
This Moscato is worthy of any occasion. It is a sweet wine characterized by fresh and crisp fruity aromas. It can be consumed as a refreshing aperitif or matched with desserts and fresh fruits.

product_name: Moldova Asconi Sol Negru Dry Wine Chardonnay 2014 750mL
product_description:
The resurgence of Chardonnay has begun!
A beautiful example of classic Chardonnay with unique and distinctive features typical of wines from Asconi Winery. A sophisticated wine of light straw colour with light greenish reflections.
The bouquet is pronounced with floral tones, which immediately reminds one of blooming jasmine.
A stunning scent of peach and citrus, with caramel at the end. This bouquet literally breathes the freshness of spring! The taste is elegant, rich and layered with clearly traced white apples.
The finish is long and slow fading, lasting for more than 20 seconds, leaving your mouth with pleasant light pear and caramel shades.
This Chardonnay perfectly complements white meat and seafood dishes as well as salads, desserts and fruit.

A sweet gift from the magical Moldavian Winter. Ice wine is a dessert wine produced from grapes that are frozen while still on the vine. The water in the grape freezes meaning that when the grape is pressed the result is a smaller amount of more concentrated, very sweet wine.
This Riesling ice wine is a luscious, delicate treat that is simply heavenly. Fruit and floral sensations along with dark chocolate add depth to the palate. The finish is rich, crispy and refreshing. With a perfect balance between sweetness and acidity. Enjoy on its own, with chocolate, berry fruits, blue cheeses or creamy desserts.

Iron House Vineyards

Riesling, a pendulum varietal if you will, presents delicious and refreshing apple, apricot and pear notes whilst maintaining the wonderful minerality acidity associated with the classic style very much in the hearts of wine lovers. A medium length pleasing acidity that is not overwhelming at all, yet somehow more enhancing to this wine that balances delicate nectarines, fresh grapes and robustness dryness in harmony.
 
Bringing all the terrific Tasmanian notes of southern white Rieslings to the table, this wine is to dine for.

*Vintage pictured differs from actual vintage

Tasting:
Floral and bright on the nose, bursting with grapefruit and green apple. Subtle notes of apricot and almond provide depth and interest to the fruit profile. Fresh and vibrant acidity, teeming with citrus fruits. Great length, with some texture from fermentation in older oak, and a lingering sea-spray finish.
Winemaking:
A unique varietal that comes from our Boyup Brook Property. Originally from Sardinia, Italy.Pressed of the skins and straight into older oak barrels forfermentation. Inoculated with various yeasts to build aromatic complexity. After fermentation, the barrels were topped and the wine was allowed to age on lees, building up interest and complexity. Taken out of barrel after 9 months and straight into stainless to finish off the winemaking process Bottled onsite.

Tasting:
Flintiness and gun-smoke on the nose from the high-solids fermentation. A strong core of citrus fruits. White peaches and white flowers provide an elegant touch, while the integrated oak provides char, and notes of Brioche and Crème Brule. Complex and interesting, slightly left of field, and plenty of funk-factor.
Winemaking:
We had the scope to make something a little different here.Majority handpicked fruit, pressed into tank to cold settle, then racked to barrel at high turbidity to undergo wild fermentation at controlled temperatures.High solids, with plenty of lees interaction and some quality French oak thrown into the mix.

product_name: Chardonnay Gravette Vin de Pays de l'Ardèche 2019
product_description: A fresh, clean and fruity white from the Cevennes mountains. This Chardonnay Gravettes is cultivated in the heart of the Ardeche region, a vineyard marked by its cool climate and high altitude. The gravettes are white stones which are flush with the ground on the Ardèche clay-limestone plateaus. They offer this Chardonnay an exceptional terroir. This cuvée is the fruit of rigorous work: limited yields, harvest at full maturity at the coolest hours of the day… Only the juice of drops and first press are kept. Vinification is traditional with temperature control during fermentation. A second fermentation (malolactic) is generally sought, to extract flesh and complexity, before aging on lees.

Awarded with a “Coup de cœur" (= favourite) prize by the 2018 guide of prestigious "Revue des vins de France", the Domaine Emile Beyer is a true rising star in the Alsace region. In Eguisheim (Alsace) since 1580, Emile Beyer has preserved family know-how for 14 generations. Christian and Valérie Beyer now manage this 17 hectares estate, half of which is located on the Grands Crus and Lieux-dits hillsides. The soil is a living environment and a source of energy for the vines. By taking care of their terroirs, Domaine Emile Beyer promotes the balance of the vine and preserve the subtility and unique character of Alsacian wines. All the Alsatian grape are present in the vines: riesling, gewurztraminer, pinots (white, gray and black), muscat, sylvaner and even, for Crémants, chardonnay and auxerrois. The estate uses sustainable farming practices and is in conversion to organic. All Grand Crus are in conversion Demeter (biodynamic).

After pressing off skins and separating press fractions, the juice was allowed to settle naturally before racking to achieve a desired level of solids. The juice was then transferred to French oak barriques and puncheons to commence fermentation with a mix of inoculated and wild fermentation. Stirring of the yeast lees continued for seven months before the wine was allowed to clarify and rest on lees.

The 2020 vintage provided unusually ideal mid to late season growing conditions to facilitate production of a Botrytis-influenced sweet Sauternes-style dessert wine from our Maroondah Highway vineyard. This time-honoured wine style brings an unctuous expression to our mature-age Semillon vines which is enhanced further through the introduction of small but essential complexing elements of late-harvested Sauvignon Blanc for restrained acidity with Muscadelle & Sauvignon Gris for perfume and weight. Concentrated and complexed via infection of the selected berries with the noble Botrytis cinerea, this wine is rich and hedonistic, luscious and viscous yet elegant and structured. Aromas of golden syrup dumplings, barley sugar, crystallised ginger, beeswax andorange marmalade meld with flavours of orange poppy seed cake, cumquat and cardamom panna cotta. A smattering of phenolics on the finish helps draw the palate long giving resolution and profundity, keeping the sweetness in check. It will gain further richness and dark allure with careful cellaring over 10+ years.

The concept of blending complementary and compatible grape varieties to create a wine of amplified expression, structure, integration and balance, harnessing each components individual strengths to fashion a wine greater than the sum of its manifold components, has long held a fascination for us as wine producers. Taking its lead from the estimable blends of the southern Rhône Valley, built around a base of Grenache Blanc, we seek to find a
vintage-specific synergy from a harmonious blend resulting in a wine
expression beyond the limited range afforded to the singular grape varieties when bottled in isolation.
Aromas of grilled peach, Greengage plum, mandarin, royal jelly,
orange blossom, apricot, fig tarte tatin, olive brine and flint abound.
The palate features golden delicious apple, garrigue, dried oregano,
orange marmalade, lovage and bay leaf. Weighted and moreish tactile phenolics help draw the palate to a long finish. A true food and cheese lover’s wine!

This third Glen Garvald Marsanne Roussanne release builds upon the
realisation of a 13-year long process of development from inspiration to ideation to actualization of a dream triggered by our winemaker working the 2006 vintage at the incomparable Domaine Jean-Louis Chave in the Hermitage appellation of France’s northern Rhône Valley. This family-owned and operated domaine has been producing blends of superlative and ethereal expression and highest regard from these perfectly matched varieties for centuries.
Unfurling aromas of ginger, lychee, makrut lime leaf, vanilla custard, tarragon and orange blossom introduce the rich and viscous palate. The wine’s length and persistence are enhanced by tactile phenolics and a subliminal bitterness contributed by the Marsanne skins. Roussanne works as the perfect foil, harnessing and focusing the power of the Marsanne, adding definition across the palate and accentuating the finish. Flavour resounds and reverberates as a result.
This wine may experience a couple of peaks throughout its maturation: an initial youthful vibrancy followed by a period of relative dormancy of
indeterminate time. Its second rising will be the most definitive as it experiences a long, graceful and stable blooming into its twilight. Best serving temperature: 8-12°C.

The palate has excellent depth of flavour yet fine linear acidity and an elegant structure that will reward careful cellaring from 4 to 6years.

This classic Mt Barker Riesling exhibits a vibrant, floral bouquet with notes of lime zest and wet stone. The palate is fresh, crisp and deliciously balanced, with refined citrus and mineral flavours leading into a long finish. Irresistible when its young, this wine is also worthy of 5-8 years careful cellaring to develop the complexity characteristic of the region.

This wine displays vibrant aromatics reminiscent of freshly crushed wildflowers and rose petals with hints of white peach.. these flavours lead to a mid-palate core of intense lime juice supported with crisp acidity and balanced by an ethereal textural minerality. Pale straw in colour with nice length and a clean, dry finish. This wine will reward medium term cellaring with the development of complex characters of toast and honey.

Tasting Notes
Aromas of citrus, pear and white peach lead to enticing stone fruit and fig flavours on the palate. Crisp acidity, complex layering with a hint of nougat and vanilla culminate in a long seamless finish. 
Winemaking
Hand-picked from select rows in our high altitude Eden Valley vineyard. The grapes are whole bunch basket-pressed, before the juice is run to barrel for fermentation. Wild and inoculated fermentation is encouraged. Regular lees stirring and 8 month’s maturation in new and seasoned French oak barriques gives the wine beautiful texture and complexity.
Vineyard
Soil Type: Deep clay loam contrast sandy loam soils on dark brown subsoil.

Grand Barossa Riesling draws from the Barossa region’sGermanic history with its exceptionalRiesling that are refreshing, dry and displaying all the delicacy, eleganceand finesse of this noble variety. The body of this wine comes from vines planted in the 1920s, adding to the complexity and depth of flavour. This Riesling displays delicate lifted aromas oflime blossom and citrus fruits. Lemon, limeand hints of ripe stonefruit are in abundance.The palate is focused, pure and linear with adelicious juicy finish. Elegant and intensewith a touch of minerality and refreshing acidity.

Tasting Notes:
Aromas of citrus fruits, melon and white peach lead to bright tropical fruit flavours on the palate with refreshing acidity, Grand Barossa Chardonnay displays all the delicacy, elegance and finesse that can be achieved from this noble variety. 
Winemaking:
The grapes were picked early to retain freshness and acidity. Fermented at cool temperatures in stainless steel to preserve the fresh aromatics with a small portion of the Chardonnay was fermented and matured in seasoned French oak to add depth, complexity and structure.

Fresh stone fruit and citrus on the nose.
The palate displays white peach, grapefruit, lemon zest and apricot flavours with a fine texture, a slight nuttiness and crisp acidity.
Single Vineyard Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, Gooseberry, balanced with herbaceous chilli pepper enhanced by fresh mineral acidity.
Pale straw with green hues. This wine has delicate flavours of pears, almond with a savoury textural palate with a citrus pith finish. Pears and white flowers on the nose.

Our Fiano is grown at the De Bortoli Shelley’s vineyard on the eastern edge of the Rutherglen region. The site is south east facing and produces Fiano with a tight acid backbone and delicate varietal flavours. The site has an interesting gravel, clay and alluvial soil mix.
The colour is Pale Straw with green hues, citus lift with soft hazelnut and dry herb aromas. The palate has beautiful length and structure, soft texture, and nutty, citrus and delicate tropical fruit notes.

Deen De Bortoli created his Vat Series with the idea of developing a range of delicious, full-flavoured wines at an affordable price. This Sauvignon Blanc is crisp & refreshing with tropical fruit flavours. The finish shows silky soft acidity with a slight saltiness. Surprisingly good quality and great value.

In the glass the 2014 Gruner Veltliner, (or GruVe as we like to call it) is very pale straw with fine green hue. The nose is lifted with a flinty minerality and a loaf of citrus (more fresh limes than lemons) with a subtle herby peppery and floral notes. Again the citrus is prevalent on the palate followed by a fine peppery note. The mouth watering acidity combines with the fruit and peppery notes to deliver a long and fresh finish. Drink now or until 2025 with careful cellaring.

Medium bodied, round and pleasant with a great balance. Long and clean, spicy finish. Easy to drink well with rich pasta dishes, white meat and cheese. Delicious with cream
soups and grilled fish.

Passione e Sentimento (Passion and Feeling) celebrates the city of love par excellence, Verona, not in this case only because of its history and monuments, but also because of its wine. This white wine is obtained with the appassimento technique. Pale yellow in colour. This is an alluring white wine. Intense aromas of citrus fruits, almond and peaches on the nose. This wine has a palate which is refreshing and well balanced with a lingering finish.

This Chardonnay fruit is from one of the best vineyards in the Hunter Valley. The wine has had minimal French oak contact and exhibits the characteristics of fresh fruits and minerals, the very flavours that made Chardonnay famous in Australia in the late 70's. The lifty nutty tones and creamy textures make it easy drinking. A pale colour, citrus, blossom, almond and creamy oak aroma. Citrus and orange blossom carry onto the palate and are layered with creamy textured characters. A delicate and fine bodied Chardonnay.

BOUQUET = Complex aromas of lemongrass, lime,
passionfruit, melon and red capsicum all compete on the
nose.
PALATE = The palate is supported by delightful fresh cut
grass and tropical fruit notes. This Sauvignon Blanc has great
concentration, length and a fresh, dry finish.

K1 Chardonnay is styled to accentuate the
characters of Kuitpo’s cool growing conditions and terroir.
The fruit is gently handled to ensure aromatics are retained,
with French oak and partial malolactic fermentation are used
to enhance the wine’s purity of fruit character.

FLAVOURS = Aromas of white peach, fresh baked pear
tart and hints of jasmine and mandarin.
PALATE = The palate is focused and taut, delicate with
balanced acidity, textural phenolics and subtle layers of
fruit flavour.

Deliciuos juicy green apple on the nose is complemented by ripe lemon notes. The palate is milder than expected but therefore fruity in its easy, fluid, bright juiciness. The finish is dry on this summery wine.

This Sauvignon Blanc Arinto is a white wine from the region of Lisbon with a very aromatic profile, fruity notes, yellow and citrus fruits and with residual notes of fresh asparagus. It has a well-defined acidity together with a delicious minerality.

Our‘shining sword rising from the water’moment wasn’t quite of Arthurian legend, but by a misty dam early one morning. The first rapier-like cut of this Sauvignon Blanc inspired our Excalibur. Perfect for sitting down with a well-chilled glass on a balmy summer’s eve, accompanying a plate of any fresh crustacean known to man.
Excalibur will surely impress with its whiteGrapefruit Zest,Lemon Curdnotes and delicate citrus blossom aromas, with tartGooseberryand mineral-like acidity. It is the perfect accomplice to just such occasions.

Sexy, sassy, and somewhat racy, our cheeky Vermentino exudes so much character it just keeps you coming back for more! Clarity of direction and straight-out pizazz. You can see where the name came from!
Purity of varietal flavours such as lovely green apple,Starfruit, freshLimeand zestyGrapefruitall wrapped up in a crisp zingy finish.

product_name: Single Vineyard McLaren Vale Gilbert Grillo 2018
product_description: John Gilbert the 'Godfather' of Grillo in Australia, has produced a full-bodied Grillo with flavours of citrus fruits, apple and almond. A great wine to pair with rich seafood dishes, pasta, pizza and some salty appetisers.

product_name: Single Vineyard Adelaide Hills Grüner Veltliner 2018
product_description: Grown in the Adelaide Hills a soft elegant wine with flavours of peach, melon and green apple with a slight zesty finish. The firm mineral structure of this wine will allow it to age extremely well, recommended for between 10 and 15 years.

product_name: Adelaide Hills Sauvignon Blanc 400 Metre Range 2023
product_description: Family owned, and estate grown, this classic Adelaide Hills Sauvignon Blanc has characters of passionfruit, guava and fresh herbs. Flavours of Granny Smith apple, dill, gooseberries. A generous pallet weight finishing fresh and dry. Spring in a bottle. A proud member of Sustainable Wine Growers Australia and Eco-Vineyards Australia.
Zesty citrus, balanced by just a touch of honey-like richness, this Pinot Gris is complimented by a wonderful flinty crisp finish. This wine has a freshness that makes it highly enjoyable.

Tasting Notes
Aroma
The bright and lifted nose shows pithy lemon & lime with orange blossom, melon and complex aromas of toasted almond and gun flint
Palate
Juicy melon and crunchy lemon zest with hints of brown lime and creamed citrus fruit palate. Fine natural acidity gives great length and balances the textural oak characters.

AROMA
The nose displays lifted notes of mango and feijoa with supporting fresh mint, cut grass and green capsicum.
PALATE
The palate is delicate and fresh with bright passionfruit and tropical fruit flavours, balanced perfectly by refreshing acidity.

Produced From
Premium South Australian Vineyards
To Yield Wines With Great Drinkability
Winemaking Notes
Our H By Haselgrove Moscato Has Been Made In The Frizzante Style (Lightly Spritzed). It Is Low Alcohol With Fruity And Floral Notes And Obvious But Balanced Sweetness.
Aroma
The First Impression Is One Of Summer, Fresh Stone Fruit Blossom Leap Out Of The Glass, Followed By Bright Lemon And Lime Citrus Notes And Finishing With Juicy White Peach.
Palate
Even Though Moscato Carries A Much Higher Sugar Than Usual This Wine Is Refreshing And Crisp. The Grape Juice Sweetness Is Balanced By A Fine Minerality And Tight Natural Acidity.
The Flavours Are Complex, With Hints Of Refreshing Rose Petal And Lemon Meringue Mixing With More Textural Flavours Like Candied Citrus, Ripe Peach, Apricot And Honeysuckle.

AROMA
White stone fruits, melon and citrus with hints of toasted oak spice and honey.
PALATE
The wine exhibits bright peach and ripe citrus fruit flavours with complexing toasty brioche characters. The palate is well balanced with a creamy texture and a crisp, lingering finish.

product_name: First Cut Adelaide Hills Sauvignon Blanc 2022
product_description:
Tasting Notes
Aroma
This wine has a lifted nose of mango and feijoa with supporting fresh mint, cut grass and green capsicum notes.
Palate
The palate is delicate and fresh with bright passionfruit and tropical fruit flavours, balanced perfectly by refreshing acidity.

product_name: First Cut South Australia Pinot Grigio 2022
product_description:
Tasting Notes
Aroma
Lifted aromas of ripe citrus, honeydew and peach blossom.
Palate
The generous palate has a soft, yet delicate structure with typical varietal flavours of nashi pear and lychee. The wine has a delightful creaminess but finishes dry with beautifully balanced acidity.

product_name: Alternative Series Adelaide Hills Pinot Grigio 2022
product_description:
Tasting Notes
Aroma
Fresh aromas of citrus and nashi pear with hints of green apple and peach blossom.
Palate
Crisp and refreshing flavours of white peach and nashi pear, the palate is lifted and textural with bright natural acidity.

Tasting Notes
Aroma
Bright and lifted aromas of pear skin, delicate florals and hints of almond .
Palate
Zesty and refreshing with delicate flavours of pear and lychee, the palate has a lovey texture with great drive and a moreish finish.

Sensi Collezione Vermentino Toscana displays straw yellow colour with greenish reflections, intense and persistent perfume with hints of fruits and aromatic herbs. Creamy and aromatic, perfect with pasta and grilled fish.

Sensi Collezione Pinot Grigio Veneto is aged in steel for 8 months, and then ages further in bottles for two months. The aromatic and fresh taste renders it particularly adapted to match salamis and medium-seasoned cheeses as we as a wide range of complicated dishes. Crisp, dry and herbaceous with a lovely finish.

Andeluna Altitud (Argentina) Chardonnay is an intense yellow colour with subtle tones olive shiny appearance. Exquisite aroma dominated by tropical fruits, citrus, coconut and nuts. A delicate and correct acidity giving a feeling of freshness. This Andeluna Altitud Chardonnay has a smooth, lingering finish. Serve at 9C. Aged in new French oak barrels for 12 months, followed by at least 8 months in bottle before release. Battonage (stirring of the lees) was carried out during the aging process.

Andeluna 1300 (Argentina) is a wine that clearly breaks away from the rest of its kind, due to both, the intensity of its colours and the expressiveness of the ripe fruit that permeates its flavours. The grapes used to produce these wines come from our vineyards, located 1300 meters (4300 feet) above sea level. Light green colour with silver hues. Aromas of white flowers, citric and tropical fruits. Rue, jasmine and white peach stand out. Fresh attack with an intense finish.
The classic Margaret River blend. Pale green in colour, with aromas of tropical, guava Sauvignon Blanc and lemongrass, citrus Semillon. The palate is fresh and crisp with a fine tangy finish.
Pale straw some green. Attractive lifted citrus, nectarine varietal Chardonnay flavours with subtle oak complexity. Palate is textured and vibrant with great persistence.
Pale green with very attractive lifted cashew fruit aromas that follow through to the palate. Fine and weighted with abundant varietal Chardonnay and a touch of oak.

To immerse in the world with the love of travel, is one of life’s greatest pleasures.  Camping without effort is a way to jump right in and experience adventure and pairs brilliantly with a summer night's sky full of stars. 
With aromas of honeysuckle, tropical fruits and subtle French oak this light bodied white wine has an elegant palate of peach citrus and pineapple with balanced acidy.
Vegan Friendly & Sustainably Produced.

When people talk about the ‘history’ of a place, they think of the people who lived there, and the personalities who built it. For Warwick Estate, ‘history’ began when the first title deed was issued for the land in 1771. For almost two hundred years, it was a hugely productive fruit farm that served the Cape’s growing pioneer population.
Zest, elegance, flair, and a citric wit. Qualities that apply to our savvy bee and to our current First Lady, CEO Christiane Von Armin. This bottle should be the first lady to exit your picnic basket on any summer outing.
Zesty and refreshing with a beautiful balance of cut grass and green figs and passionfruit
on the nose. Tropical fruits follow on the palate, pineapple, passionfruit, and ripe guavas
leading in to a citrussy fresh palate with a long lingering aftertaste.

Stellenrust was established in 1928 and has ever since produced some of the most superb quality wines that the Stellenbosch region from South Africa can offer. It consists of about 400ha (200ha planted) of which half is stretched over the Golden Triangle area of Stellenbosch, internationally recognised for some of the best red wine soil in South Africa
Grapes for this wine are harvested from our highest altitude vineyards in the Bottelary Hills. Interestingly enough, it is also the only block of lime stone on any of our properties and our Grandfather decided many years ago to plant Chardonnay to this small patch of land.
The nose shows ripe citrus fruit with some toasted almond. The palate more concentrated with stronger nut flavours, some peach notes, but also a lingering mineral finish to it. Well judged oak preserves a butterscotch palate and promote a zesty acidity.

The Austin’s Riesling is vibrant and highly aromatic with lime zest, green apple and a lovely hint of nashi pear. Underneath these fruit layers are a perfumed, delicate fragrance of jasmine and citrus blossom.
A balanced, textured mid palate is elevated by that traditional zesty bright edge. A crisp dry finish that carries forward those lovely citrus notes through.

A medium bodied chardonnay withfreshness of stone fruits, lemon citrus and a hint of honeysuckle. The savoury like qualities, generous crisp mouthfeel and rich texture give this a well rounded, balanced and layered chardonnay.
Only 2600 bottles of thissmall batch winehave been produced, crafted by our experienced winemaking team using hand-picked fruit. Parcels are matured separately in French oak, with only the best barrels blended to produce thispremium chardonnay. We recommend you serve it slightly chilled in a wide-rimmed white wine glass.

Fragrant, clean refreshing nose of lychee and gooseberry, a whiff of wet stone which all follows through onto the palate. The flavours linger on a refined linear palate aided by a restrained acidity and supple texture.

It is pale straw in colour with a highly perfumed nose. The first sip takes you by surprise with full-on fruit sweetness, but the second reveals a balanced, generous palate dominated by Pink Lady apples and cinnamon.

Each year we make a Reserve Riesling from the very best parcel of fruit out of one of our four Riesling blocks. For the third year in a row Block 7 was the stand out. Pale straw with a floral nose dominated by jasmine and frangipani. Lemon from start to finish on the palate. An austere, classical Eden Valley Riesling. Drink now, but built to last.

Only our second Chardonnay from a carefully fostered single block of Eden Valley fruit of impeccable pedigree. Bright golden yellow, with white peach, apple Danish and cinnamon on the nose that follows through on the palate. A full-bodied wine with a silky creamy texture and an elegant lingering finish. An assured Chardonnay that can stand alone and solve the problems of the world. Drink now or cellar with confidence, for there is a long road ahead.

Les Enfants Koshu Shiro 2016 is light with a soft aroma of pear and freshness of lemon or green apple. Very subtle character of oak is nicely blended. This is a well detailed white wine that pairs well with Sweet Miso Grilled Cod, Creamy Chicken or Camembert Cheese.

Established in 1885, Lumiere is a family-owned winery continuously operating for 130 years in Yamanashi prefecture where is the most famous and historical region for Japan's wine production.
Koshu is a pink-skinned grape which is one of the most popular grapes in Japan.
This dry white wine made from 100% Koshu grapes, has full of minerals and fresh also just right deep flavour. You can enjoy it with various dishes not only Japanese and also Australian style.
Manufacturer: Lumiere Winery.

Colour : Pale Straw.
Aroma : Freshly cut apple and pear with hints of baking spices.
Palate : Light but lively with tropical notes and freshness.

Colour : Pale Straw with green hues.
Aroma : Citrus characters dominated by lime with hints of flint and nougat.
Palate : A continuation of citrus characters supported by ripe fleshy peach, balanced with minerality and zesty acid.

COLOUR : Bright greeny straw

AROMA : A delightful fragrance of butterscotch, honeycomb, white peach and pear

PALATE : A delicions mouth feel of lemon sorbet, rock melon and a cream mid palate finishing with a lovely citrus minerality

Barokes Bubbly Chardonnay Semillon Bin 242 is a wonderful bubbly drink providing a classy chardonnay blend. There are tropical characters on the palate with a pleasant creamy aftertaste and an appealing crisp acidity.

Barokes Chardonnay Semillon Bin 241 displays a lovely bouquet of honey and gentle floral notes, a result from the subtle wine maturity which provides a distinctive peach aroma. Pale green in colour with golden hues.

Quite full and expansive on the nose with seductive creme patissiere, pear, spice and gentle wood notes. The palate is not quite as full as the nose suggests - the wine is seductive in the mouth - but finishes with a tangy lemon acidity combined with a creamy texture. Balanced and thought provoking.

100% Verdejo. Like the Airen above the vineyards are at 800 meters above sea level, with a very cold winter and dry summer, warm by day and fresh at night, therefore the grapes mature very slowly. The fermentation room has Stainless steel deposits with automated cold-heat shirts. The grapes are whole bunched pressed.
Brilliant straw yellow color with greenish reflections. Fresh and complex aromas. White fruits and citrus aromas with a balsamic ground. Unctuous and elegant. Balanced structure and very persistant.

100% Airen. The vineyards are at 800 meters above sea level, with a very cold winter and dry summer, warm by day and fresh at night, therefore the grapes mature very slowly. The fermentation room has Stainless steel deposits with automated cold-heat shirts. The grapes are whole bunched pressed.Yellow green colour with shiny tones. Clean and floral aromas. Balanced and very fruity wine with elegant body. Agreeable to the palate with a fresh and vibrant palate.

Millot’s wine is 100% old vine Chardonnay from gravelly soil, picked and sorted by hand, and aged in old oak barrels for twelve months. The resulting wine, like everything the domaine produces, is fresh and vibrant with notes of citrus, flowers and minerals. . The grapes come from Meursault. The wine has a diam closure.

Mechanical harvest at the beginning of September. Pneumatic press under inert gas. Maceration with skins. Cold soaking and cold fermentation. Regulation of temperature. Ageing on fine lees in stainless steel vats.

As the vines have aged, the monopole Clos de Rougemont, from a small vineyard close to Tours, has even greater depth of flavour, and a delicious long dry finish. It is planted on pure limestone soil and vinified in barrel with a tiny proportion of new oak. A truly stellar Vouvray!

The Vinho Verde region is the name of a Portuguese wine as well as the name of this region.
The literal translation is 'green wine'.
What is meant, however, is not the colour, but the wonderful freshness and youthful characteristics of the wines of this region. Playful, light and fresh with aromas of bright fruit. An enticing chill breeze on a hot summer day.

product_name: Casa Do Arrabalde Vinho Verde DOC
product_description:
A successful combination of the regional grape varieties Avesso, Alvarinho (A.K.A Albariño) and Arinto.
Intense nose of citrus and floral notes of orange blossom.
Fresh on the palate with balanced acidity, vibrancy and a seductive lightness - this is what summer tastes like!

The William Murdoch vineyards are situated in the renowned Gimblett Gravels region of Hawke’s Bay, New Zealand. Inspired by his grandfather’s values and the Murdoch Clan motto, Omine Secundo – Under favourable omen, Brett Murdoch planted his vineyards, in William’s honour. The W.M. vineyards are like no other in Hawke’s Bay. By employing organic practises, the vineyards are a hive of activity, with bees and other insects thriving in the natural environment.

This distinctly delicate and ethereal aromatic variety marries harmoniously with our full-flavoured terroir characteristics, typical of all Persuini white wines, which originate from their hillside site and our rigorous cultivation techniques.
The grapes were harvested by hand and gently pressed in a pneumatic press, and cooled during the process with dry ice. With the use of specially selected yeasts the vinification took place in modern stainless steel tanks with the temperature of fermentation controlled below 20° C. For the
following 6 months the wine was left in contact with the fine lees. The wine has not gone through malolactic fermentation, in the effort to retain the original fruit aromas.
Colour: A brilliant straw yellow.
Nose: Our wine is perhaps more reminiscent of the Alsace style of Pinot Gris than it is to the greener, lighter Italian style. Its perfume is distinctly tropical, with a pronounced banana and passion fruit quality. 
Palate: Full bodied, with a fragrant tropical fruitiness. With its pronounced
acid structure it cleanses the palate, and has a long enduring finish. It has
great balance and is the most viscous of our white wines, though it avoids
any cloyingness thanks to its high acidity.

Jasci & Marchesani family, is pioneer of Organic farming and certified since 1978. The history of the family and their wine is indissolubly linked to love for the land, hence the decision to convert all 33 hectares, in Abruzzo region, according to organic principles. The challenge that awaits the Company in the next two years is to accompany the Organic philosophy to a low energy impact production system, so as to guarantee a healthy and environmentally friendly product that surrounds them.
A single vineyard Vermaccia di San Gimignano that expresses the intensity and depth of vines over 40 years old; the essence of the prehistoric sea that covered all these lands.

The Haute Févrie estate is located in the heart of the Muscadet Sèvre et Maine appellation, on the slopes of the Sèvre between Saint-Fiacre and Monnières, the vineyards of the estate benefit from the best ripening conditions thus providing Muscadet with a great expression of the terroir. The "Clos de la Févrie" is a cuvée from very old vines planted on the best terroirs of the estate. The oldest vines were planted in 1922. Very powerful body, generous, extroverted in flavors. The finish with beautiful ripe bitters and praline nuances is particularly promising.
Pale yellow color. Fine and delicate nose, with aromas of citrus and white fruit. Light textured with fresh and saline finish.

Bresset & Morel is a delightful Blanc de Blancs made from grapes picked from the greatest French white varietals grown solely in organic certified vineyards. Pale gold in colour with gleaming glints and delicate bubbles. Fruity and expressive nose with citrus fruit flavours. Pleasant and structured palate, with fragrant Muscat delivering flowery and lemon flavours to the finish.

All the charm of Côtes du Rhône South with the elegance of Côtes du Rhone north.
Bright yellow color with intense green reflections of an extreme shine. The nose recalls wild essences, citrus exotic fruits. When stirred, lemony notes are revealed, stone and spices dance together. The extraordinary freshness invades the palate enriched by enticing stone fruit profile.

product_name: IGP Val De Loire Sauvignon Blanc Reserve 2020
product_description: “Youthful pale straw colour with a bright hue. Pure and aromatic nose with cut grass, elderflower, lemongrass and stone fruit. Bright and crisp palate with good layers, exotic fruit yet bone dry with a lovely freshness good extract and a long lingering finish with a slight salty sensation” Andreas Larsson, Best Sommelier of the World 2007.

product_name: La Mancha Hoya Del Carmen Macabeo 2020
product_description: Wine made with the best Macabeo grapes of the Tolosa Family. Organic, vegan, modern and tasty. A fresh wine with a charming lightness. Suitable for everyday drinking. Pale lemon straw colour, slightly greenish reflections. Fine and slow tears. Clean and bright. Medium intensity aromas with hints of white flowers and aniseed touches. Subtle memories of liquorice and pastries. On the palate it is unctuous, fresh and very pleasant.

Visually clean and bright pale yellow with greenish reflections. The nose is high intensity notes of white fruit such as pear and tropical notes such as pineapple. Fresh wine with citrus notes that accompany the
course of the glass. On the palate it is soft and
delicious, elegant, voluminous ad balanced.
Structured wine with long-lasting finish.

The Gustavshof Orange Chardonnay, presents an exotic colour, which is obtained through a long, gentle extraction from the berry skins in the fermenting juice. The orange Chardonnay 2019, remains completely unsulphurised and unfiltered and is one of the most exciting natural wine. In sensory terms, this wine, is noticeably different from normal white wines, with a ripe tannin structure, powerful palate and particularly complex aroma. Orange wines are preferably used as a companion in top gastronomy, but they also bring a lot of drinking pleasure with spicy snacks. It reveals itself best, ideally at 12 -14° C temperature. This Orange Chardonnay is continuously evolving in the glass, allow it sometime and you'll be delighted.

Under the hardworking sunshine of the southern Seewinkel region in the Austrian state of Burgenland, Micheal Opitz white and red grape varieties flourish in various vineyards around the region. The unique flora and fauna of this region and its Pannonian climate are just perfect for winegrowing. The result: straightforward and honest pure wines.
Deep orange colour; floral (rose) combined with herbaceous notes; fresh yet rich with notes of apricots and nectarines leading to a long finish; goes well with seafood and Asian food.

About the Estate:
Starting in 1937, this family-vineyard is located East of the Bordeaux wine region, 25 minutes from Saint-Emilion. Wines of the Franc de Ferriere family originate from a unique area on the hills of the Dordogne river, giving the appellation all of its originality and grace.
Winemaking:
The grapes are picked later than typical for Sauvignon Blanc in order to express the more exotic fruit flavors of pineapple, mango, etc. After pressing, the juice is kept at low temperatures during fermentation to preserve these flavors even more. As soon as fermentation is complete, the lees are stirred every second day to add roundness and balance the acidity of the Sauvignon Blanc.
Tasting Notes:
This wine shows notes of pear, grapefruit and peach with a delicate citrus touch. On the palate, a good balance between acidity and roundness with a crisp mineral finish. Perfect wine for an aperitif or with seafood

100% Bourgogne Aligoté ‘Les Gravelles’, central Mercurey, almost 100% Limestone soil composition.Hand picked the wine are aged in stainless steel (zero oaking) for purity of fruit.Pale gold in colour with green reflections, this wine offers a lively nose developed with citrus fruits and white flowers. On the palate, we find a beautiful freshness marked with lemony notes.

Tasting note: Named after the parcel from which this wine originally came from, Tiserny wine is delicate and soft. A beautiful green and gold colour, Citrus on the nose and fresh on the palate. Yet, the notes of apples and citrus are light enough and balances well this dry style chardonnay from Brugundy.
Overall, Tiserny is a wonderful Burgundy white wine as you expect from Maison Tramier.
Production Process: Whole bunches are lightly pressed and the juice remains in stainless-steel vats for maceration for up to 10 days.
Predominantly aged in steel-vats for purity, the wine then takes passage in oak for 3 months. It can be aged for up to 5 years.
Appellation: AOC Bourgogne White
Varietals: 100% Chardonnay
To be served at 8-10°C. ideally with pasta, salmon, shellfish, mild soft cheese or cured meats.

The vines used to produced this fantastic Chablis are located near Auxerre, in the northern part of the Burgundy region. Tramier Chablis is reknown all around the world for its fantastic quality.
The soil is made of limestone, clay and marine fossils which gives this chardonnay fabulous mineral character.
It has a beautiful golden colour, it is fresh and elegant. A good wine to be drunk straight away but can also be kept for about five years in a cellar.
To be served at 10-12°C. It goes best with seafood and poultry.
About Maison Tramier
Wine merchant and growers since 1842, Maison Tramier combines tradition with progress. Tradition, on account of time-honoured expertise handed down from father to son, providing in-depth wine maturing experience whilst respecting past techniques.

Character:This wine has a veryfresh and fruity nose. With a good attackon thefruits (mainly lemon and grapefruit), it has a nice balanced acidity. It is ready to drink now but it may also be kept for up to 5 years.
Tasting advice:It is best drunk fresh (8-10°C), with seafood, fish or chicken. This Roncier "blanc de blancs" is also perfect as an aperitif with friends.

Château les Mesclances is one of the oldest family-owned wineries from Provence available in Australia, run by the Villeneuve-Bargemon family since 1531.
The winery is made of about 30 hectares of vines, all Organic Certified. They have received many accolades for the quality of their wines and praised for their ethos in looking after the land using minimal intervention. The winery is located just moments away from the Mediterranean sea influencing, the fresh and vivid Provençal rosé wines. Their white and red wines are stunning and not to be missed.
St Honorat white tasting notes:
Bright straw yellow in colour. The nose opens with mineral and buttery notes. Slight notes of white flowers as the palate becomes quite round with notes of spiced brioche.

Nose: delicate tropical and sweet floral notes, together with hints offresh cut grass.
Palate: contrasting the gentle nose is a fresh fruit density and a citric mouth feel.Lime hints follow with a crisp finish. A nice texture evolving the complexity in the classic Ant More genre.
Vinification: evenly spread rain events for an average total fall, andprotracted flowering conditions in December meant looser bunches thannormal contributing to less disease vulnerability and the success of the vintage as a whole. Some cold nights certainly helped in retaining nice acidity.
