product_name: Domaine Tournon Shay's Flat Vineyard Shiraz 2016
product_description:
Appearance: dark red colour
Nose: complex nose of black fruits (cheery, blackberry) with hints of tobacco (havana cigar).
Palate: aromas of black fruits and liquorice with supple and delicate tannins.

product_name: Domaine Tournon Shay's Flat Vineyard Pyrenees Sangiovese 2018
product_description: Deep dark red colour with black tinged edges and a dark red hue. Lifted ripe dark cherry top notes intermingle with dark plum, earthy tobacco characters, and spicy dried herbs. Medium-bodied with a fleshy feel the palate features ripe dark cherry and plum flavours over earthy tobacco and spice characters. Slightly dryish finish with fine-grained tannins, bright acidity and a spicy aftertaste of dark cherries, plum, earthy tobacco like characters and dried herbs.

product_name: Pyrenees Domaine Tournon Shay's Flat Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
product_description:
Appearance: dark, garnet red.
Nose: blackberry, blackcurrant, red currants, plum, spice, cigar box.
Palate: dark fruits and spice with fleshy, supple tannins, medium – full bodied.

product_name: Domaine Tournon Landsborough Vineyard Grenache Shiraz Touriga 2016
product_description:
Handpicked in late March, with the Grenache in early April, at optimal ripeness in the early morning to retain the natural freshness within the grapes. The fruit was destemmed and transferred into a stainless steel tank where it was kept cool until fermentation started naturally. A 4-5 week maceration allowed for maximum colour and the tannins to soften. uring
In the style true to Chateauneuf-du-Pape, the Grenache was aged in concrete tanks for 12 months. The Touriga Nacional and Shiraz were matured in a combination of new and old oak for 12 months to increase complexity. At the completion of the maturation the blend was assembled based on taste.
Appearance:
Brilliant dark red
Nose:
Blackberry, blackcurrant, floral (violette), spice and liquorice with bright berry aromas
Palate:
Full flavoured with a combination of ripe, dark fruits and hints of allspice, cloves and a savoury, long finish.

product_name: Heathcote Domaine Tournon Lady's Lane Vineyard Shiraz 2019
product_description:
Appearance: deep ruby colour.
Nose: redcurrant, leather, red crushed berries with a hint of toffee.
Palate: this is a powerful and generous wine expressing itself with delicacy thanks to a very delicate tannic structure. Intense flavors of ripe fruits and spices combined to a fine acidity – a hyphen between richness and strength reflecting perfectly the terroir of Heathcote.

Appearance: beautiful deep purple color.
Nose: intense with aromas of flowers, exotic fruit and red fruits with mineral notes.
Palate: soft with a nice structure. There is a good weight and depth. Well balanced and fresh. The finish is long with floral notes.

Appearance is deep ruby red colour. Noted tones of liquorice, spice and cherry vanilla oak on top of dark cherry fruit.  Its dark berry fruits give way to a rich mid-palate of chocolate, spices and a hint of regional menthol. The soft tannin structure of this wine allows lingering fruit flavours to shine throughout the long dry finish. Beautiful with rib eye and mash. Can be enjoyed now or cellared with confidence for 10 years.

Colour: Medium-light crimson cherry.
Bouquet: Attractive cherry, raspberry and underlying blueberry characters are underpinned with nuances of graphite-like wet slate and grape stalkiness. French oak is evident offering spice, complexity, and purpose.
Palate: Medium-bodied in style with vibrant fruit characters of cherry and raspberry. The palate is long and supple, with powdery tannins providing support and structure. Oak is subtle offering complexity and harmony.

Colour: Ruby red not too intense.
Bouquet: The first scent evoke cherries and raspberries, plum marmalade, and cloves.
Palate: The wine is fresh and lively, an elegant tannic structure makes it smooth and soft.
Food Pairing: It matches with tasty fish and white and red meats. Perfect with cheeses.

This quintessential Italian style luscious red wine is redolent with sweet cherry and a rustic earthiness combined with silky tannins making it a highly desirable food wine. It's blended with Cab Sauv which is a particularly complimentary partner to Sangiovese as it lends bouquet and lifted berry fruit flavours, liquorice and adding structure and dimension to the wine. This blend of varieties are used in the new wave Super Tuscan wines.

Colour: Bright pale pink with a blue/fuchsia hue.
Bouquet: Fresh, savoury red berry fruit lift.
Palate: Crisp and tight with vibrant cherry and raspberry fruit, with lovely savoury quality and a clean, drying finish. Quite moreish.
Food Pairing: Chilli prawn and basil pasta.
Cellaring: Fresh lively drinking immediately.

Medium to deep purple red colour. Red and blueberries on the nose with subtle oak aromas. Medium bodied. Elegant palate with an abundance of berry flavours. Fine tannins. Drink now and over the next three years.
A vibrant pink fizz with fresh strawberries and soft plums. It’s made from Merlot grapes grown at our cool climate Canyonleigh vineyard. A fun wine to celebrate this summer.

PepperGreen Estate’s Gamay Noir is a very versatile wine for summer enjoyment. Can be served lightly chilled.
Tasting Notes.
Pale cherry red.
Fragrant red currant nose.
A supple wine finishing with a brush of tannin and refreshing acidity.

Medium red colour with a little purple. Fragrant nose, with violets, red berries and leafy overtones. Medium body. Elegant berry flavours, finishing with a fine tannin grip.
Tasting Notes
Medium red colour with a little purple.
Fragrant nose, with violets, red berries and leafy overtones.
Medium body.
Elegant berry flavours, finishing with a fine tannin grip.

product_name: New South Wales Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot 2019
product_description:
PepperGreen Estate’s Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot is a good, firm Cabernet with a medium body and delicious berries on the palate.
Tasting Notes
Mid-deep red.
Blackcurrant and red fruits on nose with a little leafiness and vanilla from oak.
Medium body.
Good, firm Cabernet structure and flavour.
Dark and red berries.
Balanced, dry tannins and nice length.

This charming, refreshing wine is suited to most foods particularly salads at casual lunches and dinners.
Tasting Notes
Pale pink in colour
Fresh nose showing hints of raspberry and strawberry
Soft mid- palate with lively red fruit flavours
Fresh zesty acidity to finish.

A very attractive crimson red.This wine exhibits the distinct Grenache aromas; concentrated rose petals, ripe red berries and hints of confectionery. The nose is complex with signs of barrel maturation without any obvious oak. Ripe strawberry and raspberry flavours with the warmth of the dry grown Grenache showing long and fine tannins with a lingering finish. Savoury dry character that is not aggressive in any way with hints of spice. The wine lingers and has cleansing acidity. This wine reflects the terroir of the area and the characteristics of the Grenache variety.

Hand picked, open-fermented and a meagre 10 days on skins, 24 months in (30% new) French oak. Soft, polished fashion. Cassis, green olive, verdant herb and a scrub of sage-laden tannins. Long and plush.

product_name: McLaren Vale Jon's Block Reserve Shiraz 2015
product_description:
Colour.
Very attractive crimson black colour. Dense.
Aroma.
Very lifted and perfumed, spicy, almost nutty fruit/ oak complexity. A touch of that peaty character which is so typical of the old vines in Block 9.
Palate.
Soft, rich, flavoursome palate with lovely spice and pepper complexity lingering. Not sweet, more savoury and elegant in style. A great follow on from the 2010 Reserve Shiraz. This is an impressive example of old vine Blewitt Springs Shiraz.

Hand picked. 7 days on skins. 24 months of maturation in 1st- and 2nd-use French oak. The flavours is still in Blewitt Springs heartland. Dark plum, black cherry, blue berry, Asian herb, baking spice, anise, chocolate, toast oak and fresh acidity. Complex, rich, round and slickly made.

Colour: Brilliant cherry – red colour; bright and attractive.
Aroma: Savoury bouquet, perfumed with dark maraschino cherry, quince paste, very subtle smoky oak complexity.
Palate: Elegant medium bodied, with a good line of acidity and a clean finish. Lingering ripe cherry flavour balanced by distinct but gentle tannins.

Variety: Grenache
Region: Blewitt Springs
Vine Age: 50 years
Winemaking and tasting notes
Sourced from Blewitt Springs wild bush, dry grown 50+ years old vineyard, 9 months in second hand French oak, 150 dozen made. Lively floral, raspberry with hint of dark fruit and white pepper.
Review:  95pts (gold medal) – Wine Showcase

product_name: Old Vine Grenache Shiraz "The Gander's Blend"
product_description: Soft, rich, flavoursome palate with lovely spice and pepper complexity lingering. An elegant blend of our old vine Grenache (80%) and Blewitt Springs Shiraz (20%).

Colour
Attractive deep black-red.
Aroma
Soft and rich berry fruits on the palate. Fine tannins on the finish allow the berry flavours to linger elegantly.
Palate
This is primarily from Sue’s Block 11 Shiraz at Blewitt Springs and shows the typical, more spicy and savoury style of this sub-region of McLaren Vale.

Colour
A very pretty salmon pink.
Aroma
Fresh, bright red fruits and spice with a little of the typical Nero d’ Avola quince character coming through
Palate
Lovely crisp flavoursome palate with good texture and acidity and a long dry, savoury finish lingering with rhubarb and quince.

Colour Brilliant cherry red colour, bright and attractive. Aroma Savoury bouquet, perfumed with dark maraschino cherry, quince paste, very subtle smoky oak complexity. Palate Elegant medium bodied, with a good line of acidity and a clean finish. Lingering ripe cherry flavour balanced by distinct but gentle tannins.

Colour: Impressive deep black/red.
Aroma: Lifted, more fragrant Cabernet cassis aromas complexed by barrel maturation. Bordeaux-like!
Palate: Nice ripe berry fruit on the front palate and finishes with that firm, distinctive Cabernet tannin. A lovely cassis flavour lingers.
Deep red color and concentrate aroma. Layers of fruit, with blueberry to the fore.100% french oak givesa mass of fine grained tannins which bring a firm tight finish of great length.
Chocolate, pepper plum aromas, rich dark berry fruits with herb and spice on the palate, well balanced by ripe soft tannins.

Our Two Blocks Shiraz was matured in a combination of new American & second use French oak for 24 months. This gives the wine structure, complexity and a lift of chocolate oak flavour. The finish is smooth and lingering. Cellar for another 5-10 years to see the wine soften and develop further complexity.
Winemaker’S Note:
2017 was a great year for both freshness of fruit and balance of spice and elegant tannins. This Shiraz is a great example of our cool climate style, being approachable and elegant with just a touch of oak.
Vintage Note:
A cool growing season and above average rainfall lead to a mild growing season that presented some challenges towards the end of harvest. Fortunately the rain cleared enough for the Shiraz to ripen and be picked just in time. It was the stand out variety of the season with the balance of spice and ripeness returning to a more traditional style cool climate
wine.

Our Two Blocks Cabernet Sauvignon Grown in our northern Coonawarra vineyard and sourced from two blocks, 3 and 4a, within this single vineyard. The larger berries of this block mean more juice and less tannin extraction, making it a fruit driven approachable style. A combination of 40% new and 60% second use hogsheads (300L).
The aroma has a lifted perfume and is full of plum with a touch dark cherry fruit. The palate is bold and full, but has softness, spice and elegant tannins. An approachable Cabernet that will drink well now or cellar for up to 5 years
VINTAGE NOTE:
The season had a fantastic start, with generous Winter rainfall regenerating the aquifer and ensuring adequate subsoil moisture coming into Spring. We saw great canopy growth but a cool November delayed flowering and brought the bunch weights down to just below average. The majority of the state suffered from dry conditions, however our cool climate and on average rainfall kept the vines healthy and made for a long growing season, perfect for Cabernet.

97 PTS — Halliday Wine Companion - "A barrel selection from the best vintages from Home Block vineyard, 30 months in French oak, then 4 years cellaring at the winery. It is opulent yet well balanced, repeated tastings revealing a wine of great class with a long future. Cellaring potential: 2042. "  
The best fruit from only the best vintages makes the grade for this iconic wine. Bold, complex notes of dark chocolate and concentrated fruit lead to a wonderfully rich, structured palate with impeccable length. A wine that showcases the true essence of aged Coonawarra Cabernet

We are a small team at Patrick of Coonawarra, making award winning wine from our estate grown vineyards within the Limestone Coast of South Australia.  We produce product of passion, perseverance, people & place.
Tasting Note:
This Shiraz builds mouthfeel and rich fruit flavour, with medium bodied tannin complexity. It is a wonderfully round, complex wine that has all the hallmarks of a classic Australian Red.
Winemaker’S Note:
From our nothern block in Wrattonbully. Aged in predominantly older oak to ensure the richness of fruit is preserved and minimal tannin is absorbed.
Vintage Note:
A warm October and November advanced budburst andflowering by about two weeks earlier than average.March then saw more stable and mild conditionswhich allowed for a slower finish to the season andensured enough time for tannins to ripen and flavourto develop.

We are a small team at Patrick of Coonawarra, making award winning wine from our estate grown vineyards within the Limestone Coast of South Australia. We produce product of passion, perseverance, people & place.
Tasting Notes:
This dry style of Rosé is fresh and lively with berry fruit aromas and floral hints combining with a soft, silky mouthfeel. The palate shows hints of strawberries and cream, perfectly balanced with fruit sweetness and a crisp, refreshing finish.
Winemaker’S Note:
The grapes were picked from a single vineyard, 40% Merlot, 30% Cabernet, 30% Chardonnay, then crushed and left on skins for 8 hours to enhance the flavour and release the vibrant colour, before being pressed.

We are a small team at Patrick of Coonawarra, making award winning wine from our estate grown vineyards within the Limestone Coast of South Australia. We produce product of passion, perseverance, people & place.
This wine has been handcrafted to combine bold blackberry fruits with the spice and earthiness for which Coonawarra is renowned. It is medium bodied in structure, yet has concentration and elegance with a smooth finish.
WINEMAKER’S NOTE:
This Cabernet is grown in our northern Coonawarra vineyard. It spent time in seasoned French oak for 20 months, before being bottled and cellared before release.
VINTAGE NOTE:
The season had a fantastic start, with generous Winter rainfall regenerating the aquifer and ensuring adequate subsoil moisture coming into Spring. We saw great canopy growth but a cool November delayed flowering and brought the bunch weights down to just below average. The majority of the state suffered from dry conditions, however our cool climate and on average rainfall kept the vines healthy and made for a long growing season, perfect for Cabernet.

Welcome to ED.02 of our Méthode Cab Nouveau, born as an experiment to showcase the diversity of the variety. This year, we trialled a new method to achieve a similar result.
The grapes were harvested and crushed into an open fermenter. The must was left with CO2 cover to warm up and allow spontaneous fermentation with natural yeast. It was pumped over twice daily until day 5, when the juice was drained off and allowed to complete fermentation in tank. After this, a reverse osmosis filter was used to remove any large tannins with a molecular weight greater than 10,000. The resultant wine was then aged in 500L puncheons prior to bottling in January 2021.
This wine sits perfectly in the 'Chilled Red' category, you might see this referenced as CR on a wine list. Putting a red wine in the fridge is certainly not a new thing, but it has seen a re-emergence in the last couple of years. As per the 2020 vintage, this wine is made to enjoy young — it's a soft, approachable twist on a classic variety.
Drink within the first 18 months. If you do want to chill this wine, simply treat it like you would a Rosé or Light White (eg. Riesling, Pinot Grigio, Sauvignon Blanc). An approachable take on a classic that will make you question the variety and challenge your perceptions.

Established by Patrick Tocaciu in 1998, our Joanna vineyardis named after the old settlement of Joanna in Wrattonbully.  We introduced Joanna to the Sngle Site range in 2018 after having discovered a batch in the winery that was to good to ignore.  The south facing slope allows for a long ripening period and concentrated flavour.  Expect rich mulberry, concentrated dark fruits, chocolate nuances and an elegance that only cool climate vines can boast.
TASTING NOTE:
The aroma of this wine is balanced between chocolate oak and raspberry fruit. The palate is medium weight with dark berry fruits and a concentrated fruitcake spice. It is powerful yet elegant and will complex and age well over the next 10 years.
WINEMAKER’S NOTE:
From the south-facing slope of our Wrattonbully vineyard. This allows for slower ripening and concentration of flavour. Matured for 28 months in new American and used French oak Hogsheads.
VINTAGE NOTE:
A cool growing season and above average rainfall lead to a mild growing season that presented some challenges towards the end of harvest. The Shiraz however, was the stand out wine of the season with the balance of spice and ripeness returning to a more traditional style cool climate wine.

Home Block is an award-winning Cabernet Sauvignon, produced from vines surrounding the Tocaciu family home. It is a single vineyard parcel grown on terra rossa soil from vines planted in 1960.
Home Block was the first wine that Pat released for the family business. It shows the true essence of Coonawarra – rich, dark berry fruits and elegant tannins.
Tasting Note:
Rich blackberry fruit is balanced with the subtlespice and cedar aromas. The palate is bold and complexwith fine, elegant tannins leading to the long,balanced finish. The warmer vintage has allowed greatvarietal expression, rich fruit and a bold yetexpressive Cabernet.
Winemaker's Note:
From our 60 year old vineyard surrounding the family
home. 2 years in French & American, tightly grained,medium toast oak barriques (60% new). This wine iscomplex & will age gracefully.
Vintage Note:
A warm October and November advanced budburst andflowering by about two weeks earlier than average.
Mild conditions in March allowed for a slower finishto the season and ensured enough time for tannins to
ripen and flavour to develop.

A bright and expressive nose loaded with red fruits, cherry and plum. The palate is both juicy and bold with spice and smooth milk chocolate-like tannin. The Shiraz component adds depth and dark fruits, while the Grenache delivers a vibrancy and energy with a fresh finish.

The wonderful Italian grape, Sangiovese, is one of the oldest known varieties in the world. Its beauty lies in its ability to produce wines that are highly concentrated in flavour yet have a lighter, more approachable structure than Cabernet or Shiraz. This Sangiovese is a perfect example of this accessible, ready to drink style.
The grapes were crushed to open fermenters and approximately 30% of the juice was removed to produce our Sangiovese Rose. The remaining juice was fermented on skins for 10 days. The wine was then pressed and transferred to 1 and 2 year old French barriques. The wine was racked frequently to aerate and soften the tannins.
This Sangiovese is imbued with sweet cherry and leather tones and loaded with fabulous smoky chocolate and mushroom characters. The savoury tannins and complex fruit characters make this an ideal food wine. Great with any tomato based dishes.

Winemaker Ian Little spent years of his childhood in Argentina and has returned many times to explore the wine regions and culture of what is a vast and fascinating country. Llamas is a fun project showcasing Malbec, the signature variety of Argentina.
The varietal hallmarks of Malbec are its spicey richness, its big lavish fruit flavours and soft velvety tannins. This Malbec encapsulates all those features with its generous flavours and sumptuous depth of fruit. Naturally, it is the perfect wine for a traditional Argentinian asado – salud!
Why llamas, why pyjamas? Just a fun name for a seriously good wine.

Barbera is a wonderful red variety which originally comes from Italy’s northern Piedmont region. It is the second mostly widely planted red variety in Italy and is becoming increasingly popular in Australia due to its soft tannins and ability to grow in a variety of conditions.
Grown in the Broke-Fordwich region of the Hunter Valley, the Little Wine Co Barbera is made in the fuller-bodied, plush style the lends itself to robust dishes. With appealing flavours of currants and blackberries, supple soft tannins and excellent structure it is the perfect foodie wine.

The beauty of this wine is in the perfumed lift of spice and violets overlaying the subtle tobacco characters on the palate. Oak maturation has imparted a little extra complexity and structure making the palate supple with fine lingering tannins.

This elegant Margaret River Cabernet Sauvignon displays  classic aromas of cassis, cedar wood and tobacco leaf with subtle earthy notes. Fine and velvety tannins combine to the fleshy palate seamlessly to deliver a detailed expression of Cabernet that is both full and persistent.

Unfined and unfiltered, this is a pure expression of place with balance and integrity.

Has beautiful salmon hues with an intriguing bouquet of wild strawberry, rose petal and blood orange. On the palate bright red fruits to the fore, complimented by creamy vanilla bean through the mid palate. Lingering dry, savoury finish with hints of white pepper.

Elegant perfumed bouquet of bramble fruits and savoury spice.The palate displays considerable fruit concentration of plum and dark berries. The fine ripe tannins are very well integrated with fruity and savoury characters providing a velvety texture.

product_name: Great Southern Third Reef Pinot Noir 2018
product_description: Displaying lifted aromas of violets and spice with subtle plum notes. The palate is full and textured with cherry and dark berries, supported by silky fine tannins which are sublimely integrated and lead to a long elegant finish.

product_name: Great Southern Third Reef Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
product_description: Displaying a perfumed nose of dark berries and savoury characters.The palate is full of juicy berries and earthy notes that are well supported by fine grained, integrated tannins.

This stunning shiraz offers a lifted bouquet of dark berries with subtle spicy notes. The medium weighted palate is filled with blackberries, spices and pepper that are balanced by silky tannins. This parcel of fruit comes from one of the earliest plantings and provides some of the best shiraz full of black fruit and peppers expected of this exceptional Frankland River fruit.

Bright ruby in colour, this wine is lifted and aromatic with ripe strawberries and dark cherries, a hint of earth and sappy notes. The palate is delicate and fragrant with subtle tannins, abundant dark fruit, and integrated toasted French oak.  Flavours to compliment five spice duck or a selection of charcuterie.
The 2021 Mourvèdre is a lovely medium, bodied wine plump with soft red fruit, plums and mulberries. It has a savoury palate of cedar, leather and roasted coffee.

Even better than the last one. A fantastic wine with an amazing concentration of mulberry, plum and rose petal on the nose.The palate has chalky tannins, red plums and a touch of cocoa and vanilla. Yum!

The 2018 Single Site Cabernet is an elegant wine with notes of blackcurrant, black cherry, and a hint of mint. Displaying a perfumed nose of dark berry fruits and earthy tones, there is a smooth silkiness to balance the fine chewy tannins of the Cabernet.
Displaying a perfumed nose of dark berry fruits and earthy tones. The palate is full of fresh berries and spice. There is a smooth silkiness to balance the fine chewy tannins of the Cabernet.

This "Quarram Rocks" range is named after a beautiful protected bay in the Southern Ocean. The wines are crafted into “ready to drink now” styles that show great fruit depth and mouth feel. The label depicts the various granitic rocks that crop out over the region.
Elegant aromas of dark red fruits, sweet spice and toasty oak. A medium earthy palate filled with spicy spicy fruit and wild berries finishing with gentle tannins from the French Oak.

Vibrant nose of black current, raspberry with subtle sweet spice. Full firm mouth feel of bramble fruits and subtle savoury spice, well integrated fine powdery tannins, supported by complex oak with great length and a fine full finish.

The Rockcliffe "Peaceful Bay" wines are named after a local bay not too far from the winery in Denmark WA. The ray emblem for the wines reflects the marine life that can often be found around the sandy and rocky shores along the Denmark, W.A. coastline.
Elegant aromas of dark rich berries with underlying savoury spice. Plum, earthy undertones, some sweet spice and fine tannins offer great support giving the wine a long, fruit-driven length.

Lovely lifted floral and perfumed notes combine strawberries and cherries.  Light, refreshing and vibrantly flavoured. The richly flavoured palate with good weight and fills the mouth with berry fruits and ripe strawberries and finishes with a delightful freshness.
Aromas of robust blackberry with hints of liquorice, spice and dark cherries. This sparkling features a rich, earthy full-bodied palate with loads of berry and spice flavours.

Nautica Shiraz has been crafted exclusively from delicious, handpicked berries grown in mineral rich soils of a selected sea of vines. Experience a nose of pronounced dark forest fruits, white pepper and smokey oak. With a palate of luscious black forest cake, earthy notes, and a long dark chocolate smokey finish.

Intertwining aromas and flavours of rhubarb, sour cherries, and smokey herbal spice excite the senses and deliver surprise. Harvested from a small block in Frankland River, the Nautica Cabernet is unfined and a true expression typical of the elegant approachable tannin of this cool climate region.

The Cabernet's intense dark berry fruit flavours are lifted with the chocolate and cherry flavours of the Shiraz in this classic Australian blend.

An elegant blend of Greenock Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz from our 50 year old Estate vines.  Matured in French and American oak for 31 months, it offers well integrated aromas of sweet and toasty oak notes.  Truly a well balanced palate with fine cabernet tannins and rich shiraz fruit giving a long lingering finish.

Selected Shiraz from quality Langhorne Creek vineyards was vinified using a combination of fermentation styles and American oak, to highlight the regional characteristics.
Proceeds from every sale of this wine goes towards the Grapes For Good initiative with Monarto Safari Park.
Learn more about Grapes For Good.

Selected Cabernet Sauvignon from quality Langhorne Creek vineyards was vinified using a combination of fermentation styles and French oak to build complexity and structure.
Displays lifted aromas of dark cherries and chocolate mingle.Richly flavoured palate of blackcurrants and ripe plums.

Classic Cabernet aromas of briary, blackberry and blackcurrant, with hints of cedar cigar box.  On the palate flavours of liquorice and blackberry with classic fine Cabernet tannins.

Made from selected parcels from Moppa Springs Estate around Greenock in the famous Barossa Valley, this wine is typical of the Barossa Cabernet Sauvigon style.  A fine, well balanced wine that was aged for 31 months in a combination of French and American oak.  Cellar for up to 10 years.

product_name: Fine Acres Estate Ancient Vine Shiraz 2017
product_description:
Aromas of dark cherry, blackberry and rasperry with chocolate and vanilla.  Rich and ripe flavours of cherry and chocolate with excellent length.

Fine Acres Estate near Vine Vale has some of the oldest vines in the Barossa Valley.  The ancient, gnarly, 100-year-old vines on the Estate still produce high quality Shiraz in the bold Barossa style, coupled with finesse.  Matured for 19 months in a combination of French and American Oak.

The Vineyard Road Estate is located in the premium Belvidere region on the outskirts of Langhorne Creek. The Estate itself grows Vineyard Road's best fruit in the region, with only the best parcels of Shiraz making it into this wine.
Palate: Displays a rich palate of black fruit and chocolate with delicate spice notes
Serve: Room temperature
Pair: Roast meats and barbecue.
Vintage: 2016
Vineyard: Langhorne Creek
Winemaking: It is a blend of some of our finest parcels of shiraz grapes. The wine has been carefully crafted in small open fermenters, the extended skin time ensuring optimal flavour development and matured in new American oak.
Cellaring: Perfect for a special event today yet will also reward those among us with the patience to cellar over the next decade.

product_name: Langhorne Creek A Rose For Mum
product_description:
Sparkling Rose
Enjoy thedelicate pink bubbles and refreshment of light,dry style of Rosé. It's a fizzy delight with every sip!
Fresh guava and brioche.Crisp structure, dry in style with a soft mousse. Notes of nectarine and guava with a soft finish of cherry.
Sangiovses Rose
Sangiovese was specially selected, picked and softly pressed to produce a Rose with the perfect balance of natural sweetness and fruit flavour.Displays a combination of cherry and guava aromas with a subtle fruit flavours with a hint of talc.

Cool climate Eden Valley and Barossa Valley fruit provides a rich, velvety textured wine with full fruit flavours.

The grapes for Alessandra were grown in Grant Burge's Corryton Park vineyard high in the cool-climate Eden Valley, and blended seamlessly with small lots from the Barossa Valley floor to capture rich, velvety texture and full fruit flavours.
A lifted and perfumed wine with red berry, black olive and plum flavours. Juicy fruit and a generous middle palate with star anise and cinnamon stick nuances.

Intense ruby red colour. Fruity aromas and flavours of black cherries, raspberries and blackberries with hints of tobacco and black pepper. Structured tannins confirm its time in French oak. Refreshing finish.
100% Cabernet Sauvignon
Handpicked in bags of 20kg. Fermented in stainless steel. Malolactic fermentation. 24 months in French oak.
Enjoy withBeef, lamb, and baked pasta.
Best served at 17 - 19° C.
About the winery: Since 1955, Cinco Sentidos have followed Mendoza’s noble tradition of high-quality winemaking. Today, this path of history finds them enjoying what they love best and know most about: making wines that can evoke thousands of moments and transmit numerous life experiences. Their vineyards cover 100 hectares located in the Uco Valley, Mendoza a most privileged location at an altitude of 850m. The vineyards sit at the banks of the Mendoza River, bringing out a silty loam alluvial soil of deep character, in a dry region with little rainfall and clearly marked seasons.

Intense deep red colour with purple hues. Clean, deep and bright. Delicate aromas of ripe plums and cherries with vanilla and leather notes, resulting from its ageing in oak. Flavours of ripe plums repeats in the palate rediscovering the cherries with just a hint of caramel. A deep yet delicate softness makes you think of velvet. Great finish.
100% Malbec
Handpicked in bags of 20kg. Fermented in stainless steel. Malolactic fermentation. 24 months in French oak.
Enjoy withBeef, lamb, and baked pasta.
Best served at 18° – 20° C

Today, this path of history finds them enjoying what they love best and know most about: making wines that can evoke thousands of moments and transmit numerous life experiences. 100% Malbec 
Balanced, vigorous and adventurous wine like a good rider. Intense red color with violet shades. Kind, natural and fresh in mouth. High Intensity of red fruits aromas in nose. 
Best served at 12-15° C
Enjoy with red meats or pasta.
About the winemaking process:  
The harvest is performed between the third and the fourth week of March using plastic cases of 15-17 kg. Pre-fermentative cold maceration during 4 days at 8 degrees. Total maceration time between 15 to 20 days.

100% Tannat.
High altitude wine (1700 masl) from Cafayate Valley, Salta, Argentina.
Best served at18°C.
Enjoy with lamb, red meats or game.
Tasting notes: Bright and clear, with an intense color and violet reflections. Intense, with a marked fruity (plums, cherries) and a little spice. The palate repeats the fruity character, with good varietal typicality, firm ripe tannins, good acidity, and long finish.
The grapes are picked byhandin the morning, atlowtemperatures,inboxesof 20kg.each. Then there is a bunch selectiontable. 5 days maceration in stainless steel tanks with temperature control. Fermentation at controlled temperatures (25º) stainless steel tanks. Natural yeasts.
Only 8km from Cafayate, Yacochuya is located 2,035 metres above sea level (masl) with limited rainfall (less than 300 mm year), which makes its terroir something unique and matchless.

Full-bodied with high acidity and soft tannins. It is easy to drink, and hard to forget.
100% Malbec Designed to drink young, it has a deep dark red colour with straight forward aromas of red fruits and marmalades, in perfect harmony with an oak finish. Very full-bodied with high acidity with and soft tannins make it easy to drink and hard to forget.
Best served at 18° C
Enjoy with a BBQ, red meats or pasta.
Nocturnal harvest. Controlled fermentation. 10 months of French and American oak.
Domiciano produces wines with 100% Malbec grapes, harvested during the fresh nights in our farms in Barrancas to avoid oxidation and thus preserve the maximum aromatic expression. Once the grapes are taken into the cellar, they are allowed to macerate at cold, controlled temperatures for 5 days in stainless-steel tanks. Then they ferment with selected yeasts, maintaining the temperature between 25 to 28ºC for approximately 15 days. Later, the wine rested in a combination of French and American oak for 10 months.
About the winery:
The vineyards of Domiciano de Barrancas are located in the heart of Barrancas, south of the Mendoza River. The climate is dry and sunny, with great thermal amplitude between day and night; this allows a slow and progressive maturation, harmonising the sugar-acidity ratio. The tall trellises are irrigated with the purest water, the melting snow of the Andes.

Another suprisingly easy-drinking offering from this remarkable, tiny Margaret River vineyard, producing award winning red blends hand-picked from one block of cabernet sauvignon and one of shiraz.

This red blend has a wonderful bouquet with plum, liquorice and vanilla. The palate is smooth with voluptuous fruit and eastern spice notes. Brilliantly balanced and lightly oaked, it will continue to cellar to 2029.

A typically smooth and refined Frog Choir cabernet sauvignon and shiraz blend from a wonderful boutique Margaret River winery. A supremely easy drinking wine, with or without a meal. Aromas of currents, plum jam and liquorice, laced with more delicate cherry blossom, clove and black pepper notes will delight. This carefully crafted red is yet another superb offering from award winning winemaker, Bruce Dukes. A long cellaring wine, much of the waiting has been done for you. Rewarding drinking now or continue to cellar to 2028.

A wine of depth and intensity, grown on 70+ year old Hunter Valley Vines. Grown on the deep red volcanic soils from the hillside on Wynwood Estate and handpicked after an ideal growing season this is a Medium to Full Bodied Shiraz. 

The boquet is layered, displaying darker berry fruits, earth and French oak. The primary focus of the palate is fruit sweetness and natural acidity supported by fine tannins.

Perfumed aromas of dark plums, black currant and cola. Secondary aromas of black olive, clove and nutmeg and charcuterie evolve with further swirling of the glass.
Powerful, textural flavours of red currant, wild raspberry and Cherry Ripe flavours swamp the surfaces of the mouth. Subtle, velvety oak tannins envelope the fruit core with a fine acid line creating line and focus.
The 2018 SYNA has plenty of nervous tension as an infant, however with further cellaring will show its true potential into its teens!

Each varietal has an important role to play in the blend. The Sangiovese provides chalky tannins and fresh acid line. The Shiraz provides ripe fruit density and richness. With the Malbec providing floral notes and red and blue fruits. At the conclusion of maturation rigorous barrel selection and blending trials across the three varietals is carried out to maximise the expression of each grape variety to produce an easy drinking, food friendly style of wine. The wine is neither fined nor filtered.
Dark crimson in colour with scents of crushed rose petals, black cherry, blueberry and subtle cinnamon spice. A palate of ripe fruits flavours of dark plum, raspberry and blueberry, partnered with fine chalky fruit tannins delicately wrap around the fruit core.

The name MARAnanga Shiraz is a play on words, Mara Georgiadis co-owner and Marananga the region where our two vineyards are located.
A true reflection of the region and the strong 2021 vintage.

A true reflection of the region and the strong 2020 vintage.  Deep crimson colour with perfumed aromas of black currant blackberries and cassis. A rich concentrated palate of black fruits liquorice with cedar oak spice fine acid line. Velvety chocolatey tannins.
Drink now over next 8 + years.
Partner with chargrilled rib-eye or vintage cheese.

The Tuscan is a blend of Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese, Colorino and Petit Verdot which is a traditional Bordeaux blend. A vibrant and juicy wine with red berry fruit and fine tannin with a rich lingering finish.
Receiving 95 James Halliday points this wine is perfect for cellaring for up to eight years.
All grown in within the Wood Park home block the varieties are harvested separately and all fermented in 3 tonne open fermenters and regularly hand plunged, helping bring out the vibrant color. The wines were transferred to seasoned oak barrels for 22 months and blended prior to bottling. This style was inspired by the super Tuscans of Italy.

This is a bold Pinot Noir with a palate that is rich and distinctive with a fleshy texture with a smooth finish. Featuring black cherry, plum and a touch of cinnamon, bright and vibrant with the savoury spice of a Burgundy style wine. Our Pinot Noir has great persistence and length with a taut structure.
Handpicked from a small, single pinot noir vineyard in the Yarra Valley. Entirely delicious, fruit driven, barrel aged… ready to enjoy now. Spot is the family dog who runs the place.

Margaret River Shiraz Viognier 2018. The great red wines of the northern Rhone in France are made up of two grape varieties one red variety being Syrah, what we refer to as Shiraz in Australia and one white variety namely Viognier.
Intense aromas of red fruits, cherries, cranberries, with liquorice coated raspberry confectionary sweetness. Layers of spice, cashew nuts and tabacco dance together with the subtle apricot lift.
A lovely soft and round wine. A generous mid pallet of the red fruits and spice dominate the mouthfeel. The fine tannins create a length of succulence and balance.

This wine showcases an elegant Margaret River Shiraz at its best.

This is an aromatic wine. As a young wine it displays red fruits of plums, kirsch, fresh tobacco, white pepper, touch of sage and violets.

 Intense dark forest fruits lead the way, with plenty of white pepper, nutmeg, bay leaves and a hint of violets. The Oak gives the wine weight and nutty vanilla tones. The line is elegant, the fine tannins and soft acid lingers on the long, soft and satisfying finish

product_name: Margaret River Cabernet Malbec Merlot Blend 2017
product_description:
As in Bordeaux these grape varieties grow very well and feature in this Margaret River 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon.
A delightfully perfumed nose of black cherries, plums, blackcurrant, cigar box, new leather and mingled smoky oak.  A great balance of bright fruit, savory complexity and integrated oak.
A generous palate of ripe dark fruits, with layers of savory notes  The tannin profile is precise and linear, providing a long dry length.
A quintessential Margaret River Cabernet of absolute quality featuring fine tannins and a long finish

Selected parcels of Shiraz and Viognier were co-fermented to produce Churchviews classic Shiraz. 14 months in French barriques and hogs heads has craftd a wine with red fruits, white pepper, with a bright floral overtones. Palate has fine tannins and a long finish.

product_name: The Bartondale Margaret River Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
product_description: Select parcels of fruit from the Old Block and Ray's block brings fruit richness and savoury elements together.  Matured in French oak barriques for 18 months.  A quintessential Margaret River Cabernet of absolute quality, with fine tannins and a long finish.

product_name: Margaret River Cabernet Malbec Petit Verdot Merlot 2018

product_description: Lone Palm Vineyard established in 1992, located at South of Marananga, the heart of Barossa Valley. A vineyard of many different sites and a lone palm tree standing next to the settlers cottage built in the late 1800’s from where the name originates. Hillside block has opulent sunshine, enough precipitation and rich soil. Using hand pick, high-quality French oak and traditional winemaking to produce dark, fruity, full-bodied premium Shiraz. The 2020 Lone Palm Hillside Shiraz was sourced from one of our best West facing hillside block, located at South of Marananga, the heart of Barossa. The wine was aged in French and American oak for at least 18 months. Dark ruby colored, the nose reveals rich dark fruit, blood plumbs, blackberry, and blueberry with dark chocolate, mineral and licorice. Full-bodied and elegant, the wine offers layers of deep flavors, outstanding depth, and a long, smooth finish. The wine will comfortably cellar for the next 12-15 years.

The 2020 Lone Palm Crossings Shiraz was sourced from front roadside block, located at South of Marananga, the heart of Barossa. The wine was aged in seasoned French and American oak over 14 months. Purple-colored, the nose reveals toasty oak, mineral, licorice, black raspberry, and blueberry. Full-bodied and elegant, the wine offers layers of savory flavors, outstanding depth, and a long, smooth finish. The wine will easily cellar for 5-7 years of further evolution in bottle but can be enjoyed now and over the next 10-12 years.

In 2021 the fruit showed greater intensity and minerality than the previous vintage. Each parcel was picked separately and destemmed into open-top tank for fermentation, chilled down then allowed to warm up and naturally ferment using indigenous yeasts. All three parcels were fermented separately. The ferment was gently hand plunged two to three times daily for approximately 7-8 days. Then basket pressed and all blocks blended together and filled directly to USA & French oak (15% new) with natural malolactic fermentation, then followed by a minimum 18 months maturation in barrel. The wine was racked once (after MLF completed) during this 18 months and then bottled unfiltered.
This wine as usual has amazingly deep colour and density, notes of cedar and blue and red berries. The palate has initial blueberry fruit (a hallmark of this wine) with mouth-watering juiciness, finishing smoothly with great chalk-like tannin structure. All too easy for now but is also built for a bit of a long run in the cellar.

From our own vineyard in Marananga. Picked before daylight and destemmed to an open-top tank for fermentation, chilled down for a 24-48 hour cold soak then allowing to warm up and naturally ferment using indigenous wild yeasts. The ferment was gently hand plunged two to three times daily for approximately 7-10 days. Then basket pressed directly to seasoned USA & French oak (20% new French) with 3-4 weeks barrel fermentation with natural malolactic fermentation followed by 16-18 months maturation. The wine was racked twice during this 18 months and then bottled unfined, unfiltered.

Picked before sunrise to maintain freshness and flavour. Fermented long and cool, basket pressed to complete ferment in French & USA oak barrels (15% new). Lifted aromas of blueberries a hint of soft cedar, big juicy palate of blueberries and blackberries, oak playing a supporting role finished with long smooth powdery tannins.

product_name: Artisan Barossa Valley Grenache Mataro Shiraz 2020
product_description:
Ten months in oak with three months in stainless steel before
bottling in autumn ’21. All three varieties were fermented in
open-topped fermenters on skins, and matured in French oak
puncheons of different ages. The Grenache for 10-15 days before being pumped over twice daily, the Mataro for 15 days with whole berry fermentation, while the Shiraz was fermented on skins for 10 days with gentle pumpovers twice daily. All components were kept separate before blending at 10 months.

A wine that manages to evoke both varietal and regional typicity from a region where these lines can become blurred if not carefully managed. Medium to full-bodied in nature, it displays richness of fruit with cassis and blueberries, while retaining the varietal savoriness of dried rosemary, bay-leaf-smoked paprika, and a gentle rub of mint. The palate has an enviable balance of tannin firmness and pillowy generosity of fruit weight. The fruit’s generosity allows for drinkability in its youth, but will comfortably cellar well for 10–15 years.

A variety that is at home in the Barossa Valley, and a wine we are proud to craft. A modern and elegant take on the Barossa but a wine that also manages to evoke the power and complexity the Barossa is known for. A contemporary wine combining the red-blue fruited nature and savoury tannin structure of Gomersal with the seductive caressing nature of Greenock. The Artisan Shiraz will drink well from release but hold and continue to improve over the next 10 years. It is at its core a food-friendly wine so enjoy it with good food and great company.

product_name: Black Label Barossa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
product_description: Full and rich in the mouth. Full bodied with a saturation of black and blue toned berries. Tannins are firm and fine grained with alcohol and acid nicely integrated into the structure of the wine. Complex flavours of preserved dark fruits overlaid with a suggestion of marzipan. A fresh, tight finish with hints of eucalyptus.

Full and rich in the mouth. Full bodied with a saturation of black and blue toned berries. Tannins are firm and fine grained with alcohol and acid nicely integrated into the structure of the wine. Complex flavours of preserved dark fruits overlaid with a suggestion of marzipan. A fresh, tight finish with hints of eucalyptus.

THE Rosé is as fresh as the first blush of a new morning. Subtle notes of rose petal open up to strawberry on the nose with a splash of cranberry and pink grapefruit on the palate.
The grapes for THE Rosé were hand-harvested in West Lodi, an AVA known for the cooling Delta influence in an otherwise warm area. The 2016 harvest provided balanced yields of quality fruit, allowing us to make a fun and easy-sipping wine.
50% Pinot Noir, 25% Syrah, 25% Zinfandel.

product_name: Oakville Estate Napa Valley Cabernet Blend 2015 1500mL
product_description:
An authentic expression of a unique place, the Rudd Oakville Estate Red transcends grape variety with a profound expression of vintage and site from mature vines in the Estate’s complementary terroirs of core stone volcanics and alluvial fan.  Composed for ageability, harmony, finesse and longevity, the Rudd Oakville Estate Red is the pinnacle of what the Oakville Estate produces in each vintage.
Deep in color with a hint of violet edges, the 2015 presents black cherry on the nose. With an elegant entry, the mouth is filled with supple tannins, yet the wine remains fluid and focused. An Estate blend that is dominated specifically by the vineyard lots originating from the Rudd Alluvial Fan, revealing elements of fresh acidity and dark fruit. The beauty of alluvial characteristics are complemented by the lots from the red, volcanic soils with the wine showing density and volume with notes of bramble, earth and iron rust.
Blend: 94% Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot, 1% Malbec.

Created on the Sergi 1957 estate at Virginia, South Australia. The old hand pruned vines are handpicked at perfect ripeness. Once fermented and basket pressed, the wine is then matured in French and American oak barrels. With an abundance of fresh fruity aromas and flavours, this amazing red is very smooth and subtle with a superb balance of cinnamon, pepper and oak. The 2015 Grand Grenache Shiraz is at its best for drinking now, after being cellared for 4 years. Enjoy on its own or with most dishes, a great easy to drink all rounder that’s sure to please.

Made with fruit from our estate vines, thisRoséhas beautiful aromatics and texture; strawberry, tangerine and pears combine for a pure and delicate mouthfeel.
A focused and driven palate presents volumes of lifted summer fruits with a carefully constructed purity of texture to finish light and fresh.
Sinuous and graceful, with blackberry, blood plum and coffee spice. Hand plunged in open fermenters, pressed to tank then matured in new and seasoned French oak for 12 months.

The mc2 is aclassic blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc.
Cabernet Sauvignon gives the wine structure with rich fruits of the forest and a harmonious tannin fingerprint. Merlot encourages softness and juiciness with bursts of ripe blueberries and fresh plum jam. Finally, the Cabernet Franc contributes juicy red currants and cinnamon.
All of these flavours meld together to bring a complex and rounded palate, which finishes with soft tannins and chocolatey oak.

Hidden on our 3 Mile Lane vineyard are our rarely seen rows of Petit Verdot.Petit Verdot is one of the five red varieties of Bordeaux.
This wine is a juicy, ripe fruit driven, medium bodied wine. Textural, lifted fruit, and balanced with a bright vanillin finish. Perfect withsmoked beef short rib, or barbequed vegetables.

This wine is a young, energetic fruit driven, medium-bodied wine. Textural, spicy, and balanced with a spark.
Wine harvested at optimal ripeness in along and dry growing season. Bright upfront fruit driven wine for a vibrant young drinking wine.

ThisShiraz is carefully crafted from fruit grown on our Riddoch Run Estate Vineyard.
This fresh winedisplays dark forest fruits, cassis, pepper and spices, framed in bright aromatic oak.Fresh blueberries, rhubarb and dark chocolate are on show, along with a good depth of flavour, ripe and supple tannins provide a long finish.

A perfect spicy companion, expressing the subtlety of shiraz in a region defined by cool climate and outstanding soil.
Driven blueberry and cherry fruit palate.A continuation of dark chocolate from the aroma balances with a supple and elegantly textured mouthfeel.
Toasty oak midpalate supports these youthful flavours and deep tannins to provide a harmonious and persistent finish.

Cabernet Sauvignon is Coonawarra's pre-eminent grape variety. Our 2019 vintage is well structured with a palate of rich ripe grape tannins, supported with French oak frame-work. Cassis and plum, cigar box and cocoa. Great presence and complexity.

Medium weight, generous full flavoured with assertive tannins, that are not aggressive. Long lingering after taste, with oak influence minimal and supportive of the primary red fruits present. The aroma is reminiscent of dried Italian herbs, oregano, thyme, fennel seeds and basil. Subtle oak aromas with primary fruit of maraschino cherry and cranberry.

Ripe and generous. This wine has rich blackberry and plum fruits with clove and spice which typifies Barossa Valley Shiraz. Vanilla chocolate and coffee notes from oak maturation adds to the aroma.The 2018 vintage for the Barossa Valley produced Shiraz wines of firm structure density and power. The high extract and tannin is balanced by the sweet mid palate generous fruit flavours making the wine approachable on release but will benefit from correct cellaring for 10+ years.

Complex bouquet, there are elements of fruit, winemaking and maturation aromas making for an intriguing experience. Blackcurrant accompanied by violets, brown spice, leather and licorice.ntense Cabernet Sauvignon varietal characters, multi-layered flavours. Full bodied, powerful, abundant fine tannins. The savoury notes of black olive and dark chocolate add structure and texture.

These grapes were grown using Biodynamic practices and are Certified with the ACO. The wine was fermented naturally using wild yeast living in the vineyard. The wine was basket pressed and matured in small oak barrels for 12 months.
The wine exhibits a ripe berry bouquet with a hint of white pepper on the palate. This wine will become well integrated and more complex with extended cellaring.

This hand crafter natural wine is created from Certified Organic/Biodynamic Shiraz grapes. The grapes were picked at ultimate ripeness to encapsulate the delicate flavours and crisp acidity. After whole bunch basket press to minimise skin contact the juice was cool fermented resulting in the beautiful light salmon hue. Extended lees contact creates the long mouth feel and red berry flavours. To be enjoyed with friends. Rosè at any time of day.

"Nothing But Grapes" or as we like to call it "Naturally Bloody Good" Vintage 2021, the always long awaited Nothing But Grapes!  NO added preservative (sulphur 220) NO added "designer" yeasts (fermented using wild vineyard yeast) NO added yeast nutrients or settling enzymes NO added bacteria for malolactic fermentation NO fining agents used.

The 2013 Business Time Shiraz is Mount Barker: powerful 5 spice, earth and bacon fat aromatics, succulent red fruit dominates with supporting layered tannins and a long focused finish with dark chocolate and graphite textures.

The 2018 Extreme Ways Tempranillo has red fruits: cherries, raspberry, mulberry and earthy fresh leather complexity. There is also underlying cardamom and some white flowers. Rich and generous on the palate the 2018 Extreme Ways is a product of perfect ripening in a great Frankland vintage. The succulence is balance by fine graphitic tannins with a gentle drying dustiness on the long finish.

The Shiraz is from our Pothana vineyard at Belford.
This Shiraz is a medium bodied wine showing red berries, spicy fruit and soft mild tannins. This wines has the ability to age more that it's constitution might suggest. This wine is deep red in colour with purple tinges. The aroma is dominated by sweet berry and spice. The medium bodied palate showing fruit richness with peppery undertones. The finish is long soft supported by fine tannins.
A gentle wine, try it with lamb cutlets or an old fashion mixed grill.

Piedmont region of northwest Italy is best known for its Barolo's, magnificent wines made from the Nebbiolo grape. These wines can age for decades, have great structure and are generally saved for special occasions. For everyday, most people in the region turn to the easier more accessible Barbera wines. Among their many virtues, these wines are great with food, with its bracing acidity it is a brillant accompaniment, refreshing the palate and stimulating the appetite. This wine exhibits all the classic varietal characters of Barbera.
Excellent growing conditions were experienced throughout the 2022 growing season in the Orange Region. This years wine comes from a vineyard located in the foothills of Mount Canobolas. The cool climate and ancient volcanic soils combined produce high quality grapes with good intensity of flavour and high natural acidity.
This wine has dry cherry and prune aromas with wild herb background. Savoury flavours dominate the palate which is medium bodied and finishes with a firm acidity accompanied by fine soft tannins typical of this variety.
Barbera is a versatile partner with food. It is great with pizza, but also with all manner of meat sauces and grilled meats. If you are throwing a steak or sausages onto the grill, get out the Barbera!

Sangiovese is Italy's most widely planted variety and responsible for some of its greatest wines from Chianti and Brunello di Montalcino. Wines made from this variety are elegant and forceful with alluring aromas of plums and dried underbrush with fresh cherry and earthy flavours medium tannins and bright acidity.These Sangiovese grapes were grown on Mount Canobolas in the Orange region The vines are 18 years old and the yields are low less than 2 tonnes per acre. This is achieved by meticulous hand pruning and crop thinning and removing all unripe and damaged grapes before harvest.
This wine is light brick red in colour, with bright purple hues. With aromas of fresh cherry typical of the variety, the palate delivers savoury fruit and a smooth finish.
Perfect with pizza, pasta and antipasto platters.

Deep garnet in colour with lifted ripe berry Shiraz fruit, complemented with subtle coconut oak and spice. The palate is soft and rounded with plum & blackcurrant flavours. Subtle oak sweetness is balanced with a natural effervescence.
Enjoy with BBQ ribs, roast turkey, mixed cheeses or dark chocolate mousse.

Run Amok stems from a side-project by Ming, the youngest daughter of the Hanging Tree Wines family in the Hunter Valley.
Making only premium reds while exploring Vegan wine-making, Run Amok is about keeping the cheek in life and staying young at heart. Just like our puppy Muscat, who loves to come on adventures with us, or occasionally, by himself. Either way, the sneaky little bugger runs amok wherever he goes!
This Shiraz Cabernet is a blend of Hunter Valley Shiraz and Hilltops Cabernet Sauvignon. Both were fermented in open fermenters and blended prior to bottling. The resulting wine has a purple hue with aromas of earth and spice. The palate reveals flavours of plums, blackcurrants, oak and spice.
Pair with rich, creamier dishes such as lamb shanks or fattier meats of wild game.

Run Amok stems from a side-project by Ming, the youngest daughter of the Hanging Tree Wines family in the Hunter Valley.
Making only premium reds while exploring Vegan wine-making, Run Amok is about keeping the cheek in life and staying young at heart. Just like our puppy Muscat, who loves to come on adventures with us, or occasionally, by himself. Either way, the sneaky little bugger runs amok wherever he goes!
This Shiraz shows the power and elegance of a great Hunter Valley vintage. Deep purple in colour with aromas of red and dark fruit. The palate displays flavours of earth, spice and dark berries with assertive tannins.
Pair with rich meat dishes such as pork or roast duck, or alternatively, cellar it for your next gathering and enjoy!.

This is a fresh and vibrant Rosé made from Sangiovese. Look for flavours of strawberries and cream, raspberry and pistachio. Chain of Ponds Novello range of wines are bright, vibrant and ideal for drinking right now. The modern style makes Novello a genuine all-occasion wine, perfect for enjoying with food and friends.

Clarendon Hills are vineyard and varietal expressionists who strive for purity and perfection and seek to portray the story of the individual vineyard 'Terroir' within their wines. Clarendon Hills’ collection of the old vine vineyards in sub-regions of McLaren Vale assists in defining their international pedigree for making world class wines that rate extremely highly among the international press. Among the Clarendon Hills single vineyards of  Syrah is the Domaine Clarendon Syrah vineyard which is located within the Clarendon sub region of McLaren Vale, South Australia. This vineyard was winemaker designed and is entirely unique in Australian viticulture. Single stake vines are planted within the highest elevation vineyards in all of McLaren Vale. All of the wines at Clarendon Hills are made by hand and are crafted using only natural processes and ingredients. Consistent Domaine Clarendon Syrah characters include blueberry, violet floral notes, graphite, black olive and roast meat characters on the nose and is often highly integrated on the palate with chalky tannins and impeccable balance. The Domaine Clarendon Syrah is a part of the Clarendon Hills Premier-Cru classification and generally drinks best after a few years in the cellar, when its ‘terroir’ is formally demonstrated.

Domaine Clarendon BDX represents a modern perspective of the classic Australian Bordeaux blend. Representing a traditional Medoc blend of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon and 40%  Merlot the Domaine Clarendon BDX offers a savoury styled example. Located in McLaren Vale, South Australia, all of the wines at Clarendon Hills are made by hand and are crafted using only natural processes and ingredients.
Apparent Domaine Clarendon BDX characters include violets, black currant, chococlate, cedar shavings and polished mahogany characters throughout the palate. The Domaine Clarendon BDX is a part of the Clarendon Hills Premier-Cru classification and generally drinks best after a few years in the cellar, when its ‘terroir’ is formally demonstrated. Exceptional vintages like 2016 offer a unique approachability and a refined expression of its ancient terroir.

product_name: 2016 Liandra Syrah Blewitt Springs, McLaren Vale
product_description: Clarendon Hills are vineyard and varietal expressionists who strive for purity and perfection and seek to portray the story of the individual vineyard 'Terroir' within their wines. Clarendon Hills’ collection of the old vine vineyards in sub-regions of McLaren Vale assists in defining their international pedigree for making world class wines that rate extremely highly among the international press. Among the 9 single vineyards of Syrah is the Liandra vineyard which is located within the Blewitt Springs sub region of McLaren Vale, South Australia. All of the wines at Clarendon Hills are made by hand and are crafted using only natural processes and ingredients. Consistent Liandra Syrah characters include and smokey bacon, blackberry fruit and flint-like minerality throughout the palate. The 2018 season: The twelfth consecutive good season for Margaret River - and no, we are not getting sick of saying that. A moderately wet winter led into a typically mild Spring, and the rains dried up as summer began. Summer was warm with a few hot spikes, but ample water in the ground kept the vines in good condition. The ripening period of January and February was moderate, with little or no rain - perfect conditions for the vines.
Yields were moderate, and the grapes could be harvested when they were perfectly ripe. The resultant wines have fantastic intensity and purity.
2018 will go down as an all-time classic for Margaret River.

product_name: Keeper of the Stones Barossa Valley Grenache 2022
product_description:
Family Vignerons for seven generations, dating back to 1840's when Johann George Mattner first pioneered land on the banks of Jacobs Creek, Barossa Valley. Grandfather entrusted myself to carry forward this legacy, that become apparent when I inherited a collection of family history books, handwritten notes and winemaking journals dating back to early last century. Inspired by this collection of generational knowledge, we crafted these wines to honour tradition and carry forward our family legacy.
Our Grenache wines are small batch production with only 509 cases produced. Single vineyard fruit was carefully selected from Southern Barossa Valley sub-region of Lyndoch, then guided through the vinification process. Handcrafted with minimal intervention winemaking methods and attention to detail. Gentle destemming some whole bunch inclusion, wild ferment, maceration and gravitational transfer into an old basket press for gentle extraction of colour and tannin.

The palate has richness of berries and plums with a hint of chocolate. Rich tannins are well balanced with fresh acidity and chocolate, with a medium long finish.

Nericon Durif shows a dense colour with vibrant purple hues. Offering a complex and deeply layered structure of cassis, blueberries, anise and pepper spice. The rich tannins evolve onto the palate providing a long, lively finish accompanied by vanillan oak and luscious floral aromas.

A medium-bodied Shiraz successfully combining fruit and spice flavours that offer a smooth, pleasing finish. For the ultimate Shiraz experience, serve generously with a cut of perfectly cooked beef steak.

A velvety rich Merlot with delicious plum and berry flavours that is accentuated by a soft and pleasing oak aroma. Enjoy with chargrilled Beef Eye Fillet on mash and a side of freshly steamed asparagus.

2 Monkeys Cabernet Merlot, embraces best of both the Cabernet Sauvignon and the Merlot grapes to create a blend that stimulates the palate with lush berry flavours and invigorates the senses. Enjoy with fine cheeses or slow cooked pork.

A medium-bodied Shiraz successfully combining fruit and spice flavours that offer a smooth, pleasing finish. For the ultimate Shiraz experience, serve generously with a cut of perfectly cooked beef steak.

Wannon Run Shiraz is highly aromatic and has a medium bodied palate of black and red fruits. Hints of licorice, black pepper and spice add to the complexity. Vibrant acidity and fine tannins are seamlessly intergrated.
This rose was made from low yielding Shiraz grapes picked in April using the traditional Saignee style. The wine was fermented to dryness and has light berry flavours and crisp acidity.

Charming and poised, fragrant with spice, pepper, florals and fruits in the blue-black spectrum, but it's the seamless palate that works its magic: medium-bodied and lithe, very fine tannins mingling with fresh acidity.

It is full of blackcurrant/cassis backed by fine tannins, both unequivocally ripe, and defining the quality. The wine was crafted using traditional techniques including hand plunging and basket pressing.

product_name: Wooden case with 5 bottles of Bordeaux
product_description: With wine for every course, this collection of five French drops offers the perfect entertaining collection or unique gift idea - beautifully presented in a wooden case.

Beautifully ripe and intensely aromatic, the wine shows blackberry, vanillin oak, floral and warm spice aromas on the nose, leading to a wonderfully weighted palate delivering succulent fruit flavours together with fleshy texture and silky tannins, making it highly enjoyable.
At its best: now to 2034.

This Cabernet Sauvignon produced by Cael's Gate are made from 30 year-old vines. This wine gorgeously complex and engaging on the nose showing cassis, dried herb, clove and roasted nut characters with a hint of leather. The palate displays supple mouthfeel and fine texture, firmly structured by chalky tannins, finishing wonderfully long and sturdy.
At its best now to 2032.

On the palate, ripe berries and cinnamon can be noted, leading to a succulent palate that's supple and lingering. It's flavoursome and smooth backed by chalky tannins, finishing superbly long and sturdy. Characterised by its rich full body, this wine has an arormatic display of spices, vanilla and oak.
At its best in 2021 to 2031.

This single vineyard wine produced by Cael's Gate was made from vinesplanted in 1971. This wine is delicately expressed on the nose showingraspberry, red apple, lemon peel and white floral aromas. This is followedby a finely textured palate displaying juicy fruit flavours and backed bybright acidity.

product_name: Orange Single Vineyard Hunter Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2022
product_description:
Vintage in Orange was cold, with temperatures never rising above 29degrees. As a result, the harvest was pushed back to April which meant lessstress on the vines and sunburn to the grapes. The slow ripening of grapesduring autumn added wonderful aromas and flavours to the wines.
The Cabernet Sauvignon produced by Cael's Gate is aged in new premiumFrench oak barrels. Offering purity and finesse, this wine is beautifullyfragrant on the nose with cassis, blueberry, violet, thyme and toasted nutaromas that lead to a succulent palate displaying excellent weight and
persistency. Wonderfully structured by beautifully infused chalky tannins, finishing sturdy and lingering on the palate.

product_name: Riverina Handpicked Hunter Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
product_description:
The Riverina region was largely unafected by the heavy rainfall experiencedby other parts of New South Wales and this allowed Cael’s Gate to continueproducing their highly sought-after single vineyard wines. The cool night and
warm days were the perfect growing environment for ripening grapes and thelack of disease and high sugar content contributed to a perfect harvest.
The Cabernet Sauvignon produced by Cael’s Gate is aged in new premiumFrench oak barrels. The wine is beautifully fruited with a complexity of favoursdisplaying black currant, spiced cherry, thyme and cedar notes to tantalise thenose. The palate delivers a succulent fruit intensity and a supple mouthfeelthat is well supported by chalky tannins. The finishing notes are persistent andabundantly flavoursome.

Most grape growers and wineries in New South Wales faced a difficult vintage in2021 and Mudgee was no exception. Frequent heavy rains in the regionthreatened the quality of the crops and the fruit took longer to ripen. Despite the
harvest being slow and steady, the final results yielded reasonable crops andclean grapes.
The single vineyard wine produced by Cael's Gate are made from vines plantedin 1996. The wine is matured in new premium French oak barrels resulting inwine that is sweetly ripe and inviting on the nose. The notes are dark berry, cake
spice, vanilla and roasted hazelnut aromas, followed by a delightfullyflavoursome palate offering a juicy fruit intensity combined with silky tannins.These complex and exciting flavours lead to an elegant delectable finish totantalize the senses.

Offering opulence and density, the bouquet shows dark fruit richness together with vanilla, toasted spice and hazelnut characters. It's equally satisfying on the palate, displaying outstanding depth and fruit intensity, wonderfully complemented by velvety texture and rounded tannins.
At its best: now to 2033.

Appearance: Crimson/Red
Bouquet: Redcurrant, earth and cedar.
Palate: The palate is rich and powerful showing generous mulberry and dark chocolate flavours.  A soft and supply backbone of tannin gives this cabernet a long and precise evolution through the palate.

A fresh, new addition to the Flying Fish range. 
Our 2021 Flying Fish Cove Rosé pours with a light rose petal hue. Classic aroma's of strawberry, watermelon and turkish delight. 
Fresh and vibrant flavours of light red berry and dried herb.
Colour: Pale Salmon
Bouquet: Delivering a medium bodied style Rosé, our 2021 opens with watermelon, baking spice and sweet, floral notes
Palate: A palate chock full of endless red fruit flavour presents a flavoursome and satisfying Rosé.
This Saignée style Rosé goes well with sticky sweet pork ribs. Crispy skin duck with chinese scallion pancakes and quandong plum sauce. Fresh fruit platters and cheeseboards.
Our 2021 Rosé is a Saignée style Rosé. Saignée refers to the act of bleeding juice from crushed red grapes. The bleeding of the juice yields a pale coloured juice that is perfect for the production of flavoursome fuller style rose wines. Fermentation followed by a brief period of time on lees has delivered a perfect summer style drink.

This shiraz is produced from the vineyard where the winemaker has carefully selected the fruit.

Unique location, climate and soil make this shiraz outstanding. With the aroma of fresh berries, cloves and licorice, this medium-bodied shiraz has soft and silky tannins and great length of flavour.
This medium-bodied wine has a complex bouquet and flavour profile with rich berry fruits, spice, floral aromas, cedar, and refined tannin structure. Pair with red meat dishes.

Lifted aromas of fleshy ripe red currants, cherries, spice, and mild pepper. Soft and inviting fruit flavours of the likes of plum, red currant, and ripe berries with undertones of oak and lingering tannins. Silky in texture this wine has well-integrated oak and natural acid giving it an elegant soft finish.

product_name: of 2021 Woodworkers Mark Wrattonbully Pinot Noir 750ML
product_description: Elegant and delicate - Pinot Noir with a bouquet of dark cherries and plums. The palate displays flavours of strawberry cream and rhubarb. The wine is soft with matured tannins and an everlasting finish.

This is a fresh and vibrant Pinot noir with layers of flavours adding complexity to it. Dark cherries and plums strike a perfect balance with intense savoury undertones of spice, mushrooms and forest floor. The wine has soft tannins and an everlasting finish. Pair with duck or soft mild cheeses.

Dark Knight Pinot Noir effortlessly glows in shades of scarlet and ruby red, while offering plush essences of rich forest berries driven by underlying dark plum characters. A luxurious mouth feel can be expected with a velvety smooth tannin structure. Perfectly compliments Mediterranean foods. Enjoy at present or allow to develop for a few years.

Fresh blackberry aromas with hints of mocha and French oak. Full-bodied, with a luscious dark berry mid-palate; seamlessly structured with fine but firm tannins and balanced acidity that ensures a long, lingering finish.

Darker blackcurrant and red fruits are entwined aromatically on the nose, mixed with spicy herbal notes. The palate exhibits a crunchy red fruit drive, elegance, and textural flow, with a fresh lingering finish.

Distinction Point was made from fruit carefully selected from smaller sections of our premium low-yielding vineyards. Adequate winter rainfall, relatively dry conditions during flowering, and bunch set gave a good start to the vines.
Warm weather from January onwards till harvest formed perfect conditions for the grapes to ripen at an ideal pace. The grapes were hand-picked at optimum flavour ripeness and fermented in open vats for 10 days.
The ferment was hand plunged 4 times a day, followed by maceration up to 20 days to build structure.
The wine was matured in French oak barrels for 24 months. This wine is typical of the region, depicting intense varietal character.

Lifted aromas of vanilla and spicy oak are exhibited in this Cabernet Sauvignon. Deep flavours of blackcurrant and mulberry fruit, followed by hints of nutmeg, lingering chocolate oak and balanced tannin, lead to an elegant finish. Beautifully paired with slow roasted lamb or rich duck dishes.

One of our absolute favourites, our Cabernet Sauvignon is matured in oak casks for that light vanillin oak finish. It’s a lively red with a smooth finish, presenting fine velvety tannins and an intense blackcurrant jam flavour on the palate. Despite its complexity it is a great easy-drinking red, but we recommend it paired with hearty, meaty dishes such as a lasagne, steak or a cheese platter.

The Leogate Estate Black Cluster Shiraz is made from grapes grown on our own 50-year-old historic Black Cluster Vineyard in the Hunter Valley.
This single vineyard sits at the foothills of the Brokenback Mountain Range and the grapes are carefully selected from individuals old vine Shiraz blocks, then fermented and matured using a selection of new and older French and American oak barrels.
This is a rich red wine displaying layers of red and blue fruits that are well complemented by the sweetness and structure from the oak barrels. The presence of fine tannins and spicey note contributes to the seamless palate, delvering a wine of greater character, intensity and balance.

Nature is a very curious and amazing thing and as vineyard owners in the Central Ranges wine district of New South Wales, we are constantly surprised how well our vines can perform in stressful conditions, with little to no rain. Miracle on the Wire refers to the tiny bunches of grapes that form on our vines each year, as well as to the sighting of the Blue Wren perched up on the wires of our Zeals Vineyard, as this is usually a sign of coming rain and good fortune.

A vibrant wine that can be enjoyed now or cellared for up to 3-5 years.

product_name: Barone Rosso - Cabernet Franc Merlot NV
product_description:
Brilliant ruby red with purple tinges. Intensely fruity with recalls of wild blackberries, raspberries and
pleasantly herbaceous. Extremely fresh, velvety, well-balanced, with a long and typical
after-taste.

While almost all Australian Merlot in the bottle is made from one clone, this wine is made from a parcel of clones that are new to Australia. Merite Merlot is a multi-clone blend that is built to showcase the qualities of these newer clones such as fine tannins and vibrancy. This wine aims to be a new benchmark for the variety in Australia.

A Merlot pressings wine that is the ultimate selection from the 2015 vintage. Pressings from each clonal batch were blended with a small amount of Cabernet Sauvignon from the best barrel in the room. This selection process was based purely on merit and determined that a very limited number of bottles were made (745).
A special limited production wine that will reward those committed to carefully cellaring it.

The colour of this Shiraz Viognier has a bright purple intensity, solid to the core. The nose offers a tremendous lift of spice from the Viognier. Dark blackberries are supported in the background by a careful use of oak. The palate is rich and luscious, followed by long tannins and dominating fruit.

A bright and expressive nose loaded with red fruits, cherry and plum. The palate is both juicy and bold with spice and smooth milk chocolate-like tannin. The Shiraz component adds depth and dark fruits, while the Grenache delivers a vibrancy and energy with a fresh finish.
